tataḥ ko doṣa iti cet, ucyate --cakṣurnaiva cakṣuḥ syāt, rūpasyāgrāhakatvāt, ghaṭavat jihvāvat tvagvadityādi
kathaṃ rūpasyāgrāhakaṃ cakṣuḥ iti dṛṣṭa-prasiddhiviruddhamucyata iti cet, tavaiva dṛṣṭaprasiddhivirodhāvāpādyete mayā
kiṃ kāraṇam ? ubhayathā rūpāgrāhitvāttasya
yadi sañcayastathāpyasannarūpa evetyuktatvādacakṣurviṣayo rūpam, tato rūpasyāgrāhakatvāccakṣuracakṣuḥ śrotravat
athāsañcitameva paramāṇunīlarūpamiṣṭaṃ tathāpyatīndriyatvādacakṣurviṣayo rūpam, ato rūpasyāgrāhakatvācca cakṣurna ca cakṣuḥ syāduktavaditi sūktam--ubhayathāpi rūpasyāgrāhakaṃ cakṣuriti
evaṃ tāvat cakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī ityatra cakṣuṣo'cakṣuṣṭvāccakṣurgrahaṇamanarthakam

॰pyāsannarūpa evetyakta॰ya॰
vijñānamapi na vijñānaṃ syāt, anyathārthapratipatteḥ, alātacakrādijñānavat
na ca cakṣurvijñānaṃ samaṅgati, rūpādanyatrāsambhavāt
na hi sañcayo rūpam
yadapi ca tadrūpaṃ tadviṣayamapi cakṣurvijñānasya samaṅganaṃ nāsti, aviṣayatvāt, anyendriyaviṣayavat
sañcayaviṣayamapi saṃvṛtisattvāt khapuṣpavat
nīlavijñānasambandhī na bhavati tatsantānaḥ, tadākārajñānotpattihetvabhāvāt, adagdhasya dāhājñānavat
vijñānagrahaṇamapyata evānarthakamityata āha --vijñānamapi na vijñānaṃ syādityādi yāvat khapuṣpavaditi
viśeṣeṇa jñānaṃ vijñānaṃ tadbhavadabhimataṃ pratyakṣaṃ mukhyaṃ vijñānaṃ na syāt, itarathā kathamācāryaśrīmallavādī 'vijñānaṃ na syāditi svavacanavirodhaṃ māyeya-dinnāviva brūyāt ? kiṃ kāraṇaṃ punarvijñānaṃ tanna syāt ? anyathārthapratipatteḥ, arūpasya sañcayasya rūpatvena pratipatteḥ sañcayatvena vā rūpamātrasya pratipatteḥ
ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? alātacakrādijñānavat
yatholmukāgnikaṇamātramārthaṃ cakram iti pratipadyamānaṃ na vijñānamevaṃ tadapi
ādigrahaṇāt sthāṇau puruṣajñānamityādi
evaṃ tāvaccakṣuriti vijñānamiti ca dvayaṃ dūṣitam
cakṣurvijñānasamaṅgī ityatra samaṅgitvamapi dūṣayitukāma āha --na ca cakṣurvijñānaṃ samaṅgatīti, taddvāreṇa puruṣākhyasantānaikagamanaṃ samaṅganaṃ tatastanniṣedhaḥ
kasmānna samaṅgati ? cakṣurvijñānasya rūpādanyatrāsambhavāt, na vā tatsantāno'nyatra sambhavati, uktaṃ hi --sati sambhave vyabhicāre ca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ iti
sañcayāpekṣo vyabhicāro'styato viśeṣyata iti cet, tanna, yasmānna sañcayo rūpam
arūpatvāccakṣurvijñānasaṅgatyabhāvaḥ
syānmatam--nīlarūpāvyabhicārādeva tadekagamanāt samaṅgītyucyate cakṣurvijñānamiti, etaccāyuktam, tasyāpyatīndriyatvāccakṣurvijñānāviṣayatvādarūpatvam
abhyupetyāpi tvanmatena yadapi ca tadrūpam, rūpata iti rūpyamrūpyata iti rūpam, cakṣurvijñānena kila rūpyata iti, tadviṣayaṃ sa viṣayo yasya tat tadviṣayam, kiṃ tat ? ekagamanam, kasya ? cakṣurvijñānasya, tadapi nāsti
kasmāt ? aviṣayatvāt
aviṣayatvamatīndriyatvāt prastutapratyakṣasya
anyendriyaviṣayavat, yathā śabdo'nyendriyaviṣayaścakṣurvijñānena na samaṅgyate tathā tadapi rūpamiti
syānmatam--sañcayaścakṣurvijñānasaṅgatiyogyaḥ syāditi, atra brūmaḥ --sañcayaviṣayamapi cakṣurvijñānasya samaṅganaṃ nāsti iti vartate

evaṃ tāvad rūpam, cakṣuḥ, vijñānam, samaṅgī ityetāni dūṣitāni

yadyapi syāt tayorekajñānatvādekajñeyatvam, ekaṃ jñānamanayorityekajñāne, tayorekajñānatvāt ekameva jñeyaṃ tadbhāva ekajñeyatvaṃ dāhānubhavavat, tasminnekajñeyatve itaretaratve anyonyātmāpannatve sati sarvasarvātmavāditā
katham ? samudāyānarthāntaratvād rūpaṃ samudāya eva samudāyasvarūpavat, samudāyo vā rūpameva rūpānarthāntaratvād rūpasvarūpavat
evaṃ rasādi-ghaṭādi-rūpādisamudāyāntarābhimatārthānāmanarthāntaratvāt sarvasarvātmakatvavāditā
tasmāt sarvaparamāṇunīlānāṃ sañcayānarthāntaratvādaikye sati samavāya- grahaṇe yuvatikeśapāśasamudāye gṛhyamāṇe, hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmāt sarvanīlaikyaṃ tasmādekameva nīlaṃ rūpamekakeśagataṃ gṛhyeta, ekamekaṃ prati pratyekaikanīlagrahaṇaṃ syāt, ekanīlavālagrahaṇe'pi ca sarvanīlakeśapāśagrahaṇamekanīlātmakatvāt samudāyasya
tataśca yathātra sandrāvāt sarvanīlaikatā, guṇasandrāvo dravyam, nārthāntaram, sandrutya sarvanīlaguṇā ekatāmāpannāḥ, tathā rūpādipañcakasyāpi rūparasagandhasparśaśabdapañcakasyāpi sandrāvādekatā syāt iti vartate
kasmāddhetoḥ ? guṇatvāt, dharmatvādityarthaḥ, na hi vaiśeṣikavad dravyaguṇabhedo'stīti kṛtvā
dṛṣṭānto nīlaikatvavat, yathā sarvanīlānāṃ guṇatvāddharmatvā tathā rūpādipañcakasyāpi, guṇatvāt, nīlaikatvavat
tataśca guṇasandrāvadravyatvāt sarvathā pṛthivyādīnām, teṣāmapi rūpādiparamārthatvāt sarvasarvātmakatvam
ayaṃ tu sandrāvātiśayo māyeyīyaḥ, sañcitālambanābhyupagamād rūpādiparamāṇūnāṃ sañcitānāmasañcitānāṃ prāganabhyupagamāt
āgama evoktaṃ hi vaḥ--saṅghātā eva saṅghātān spṛśanti, sāvayavatvāt
tatra parasparasparśanirūpaṇe sarvātma- dekatvaṃ tathā rūparasādyekatvam
tataśca sandrāvasiddhau guṇānāṃ rūpādyaikye sati ko doṣaḥ ? ucyate — guṇasandrāvadravyatvāt guṇānāṃ sandrutimātrameva yasmāddravyaṃ tasmāt sarvathā pṛthivyādīnāṃ pṛthivyaptejovāyvādīnām ekatvam iti vartate
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tadeva rūpādyekatvaṃ kāraṇam, tata āha --teṣāmapi rūpādiparamārthatvāditi, rūpādaya eva paramārtho guṇasandrāvadravyatvāt, teṣāṃ caikyam, ataḥ pṛthivyaptejovāyughaṭapaṭasaritsamudrajyotirādeḥ sarvasya lokasya tadātmakatvādaikyaṃ prāptamiti

tatsañcayatvakāraṇapradarśanārthamāha --sañcitānāmasañcitānāṃ prāganabhyupagamāt, prāgasañcitāḥ paramāṇurūpādayaḥ paścāt sañcitya ālambanībhūtā iti nābhyupagamyate yasmād māyāsūnavīyaiḥ
avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ bhavadbhirabhyupagatametaditi tadarthopapradarśanārtham āgama evoktaṃ hi vaḥ
hiśabdo yasmādarthe, yasmāduktaṃ hi vaḥ siddhānte, kimuktam ? saṅghātā eva saṅghātān spṛśanti sāvayavatvādityuktam
kiṃ paramāṇavaḥ parasparaṃ spṛśanti ? na spṛśanti ? spṛśanto'pi kiṃ deśena deśaṃ spṛśanti ? sarvaṃ vā ? saṅghātaṃ vā ? saṅghātā vā saṅghātān spṛśanto deśena vā deśaṃ sarvaṃ vā spṛśanti ? iti paripraśnopakramaṃ tatra parasparasparśanirūpaṇe ityādi, sarvātmasparśanāsparśanayordoṣāpādanena nirddhāritam --saṅghātāḥ saṅghātān deśena spṛśanti deśameva iti
yadi paramāṇuḥ paramāṇuṃ spṛśed deśābhāvāt sarvātmanā spṛśet, tataśca sa tatpraveśena piṇḍo'ṇumātrakaḥ syāt sapratighatvahānaṃ cāsya syāt

na sa sañcayādṛte sambhavati

yathoktam--
yasmin bhinne na tadbuddhiranyāpohe dhiyā ca tat
ghaṭāmbuvat saṃvṛtisat paramārthasadanyathā || abhi॰ ko॰ 6 | 4
abhyupete'pi tu viṣaye doṣaḥ
sa cābhyupagamyamāno'pi viṣayaḥ sañcaya eva sambhāvyeta, na paramāṇavo'tīndriyatvāt
sa cālambanapratyayo jñānasya sañcayaḥ, tasminnabhyupete'pi tu sañcitālambanapratyayatve naivāsya pratyakṣatā sidhyati tvanmatenaiva, tadābhāsatvāt
tadābhāsatvaṃ kalpanātmakatvāt, uktā ca kalpanātmakatā
tadubhayamapi bhrāntijñānātmakatvāt
bhrāntiḥ saṃjñāsaṃsthānasaṅkhyāvarṇānyathākalpanāt, saṃjñā ca saṃsthānaṃ ca saṅkhyā ca varṇaśca, teṣāṃ tairvānyathākalpanāt
anyathāpratipattirevātra kalpanābhimatā
saṃjñāsaṃsthānasaṅkhyāvarṇānāmanyathāpratipattermṛgatṛṣṇikāpratyayavadalātacakrapratyayavad dvicandrapratyayavat kāmalopahatacakṣuṣo nīlarūpapītapratyayavaditi yathāsaṅkhyaṃ dṛṣṭāntāḥ yathākramaṃ ca hetavo bhrāntijñānātmakatve sādhye tataśca pratyakṣatvābhāve sādhye
tatsamarthanārtha uttaro granthaḥ
tadarthamupasaṃhṛtyānte sādhanam --ata idaṃ naiva pratyakṣam, atathābhūtārthādhyāropātmakatvāt, bhrāntivat, nāvārūḍhasya tīravṛkṣadhāvanadarśanātmikāmekāṃ kriyābhrāntiṃ muktvā proktacaturvidhabhrāntivat
upanayastu vyavahāraprasiddhasya paramāṇunīlatvagrahaṇasya sarvatrātathābhūtārthapratipattisādharmyāt
athavā tata eva hetoḥ saṃvṛtisajjñānavadapratyakṣam
tadvyākhyā --yathā gopāletyādinā dṛṣṭāntaṃ samarthya tathā saṃvṛtisatītyādinā dārṣṭāntikasamarthanam

4 iti vacanādanyādṛśaḥ svārthasyeṣṭatvāt, tādṛśaḥ svārthād yadutpadyate pramāṇam, samānānekārthātathābhūtārthānnīlādisaṅghātāt prajñaptisata ālambanāt paramārthasadākāro labhyate, ta eva hi paramāṇavo nīlāditvenābhāsante iti tadviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣamiṣṭaṃ tathā ghaṭasaṅkhyādyākārebhyaḥ pratyakṣajñānajanakārthasadharmabhyaḥ samānānekārthajanyendriyasvārthebhyaḥ samānānekārthātathābhūtārthebhyaḥ paramārthasadākāro lapsyate iti ghaṭādijñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ syāt, saṃvṛtisadālambanatvāt, nīlādijñānavat
nīlādijñānaṃ vā na pratyakṣaṃ syāt, ghaṭādijñānavat
ta eva hi te paramāṇava ābhāsante
evamubhayostulye janakatve kuta etat--nīlādyābhāsaṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na ghaṭādyābhāsamiti
yathaiva hi paramāṇvavayavasamudāye ta evābhāsante tathā ghaṭādijñāneṣvapi samuditāsta evābhāsante, tathāstheṣveva ghaṭabuddhiḥ pravartate prajñaptiśca evaṃ tathāstheṣveva nīlādirūpabuddhiḥ pravartate prajñaptiśca

taṃ copāyena darśayiṣyannāha --bāhyārthābhāve vijñeyatvābhāvaḥ, tasya vijñānamātratvāt
vijñeyatvābhāve ca tasya vijñānatvamapi nāsti, vijānātīti hi vijñānam, kiṃ vijānāti vijñeyābhāve ? tataḥ prameyatvābhāvāt pramāṇatvābhāvaḥ pratyakṣasyeti jñeya-jñāna-pramāṇa-prameyatvavilakṣaṇaṃ khapuṣpavat kiṃ tat pratyakṣaṃ nāma ? ityeṣa doṣo durnivāraḥ, sa tāvat tiṣṭhatu
idaṃ tāvadastitvābhyupagamenaivānyathā vicāryate --vijñānaṃ hītyādi
hiśabdo dṛṣṭāntārthe, dṛṣṭaṃ hi loke vijñānaṃ pratyakṣādi, pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ca pramāṇe vijñāne
ādigrahaṇāt saṃśayaviparyayānadhyavasāyalakṣaṇāni ca vijñānāni pramāṇābhāsābhimatāni
idamasi tvaṃ praṣṭavyaḥ --tatra nirdhāryaṃ katamad vijñānamātramidaṃ sarvaṃ traidhātukamiti, naikamapi vijñānamātraṃ bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ
brūyāstvam--pratyakṣavijñānamātramiti, tanna tāvat pratyakṣavijñānamātraṃ tasyaivamavasthatvāt, tasya pratyakṣavijñānasyaivamavasthā yathāsmābhirvyākhyātā na rūpādiviṣayā na samudāyaviṣayā na cakṣurādinimittā saṃvṛtyā paramārthena vā yujyate iti tasmānna pratyakṣavijñānamātram
syānmatam--anumānavijñānamātramiti
tadapi nānumānavijñānamātram
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tasyāpi tatpūrvakatvāt, tasyāpyanumānasya tatpūrvakatvāt pratyakṣapūrvakatvāt
pratyakṣapūrvakaṃ hi svānubhavottarabhāvivikalpātmakamavikalpajñānasamanantarajanmā'numānaṃ mānasamaindriyamayogimānasapratyakṣapūrvakameveṣyate, tasyaiva pratyakṣasyāsiddhau kuto'numānasiddhiḥ ? ato nānumānamātramata āha --tadasiddhāvasiddhiratantvapaṭavat
yathā tantupūrvakasya paṭasya tantvasiddhāvasiddhistatpūrvakatvāt tathā pratyakṣāsiddhāvasiddhiranumānasya
evaṃ tāvat pramāṇavijñānamātratvāsiddhiḥ
evaṃ tarhi saṃśayabhrāntyādikalpanāvijñānamātramastu, tadapi na saṃśayabhrāntyādikalpanāvijñānamātraṃ vā, na saṃśayamātraṃ na bhrāntyādimātram, ādigrahaṇānna svapnānubhavānubhūtānukāramātraṃ na taimirikakeśondukādyākāramātram, sarvasyāsya kalpanātmakasya pramāṇābhāsasya ata eva pratyakṣapūrvakatvādeva tadasiddhāva vā, ata eva
nānadhyavasāyamātram, anavagrahātmakatvāt tasya

syānmatam--anadhyavasāyamātramastviti
tadapi nānadhyavasāyamātram, na asañcetitāvyaktasukhaduḥkhādisvarūpamityarthaḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? anavagrahātmakatvāt tasya, na hi tadatyantāsañcetitaṃ nāma jñānamasti
yadyapyavyaktajñānamasti apaṭutvāt tadarthāvagrahātmakaṃ na bhavatyato vijñānameva na bhavati, yasmād vijānātīti vijñānamiṣṭam, tacca na kiñcid vijānātīti nānadhyavasāyavijñānamātram
tasmānna vijñānamātram, pramāṇapramāṇābhāsavijñāneṣvanantarbhāvāt katamad vijñānamātramidaṃ sarvam ? etebhyaśca vijñānebhyo vyatiriktasyānyasya vijñānasyābhāvānna kiñcidetadvijñānamātraṃ sarvam
ityalamativikāśinyā saṅkathayeti saṅkṣipyopasaṃharati pratyakṣalakṣaṇasya sarvathā dūṣitatvāt, itarathā hyadyāpi dūṣaṇavacanaprapañcasyānekasyāvakāśo'stīti
evaṃ tāvadviśeṣaikāntavādinā kalpitaṃ laukikapratyakṣavilakṣaṇaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na ghaṭate, svavacanavyapekṣākṣepadustaravirodhatvāt
tiṣṭhatu tāvad bāhyārthābhāve vijñeyatvābhāvo vijñeyatvābhāve ca vijñānatvābhāvaḥ
vijñānaṃ hi pratyakṣādi

sañcitālambanasthāna uktavadityādi yāvannīlādiṣvabhāvādityanenā'tidiṣṭagranthārthabhāvanopāyadikpradarśanaṃ karoti mā bhūd vyāmoha iti
yādṛk sañcitālambanasthāne'smābhiruktam paramāṇunīlādīnāṃ sañcayaḥ sāmānyaṃ saṃvṛtisattvādasat iti, iha tu tadviparītaṃ samudāyaparamārthatvaṃ nīlādisaṃvṛtisattvam
nīlādiṣvabhāvāt tathāsambhāvane'pi tasyātīndriyatvādālambanatvānupapatteścakṣurādivijñānānāṃ rūpādisaṅghāta ālambanamiti prāptam
te ca pratyekaṃ paramārthato'santa iti teṣāmaviṣayatetyādyaśeṣaṃ yathābhāgamatra yojyaṃ bhedābhedasaṃvṛtiparamārthasthānavyavasthāpanayā
saṃvṛtisanto nīlādaya aindriyāḥ, na paramārthasatsamudāyaḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tasya rūpādyātmakatvāt tadekadeśabhūtasya rūpāderaparamārthasato'pyavibhāgāvasthasya ekasyāsarvasyālambanasyāsañcitavat na hyeko'sarvaḥ kadācidālambanaṃ rūpaṃ rasaḥ śabdo vā yathā'sañcitāḥ paramāṇavaḥ pūrvasmin vāde naindriyakā evamasañcita- vadasmin vāde lokalokottaravyavahārapratyakṣābhimateṣu ghaṭādiṣu nīlādiṣu cābhāvānna pratyakṣaṃ tadviṣayaṃ jñānamityabhisambandhaḥ
kimuktaṃ bhavati ? rūpādayaḥ sarvaikātmarūpā eva santi na pṛthaksvarūpāḥ

anayā diśā yadābhāsaṃ pratyakṣaṃ na so'sti viṣayaḥ, yo'sti na tadābhāsaṃ pratyakṣam ityādi viśeṣaikāntavādinaṃ prati yo'bhihitaḥ prapañcaḥ sa sarvo yojyaḥ
tathāsambhāvane'pi cetyādi, rūpāderekasya sattvarajastamoguṇasāmyāvasthānalakṣaṇapradhānākhyapadārthatvasambhāvane'pi
naiva tatsāmyāvasthānaṃ śabdādibhedaikasarvātmakatvābhāvarūpaṃ sambhāvyate, sambhāvyamāne'pi ca tasminnavyakte tasyā'vyaktasyātīndriyatvādālambanatvānupapatteścakṣurādivijñānānāṃ rūpādisaṅghāta ālambanamiti prāptam
te ca rūpādayaḥ pratyekaṃ paramārthato'santaḥ, itiśabdo hetvarthe, ityataḥ kāraṇādrūpādisaṅghātālambanatvāt teṣāṃ pratyekaṃ paramārthasattvābhāvānna viṣayatā
rūpādayo na cakṣurādiviṣayāḥ, paramārthato'sattvāt, vandhyāsutavat
rūpādiviṣayaṃ vā na pratyakṣam, paramārthato'sadviṣayatvāt, vandhyāsutajñānavat
tasmād yoni-bīja-prakṛti-bahudhānaka-pradhānā-'vyaktādiparyāyākhyaṃ yad vastu tadatīndriyatvādapratyakṣam

ityā- dyaśeṣaṃ viśeṣaikāntavādimate yathābhāgaṃ yo yo bhāgo yathābhāgaṃ tadviparyayeṇāviśeṣaikāntavāde'tra yad yatra bhajate tat tathānusṛtya yojyamityatītaṃ granthārthaṃ smārayati

syānmatam--puruṣasyātīndriyārthadarśanaśaktiśūnyatvāt svargāpūrvakarmasambandhajñāne pūrvavijñānakāraṇābhāvādvandhyāyā dauhitrasmaraṇavat
dravya-guṇa-rasa-vīrya-vipākādijñānasyānumānaṃ pūrvavijñānakāraṇaṃ sambhāvyeta
tasmādupadeśādevāgnihotrakarmasvargaphalābhisambandhādijñānamiti
etaccāyuktam, ubhayathāpi pauruṣeyatvāt, dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthatvenopadeśajñānasyāpi pauruṣeyatvāt, jñānato vacanataśca puruṣādhīnatvāditi vā; yathā tvamatīndriyeṣvartheṣu pūrvavijñānakāraṇābhāvaṃ manyase puruṣasya puruṣajñānavacanānāṃ tadviṣayāṇāṃ cāprāmāṇyaṃ rāgādiyogāttathā sarvopadeśasyopadeṣṭṛjñānasya śrotṛjñānavacanayośca jñānatvavacanatvābhyāṃ pauruṣeyatvānativṛtterbhāratarāmāyaṇādivadaprāmāṇyam
agnihotrādyupadeśasyātīndriyārthasya prāmāṇyavat sāṅkhyādyatīndriyārthopadeśaprāmāṇyaṃ vā
vānaramūlikādiparijñānavat kasyacit kiñcidviṣayaṃ tattvajñānaṃ syāt, na tu sarvauṣadhādiviṣayaikapuruṣajñānam, ato vaidyakādiṣvapi pūrvajñānakāraṇābhāvaḥ
tadviṣayaikapuruṣavijñānavadatīndriyendriyagrāhyasarvapadārthaviṣayaikapuruṣavijñānābhyupagamo vāvaśyambhāvī, kiṃ kāraṇam ? vedavacanayoranyathānupapatteḥ, puruṣamantareṇa vedanaṃ vedo jñānamityarthaḥ tena ca jñātasya vacanaṃ parapratyāyanaṃ tadubhayaṃ pratyayanaṃ pratyāyanaṃ ca nopapadyate, tayoḥ puruṣasamavāyitvāt
uktaṃ ca— rūpaṃ nibandhaḥ sambandhaḥ prāmāṇyaṃ pratyayaḥ kriyā
śabdasya puruṣādhīnā jñānaṃ cānanyadātmanaḥ iti
vacanayoranyathānupapatteḥ
upadeśāprasiddhirapi caivaṃ bhavataḥ, sarvasyopadeśasya sāṅkhyādyupadeśavallokatattvānveṣaṇādṛte sambhavābhāvāt
tasyāpi tvanavasthāne auṣadhopadeśājñānavadagnihotrādyupadeśājñānam, tajjñānavat tadapi vā pramāṇāntaragamyamiti
evaṃ tāvat kriyopadeśamabhyupagamya doṣa uktaḥ
॰darśanāṃ śūnyatvātya॰
atra svargāpūrvakarmasambandhajñāne vandhyāyā dauhitrasmaraṇavat pūrvavijñānakāraṇābhāvāt upadeśādeva tajjñānayogaḥ ityarthamabhipretya saṅgamanīyo'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ
anyathā pūrvavijñānakāraṇābhāvo vandhyāyā dauhitrasmaraṇavat iti pāṭhaḥ syāt
dharmasya śabdamūlatvādaśabdamanapekṣyaṃ syāt

upadeśāprasiddhirapi caivaṃ bhavataḥ, sarvasyopadeśasya sāṅkhyādyupadeśavallokatattvānveṣaṇādṛte sambhavābhāvāt
tasyāpi tvanavasthāne
anabhyupagamyāpi upadeśāprasiddhirapi caivaṃ bhavataḥ, tvanmatenaiveti vākyaśeṣaḥ, sarvasyopadeśasya sāṅkhyādyupadeśavallokatattvānveṣaṇādṛte sambhavābhāvāt, upadeśo vyākhyā, asau ca vyākhyā padaviṣayā vākyaviṣayā pramāṇaviṣayā tadviṣayavastuviṣayā vā vedavyākaraṇasāṅkhyādiśāstravikalpitā yathāsvaṃ prakriyābhiḥ
tatra yathā sāṅkhyādiprakriyābhirvastutattvaṃ ghaṭāderlokatattvānveṣaṇaparayā vyākhyayā vinā nādhigamyate'tastathā vyākhyāyate evamagnihotrādi saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhavyutpādanena vyākhyāyate, prakṛtipratyayādivibhāgena padaviṣayaṃ vākyaviṣayaṃ pramāṇaviṣayaṃ ca pratyakṣānumānāgamabādhābhyuccayavikalpāṅgāṅgibhāvavikalpādi lokatattvānveṣaṇamantareṇa nādhigantuṃ śakyamityupadeśastattvānveṣaṇaparaḥ sarvaḥ pravartate
tatra yathā sāṅkhyādyupadiṣṭārtheṣvaśakyaprāptirupadeśānarthakyaṃ ca tathā vedavyākaraṇamīmāṃsādyupadeśānāmapītyupadeśāprasiddhiḥ
atha lokatattvānveṣaṇaparāṇāṃ teṣāmupadeśānāṃ śakyaprāptyarthopadeśasāphalye śakyete, kaḥ parābhyupagame pradveṣaḥ ? ihāpi ca yathā lokata eva pratyakṣānumānagamyaghaṭapaṭāditattvaparicchedaḥ śakyate kartumevaṃ padavākyapramāṇaparicchedo'pi śakyaḥ, ghaṭādipadācchabdārthapratyayaviṣayasya lokata eva varṇānupūrvyādiniyatavācyavācakapratyayāvyabhicārasya prasiddheḥ
evaṃ vākye pramāṇe ca yojyam
uktaṃ ca— pramāṇāni pravartante prameyaiḥ sarvavādinām
saṃjñābhiprāyabhedāttu vivadante tapasvinaḥ
siddha॰ dvā॰ 20
4 iti

ato dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthakriyopadeśe padavākyapramāṇaviṣayaviṣayavyākhyāvaiyarthyaprasaṅgānna vedaśāstropadeśasiddhirlokatattvānveṣaṇaparatvānativṛtteḥ, tarkaśāstravācyalokatattvavicāravijñānasāphalyaṃ vā

etadapi na, vaiṣamyāt
kālatastāvanna hi sa chedanakriyākāla eva yūpaḥ, chedanādibhiḥ saṃskṛtaḥ san bhaviṣyati yūpaḥ, tasya tadā yūpatvenāsato yuktaṃ yūpasvarūpaṃ kālāntarabhāvyupekṣituṃ na punaragnihotrasya tadaiva sataḥ
nanu tacchabdatā tādarthyāt, yathendrārthā sthūṇā indraḥ
chedanasya saṃskāratā na vihitā syāt, yūpasya nirvṛttatvāt
asatyāṃ ca saṃskāratāyāṃ chidiravivakṣitārthaḥ kartavyatābhirnirūpaṇam, śailī svabhāvaḥ, śailyā dṛṣṭayā vidhitvādasyāpi vidhereṣā śailī ityanumānāt siddhirbhavati
kasya punarvidhervidhyantaravidhānaśailyā siddhirdṛṣṭā ? yathā yūpaṃ chinattītyādi yāvat pālāśamaṣṭāśrimityādīti śailyanumāne dṛṣṭāntamāha
yathātra pūrvamavivakṣitaniścayāvadhāraṇātmikā kartavyatā coditā paścāt aṣṭāśriṃ pālāśaṃ bailvaṃ vā ityādītikartavyatācodanayā svarūpe vyavasthāpyate tathehāpi
ācārya āha --etadapi na, vaiṣamyāt, dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayoḥ śailīvaiṣamyāt
tadvaiṣamyaṃ kālataḥ prasiddhito'vadhāraṇataśca
tatra kālatastāvanna hi sa cchedanakriyākāla eva yūpaḥ, bhavatīti vākyaśeṣaḥ, chedanādyānarthakyaprasaṅgāt
kiṃ tarhi ? chedanādikriyābhiḥ saṃskṛtaḥ san bhaviṣyati yūpaḥ
itthaṃsvarūpasya tasya kāṣṭhasya tadā yūpatvenāsato yuktaṃ yūpasvarūpaṃ kālāntare bhāvyupekṣitum, na punaragnihotrasya tadaiva sataḥ saṃskāranirapekṣasya kālāntarābhāvyarthopekṣaṇamiti vaiṣamyam

dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 142 paṃ॰ 1
kiñcānyat, kāraṇamātratve sati kartavyatā pratītikartavyataṃ parisamāptā vā syāt, aparisamāptā vā ? tatra tāvad yadi pratyekamitikartavyatāsu kartavyatā parisamāptā tataḥ pratītikartavyataṃ ca kartavyatāsamāpteritikartavyatāntarānārambhaḥ, ekayā ghṛtena juhuyāt ityanayaiva itikartavyatayā tanmātraparisamāptāyāḥ kartavyatāyāḥ kṛtatvāt payasā dadhnā ityādīnāmitikartavyatāntarāṇāmārambho nirarthakaḥ prāptaḥ
anārambha eva vā tasyā api kāraṇamātratvāt itikartavyataiva kartavyatā iti tvayaivābhyupagatatvāt nyāyataśca ghṛtādikāraṇadravyamātratvasya kriyāyāḥ pratipāditatvāt siddhaudanapacanavadanārambha eva prāptaḥ

॰ghātāprokta॰ vi॰ vinā
॰ghātaḥ prokta॰ vi॰
cetivi॰raṃ॰hī॰
ata eva yatnena mahatā pratipādanārthaṃ na kriyāyāṃ khedaḥ kartavyo bhavati
ajñānapratibaddhaikānte'pi ca svavacanavirodhaḥ
pramāṇavirodhastu prastuta eva
jñāpakatvādviśeṣavirodhaḥ
aprayogaprasaṅgāt svarūpavirodhaḥ
ataḥ pūrvoditadoṣāsambandhenedaṃ pratipattavyam--ātmaiva sāmānyaṃ svāvasthā-
ata evetyādi yāvat khedaḥ kartavyo bhavati
yat tvayā vyākhyānamanuṣṭhitam itikartavyataiva kartavyatā iti yatnena mahatā pūrvottaracodyaparihārapakṣāvyavacchedavatā pratipādanārthaṃ na kriyāyāṃ kriyāvyākhyānārthaḥ khedaḥ kartavyaḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? sāmānyādivastuvicārakhedasyāvyavasthitaparamārthatvāt sarvasya kriyāyā evopadeśo nyāyya ityasyābhyupagamasyoparodhāt
evaṃ tāvajjñānapūrvakakriyopadeśapakṣe svavacanavirodha uktaḥ
yasminnapi agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityādikriyopadeśopajīvanaṃ nāsti ajñānapratibaddhameva sarvam ityekāntastasminnajñānapratibaddhaikānte'pi cājñānapratibaddhatve svavacanasya virodhaḥ, asat kāryam iti jñātvoktaṃ cenna tarhi sarvamajñānapratibaddhamevāsya jñānaprasiddhatvāt
athājñātvā kathaṃ pratipādakaṃ sādhakaṃ ca ? iti svavacanavirodhaḥ
tvayāpi etadevam iti niścityābhyupagamyoktatvādajñānapratibaddhābhyupagamasya ca tena virodhāt evam ityavagamādabhyupagamavirodhaḥ kṛtaḥ
loke jñānavyavahārāt tadvirodhaḥ, jñānapūrvako hi lokavyavahāraḥ, tatastasyājñānapratibandhābhyupagamāpratīterlokarūḍhivirodhaḥ
pramāṇavirodhastu prastuta eveti, pratyakṣavirodhastāvat tathā loke dṛṣṭatvāt, kriyayābhivyajyamānasya ghaṭādeḥ kāryasya dīpeneva sata upalabdheranumānavirodhaḥ
jñāpakatvād viśeṣavirodha iti, asya asat kāryam iti jñāpakavākyasya jñāpakatvaviśeṣeṣṭeḥ pratyakṣasvavacanādivirodheṣu dharmaviśeṣaviparyayasiddherviśeṣavirodhaḥ

deśabhedapratyayena tāvad grīvādibhedabhāve ghaṭabhavanaṃ na

aśmādibhedānna pṛthivī

dravyādibhedānnaikaṃ sattvam
kālabhedapratyayenāpi pratikṣaṇamavyapadeśyabhavanāt katarad ghaṭabhavanam, mṛdbhūtavrīhyādyambvādikālabhinnabhāvabhede mṛdabhāvāt parato'pi kapālādipāṃśuvrīhyādibhūteḥ
ghaṭādisarvātmakasyaikasya sattvasyābhāvāt pratyekatvasya cetaretarāsattvātmakatvāt kuto bhavanaṃ bhaviturghaṭādeḥ ?
yathā tu rūpādibhedena sarvabhedaparyantaṃ bhedaṃ vidhāya vijñānamātrameva vyavasthāpyate
tat katham ? deśabhedapratyayena tāvadityādi, grīvāpṛṣṭhakukṣibudhnauṣṭhādīnāṃ deśabhinnānāṃ kapālaśakalādīnāṃ ca yāvat paramāṇuśo rūpādiśo nirupākhyatvaśaśca bhedabhāve ghaṭabhavanaṃ na, sidhyatīti vartate
evaṃ na śvetikāpītikādyekadeśabhāve mṛt
aśmādibhedānna pṛthivī
pṛthivyaptejovāyvādibhedānna dravyaṃ guṇakarmabhedādveti, tadeva hi dravyaṃ rūpagamanādiguṇakarmabhedād yāvannirupākhyatvabhedāt samudāyābhāvāccāsambandhānna dravyam
dravyādibhedād dravyaguṇakarmanānātvād naikaṃ sattvam
evaṃ tāvad deśabhede ghaṭabhavanaṃ na syāt, dravyādīnāmanupapatteḥ
॰ccasaṃbaṃdhādravyam pra॰
kālabhedapratyayenāpi pratikṣaṇamavyapadeśyabhavanāt katarad ghaṭabhavanaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe'tyantamasambaddhāyaḥśalākākalparūpādyātmakatvānupapatteḥ ? kiṃ kāraṇam ? mṛdbhūtavrīhyādyambvādikālabhinnabhāvabhede mṛdabhāvāt, asmanmatena mṛdbhūto vrīhyādirambvādiścaika eva kālāntarāvasthāne sati tatpariṇāmopapatteḥ, tvanmatena tu kālabhinnabhāvabhede kṣaṇe kṣaṇe navanavārthāsambandhād bhāvabhede vrīhireva vinaṣṭo mṛnna bhavati, na codakādi vinaṣṭaṃ mṛd bhavatīti nirbījatvānmṛdabhāvaḥ

natthiya॰
sa tathetyādi
sa eva kālastathābhūtena vartanārūpeṇa kalanārthena samādhikaraṇena tāṃ vartanāmeva sāmānyamabhinnāmatyajan bhūto bhavati bhaviṣyaṃśca iti viśeṣavyapadeśaṃ labhate, nānyaḥ kaścidakalanātmakaḥ padārtho niyatyādirasattvāt
sa eva tu kalanalakṣaṇo bhāvastridhā bhidyate tatsamādhikaraṇatvāt sattvātmakatvād ghaṭavat, na vyadhikaraṇo bhūto bhavati bhaviṣyaṃścākāla eva vyadhikaraṇo'tadrūpa eva
śceti viśeṣavyapadeśaṃ labhate
sa eva tu tridhā bhidyate, anyathānyasyābhāvāt
sa eva tathā kalayan vartanena kalayati, sa eva kalyate, tena tasmaitena ca tasmai cetyādi
evameva ca sa vartamānātītayoḥ kāraṇāvasthayoreva kāryākhyābhimukhyena gṛhyate ekatra meghādirekatra paṭādiḥpaṭādirekatra meghādiḥ
grahaṇavacca sa eva kriyate tathā vṛtteḥ kriyayā kalyate
kiṃ kāraṇam ? anyathānyasyābhāvāt, iha hyanyadanyathā na bhavati, yathā kusumaṃ khapuṣpaṃ na bhavati khapuṣpaṃ vā kusumaṃ na bhavati, ghaṭo vā paṭatayā na bhavati ghaṭatayā paṭo vā na bhavati
kiṃ tarhi ? tadeva tad bhavati, kusumameva kusumam, tadeva cānyathāpi bhavati yathā kusumameva mukulitārdhavikasitasamastavikasitajarattāmlānāditvādinā
evaṃ tāvat kāla eva bhāva ityabhedena bhavanaṃ vyākhyātam
kāraṇabhedenāpi sa eva tathā kalayan vartanena kalayatīti kalanasya kartṛtvamanubhavatīti kalanaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ
sa eva kalyate kriyate karma bhavatītyarthaḥ pūrvāparatayā kāryakāraṇabhāvāt
tena ca tasmai cetyādi tasyaiva kalanasya śaktibhedāt, tena kriyata iti karaṇatā, tasmai kriyata iti sampradānatā
ādigrahaṇāt tasmāt tasminniti apādānādhikaraṇabhāvāvapi

॰ṇabhāvapi pra॰
tasyaivedānīṃ kālasya tridhā bhinnasyāpyabhedopadarśanārthaṃ jñānena kriyayā caikyamucyate --evameva cetyādi jñānena tāvadekatvaṃ dṛśyate yāvadekatra meghādiriti
evameveti yathaiva kartṛkarmakaraṇādiśaktibhede'pyabhinnaḥ kālastathā sa vartamānātītayoḥ kāraṇāvasthayoreva saptamyanto'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ kāryākhyābhi- mukhyena gṛhyate kāryāṅgīkaraṇena tatprādhānyena tādātmyeneti yāvat, vartamānāvasthāyāṃ kāryākhyābhimukhyena atītāvasthāyāṃ cottarāvasthābhimukhyena sa eva kālo gṛhyate, kimuktaṃ bhavati ? kalyate jñāyate
yathāsaṅkhyamekatra paṭādirekatra meghādiḥ, vartamāne paṭādiratīte meghādiḥ

meghe connatamātre varṣati ayaṃvarṣatyayam, tataḥ pralahībījamutpadyate, mūlāṅkurādi bhavati, tataḥ pralahīpoṇḍam, tataḥ karpāsaḥ, tataḥ sūtram, tataḥ paṭaḥ ityatītakāla eva eṣyatkālaṃ paṭaṃ manyate ityataḥ kāryākhyābhimukhyena sa eva kālo'tīto vartamānaścābhedena gṛhyamāṇo dṛṣṭastasmādabhinnaḥ
evaṃ jñānenaikyamāpādya kriyayāpyaikyamāpādayati atideśena --grahaṇavacca sa eva kriyate
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tathā vṛtteḥ, evaṃ hi vartanam, saiva hi kriyā yathā gṛhyate tathā kriyate'pyasāvevābhedeneti tatkārakārthaṃ darśayati --kriyayā kalyata iti
evaṃ tāvadatītavartamānayoḥ kāraṇayoḥ kāryākhyābhimukhyena grahaṇakaraṇābhyāmaikyam, ākhyāśabdaḥākhyā śabdaḥ śabdamātreṇaiva bhedāt
tayorapyanāgate, tayoḥ kāraṇayorapyanāgate kārye'tītavartamānayoḥ kāraṇākhyābhimukhyena tayorapyanāgate kāraṇākhyābhimukhyena kalyamānatā dṛśyate saṃyogatantvādyudakagarbhasarjanapācanādivartanapaṭatvavat
ata eva ca kalanameva hyekaṃ kāryakāraṇavṛttitvena viparivartituṃ kṣamamapuruṣakāramasvabhāvamaniyati saṃsāri anādi
kālavṛttereva puruṣavādyuktamuktikramārthaturīyavacanādeva kālasāmarthyāt kramātmalābho ghaṭate
mithyādarśanādibhistatpradoṣanihnavādibhiśca karmabandhaprakriyopapatteḥ saṃsārānāditā santānāvyavacchedādyujyate

bandhābhāvaḥ kāryākhyābhimukhyakāraṇaikyavad grahaṇakaraṇayoḥ samānā kalyamānatā dṛśyate, tato'pyaikyameva
tadyathā— saṃyogatantvādyudakagarbhasarjanapācanādivartanapaṭatvavat, yathā tantūnāṃ saṃyogaṃ dṛṣṭvā rutakarpāsapralahīpoṇḍapralahīmūlāṅkurādijalasarjanapācanadhāraṇameghakalanāni vṛttāni tathā ca kriyanta iti tānyeva vartanāni paṭa ityeṣyatpaṭa eva tathā tantuvāyasya grahaṇakaraṇābhyāṃ pravṛttatvād vartamānātītapaṭatā dṛṣṭā ityaikyameva

etasmādeva kāraṇād vartanasyāpratīghātād vyāpitvācca kāraṇāntarāpekṣā nāsti, kalanameva hyekamananyasādhanaṃ svayameva kāryakāraṇavṛttitvena viparivartituṃ kṣamam, apuruṣakāraṃ cetanācetaneṣu vṛtterabhedāt, asvabhāvaṃ jīvājīvātmakapariṇatikramavivṛttyajasratvāt, aniyati tathānyathābhāvaviparivartavartanātmakatvādeva, saṃsāri rūpadvyaṇukatryaṇukādibhūmyambuvrīhyādyāhārarasarudhirādiviparivartanasvabhāvāntarasaṅkramaṇalakṣaṇatvāt saṃsārasya, ata evānādi, anāditvena dūramapakṣiptā niyatyādikāraṇāntarāpekṣā anena kalanena

anyathā avasthācatuṣṭayasya ekasarvagatanityākramakāraṇātmakasya katamāvasthā prathamā dvitīyā tṛtīyā turīyā ceti ? kiñcānyat, vṛttikramāpāditakāryakāraṇāvasthayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvopapattermithyādarśanādibhiḥ sāmānyahetubhiḥ tatpradoṣanihnavādibhiśca viśeṣahetubhiḥ karmabandhaprakriyopapatteḥ saṃsārānāditā santānāvyavacche kāraṇābhāvādaśarīratvādakaraṇatvācca

...saṃsārānāditā
nāpi tasya niyateḥ saṃsārānāditā, atattvāt
yad yadatat tat tanna tanniyati dṛṣṭam, ghaṭapaṭavat
evameva tasya svabhāvāt
tasmāttvanādivartanātmakatvāt kālasya pṛthivyādivrīhyādivṛttivivṛttiprabandha-
karaṇā॰bhā॰
bhāvāya॰
atrāha niyativādī--tasya saṃsārasyaiva tathāniyateḥ saṃsāro bhavati puruṣapudgalayoriti
atra brūmaḥ --nāpi tasya niyateḥ saṃsārānāditā, kasmāddhetoḥ ? atattvāt, tadbhāvastattvam, na tattvamatattvam, tasmādatattvāt tanniyaterna bhavati saṃsāraḥ, atattvaṃ cāsya saṃsārasya kvaciduparamābhyupagamāt, svahetoḥ sādhyāvinābhāvitvopapradarśanārthamāha --yad yadatat tat tanna tanniyati dṛṣṭam, yathā ghaṭaḥ paṭaniyatirna bhavati paṭo'pi ghaṭaniyatirna bhavati, tasmād ghaṭapaṭavadatattvānnāpi tasya niyateriti sādhūktam
kiñcānyat, evameva tasya svabhāvāt
yadi brūyāt--tasya svabhāvāt saṃsārānāditeti, etacca nāpi tasya svabhāvāt, atattvāt
atattvamasya pūrvavad muktyavasthābhyupagamāt siddham
yadyadatat tat tanna tatsvabhāvaṃ ghaṭapaṭavaditi
evaṃ tāvadanādisaṃsāritā nopapadyate niyatyādivāde kālamantareṇetyuktam
॰yatirna pra॰
cāsya na bhavati saṃsārasya pra॰
idānīṃ kālavāde tadupapattirupavarṇyate --tasmāt tvanādivartanātmakatvādityādi yāvanna na yujyata iti
tasmāditi prastutāt kālāt saṃsārānāditā na na yujyata iti sambhantsyate
tuśabdo viśeṣaṇe, kālavāda evaitadupapadyate'nādisaṃsāritvam, yaugapadyaparyāyatvādanāditvasya yaugapadyasya ca kālaprabhāvāvinābhāvitvāt kalanavṛttiparyāyatvācca kālasyeti tatpradarśanārthaṃ hetumāha --anādivartanātmakatvāt kālasya, kālo hi yugapadanādivṛttyātmakaḥ
nanvidaṃ prāguktena viruddhaṃ pūrvaparāpūrvāparādivṛtterayaugapadyāditi cet, na, vartanasya yaugapadyāt, tadyathā --pṛthivyādivrīhyādivṛttītyādirdṛṣṭāntadaṇḍakaḥ
yathā pṛthivya svātmaviṣayakriyābandhasaṃsaraṇavajjīvapudgalayorabhinnavartanasvatattvayoḥ svata eva bandhakriyā saṃsārakriyā ca vartanābhedena rūpabhedena ca kālasyātmasvātmanyeva kriyā anātmasvātmani vā yugapadeva bandhasaṃsaraṇavihitā bandhasaṃsārānāditā na na yujyate
ityanādivartanāprabhedapūrvāparādikramād bhāvāntarāṇi krameṇa prāptāni bhūmyambvādiyogo bījodbhedo mūlamaṅkuraḥ...

...kuṇḍakatandulaudanaḥ
jīvapudgalavṛttiparivṛttibhedena vartanaiva ārambhapravṛttiniṣṭhāḥ
tadeva hi vartanaṃ parivṛttyaparivṛttiṣu
mbuvāyvākāśapuruṣādayo yugapat sametā lokākhyāṃ labhamānā anādayaḥ, ta eva ca vrīhiyavagodhūmacūtapanasāditvena strīpuruṣamahiṣājagavayagavāditvena ca vartante sahaiva, bhūmyādivrīhyāditvena tādṛśyorvṛttivivṛttyoravyavacchedena sva evātmā viṣayo'syāḥ kriyāyāḥ sā teṣāṃ vrīhyādibhūmyādīnāṃ vṛttivivṛttiprabandhena ātmasvarūpaviṣayā kriyā, saiva ca bandhaḥ snigdharūkṣavṛttyā teṣāṃ saṃśleṣāt, anyānyarūpāpattiḥ saṃsaraṇam, tacca anādi yugapadubhayaṃ bandhanaṃ saṃsaraṇaṃ dṛṣṭam, tathā jīvapudgalayorabhinnavartanasvatattvayoḥ svasādhyebhya eva sādhanātmabhyaḥ hetukāryabhūtebhyaḥ kāraṇebhyaḥ parasparasaṃśleṣavartanebhya iva bhūmyādivrīhyādīnāṃ hetubhyaḥ svata eva bandhakriyā saṃsārakriyā ca vartanābhedena rūpabhedena ceti dṛṣṭāntaprasiddhārthavyākhyānam
dārṣṭāntikavyākhyānaṃ tu kālasyātmasvātmanyeva kriyā anātmasvātmani veti, kālasya abhinnavartanasvatattvasya bhūmyādivrīhyādibandhasaṃsaraṇavadeva ātmasvātmani jīvasvarūpe kriyā anātmasvātmani pudgalasvarūpe vā yugapadeva bandhasaṃsaraṇavihitā kālakṛtabandhasaṃsāravihitā tatkṛtā vidhāturanyasyābhāvāt, saiṣā saṃsāritā yugapadabhinnānādivṛttyātmikā jīvapudgalayoḥ parasparaṃ svātmaparātmavṛttikṛtabandhasaṃsārānāditā na na yujyate virodhābhāvādityabhiprāyaḥ
evaṃ tāvad yaugapadyaliṅgakālakṛtasaṃsārānāditā

kasmāt ? tvayaivābhyupagatatvāt, atisannikṛṣṭamativiprakṛṣṭaṃ vyavahitaṃ vā cakṣurindriyaṃ rūpamañjanamandarādi na gṛhṇātyatyantam ityatra kena tvayā etat kāraṇena pratipannam ? iti pṛṣṭenāvaśyaṃ svabhāvāditi vaktavyam, ayaṃ hi cakṣuṣaḥ svabhāvo yadatisannikṛṣṭamañjanādi na paśyati ativiprakṛṣṭaṃ vā mervādīti śeṣendriyāṇāmapi svabhāvādevātiviprakṛṣṭādyagrahaṇaṃ svaviṣayaniyamaśceti

atrāha--yannātidūre tat kasmānnopalabhyate ? atrocyate--sāmīpyāt, yadā devadatta ātmacakṣuḥsthamañjanaṃ nopalabhate kiṃ tannāsti ? atrāha--yannātidūre nātisāmīpye tat kathaṃ nopalabhyate ? atrocyate--indriyaghātāt, yathā badhiraḥ śabdaṃ na śṛṇoti andho rūpaṃ na paśyati, kiṃ te śabdarūpe na staḥ ? atrāha--yasya anupahatamindriyaṃ sa kasmānnopalabhata iti ? atrāha--mano'navasthānāt, anavasthitamanā hastinaṃ parikrāmantaṃ na paśyati, asti cāsau, vaktāro bhavanti--vyagramanasā nāvadhāritamiti
yasyāvyagraṃ manaḥ...sa kasmānnopalabhate ? atrocyate--saukṣmyāt, dhūmoṣṇanīhārā ākāśagatā nopalabhyante, kiṃ te na santīti ? atrāha--ye nātisūkṣmāste kasmānnopalabhyante ? atrocyate--vyavadhānāt, kuḍyena ghaṭādayo vyavahitāḥ
ye cāvyavahitāḥ te kasmānnopalabhyante ? abhibhavāt, yathā ādityaprakāśena grahanakṣatracandratārāṇāṃ prakāśā abhibhūtatvād nopalabhyante, kiṃ te na santīti ? atrāha--ye nābhibhūtāste kasmānnopalabhyanta iti ? atrāha— samānābhihārācca, samānāḥ sadṛśā ityarthaḥ, teṣāṃ samabhihāro rāśiḥ, tasmāt...
...evaṃ satāmarthānāṃ aṣṭavidhānupalabdhiḥ

kiñcānyat, yathaitat tathā kiñcidatyantānupalabdhisvabhāvameva bhavati ātmādi, ātmākāśa- kāladigādayaḥ kāryata eva nityamanumeyāḥ padārthāḥ saukṣmyād bāhyendriyāviṣayāstatsvabhāvāḥ

tasmād yaducyate tvayā kriyāto ghaṭādi nirvartata iti tanna puruṣa-kāma-cāra-prayatnādibhyaḥ kiñcidapi nirvartate, puruṣāt tadicchātastatpravṛttestatprayatnād vīryādityarthaḥ

anyathotpādavināśavipariṇāmebhyo ghaṭārthaṃ pravṛtteṣu tatpaṭa utpadyate tadvināśārthaṃ pravṛtteṣvavināśo vipariṇāmārthaṃ pravṛtteṣvavipariṇāmaśca
ataḥ śāstrārthavattvāya varamidameva kāraṇaṃ sva eva bhāvaḥ
evaṃ cetyādi
evaṃ ca kṛtvā lokaprasiddhivaśād yadi hetuto yadyahetuto yathāsaṅkhyaṃ ghaṭakaṇṭakādi buddhyabuddhipūrvanirvṛttābhimataṃ yadastu tadastu ubhayathāpi svabhāvānativṛttiḥ
evametadātmabhavanamanādipravṛttaṃ kāraṇaṃ jagataḥ, pṛthivyabbījāṅkurādiṣu sthiradravādisvabhāvāvirbhāvatirobhāvādirūpeṇa ekaṃ nityaṃ ca notpadyate na vinaśyati na cānyathā bhavatīti pratipattavyam, utpādavināśavipariṇāmānāmanādipravṛttasvabhāvakāraṇavirodhitvāt
evaṃ ca tatrānādipravṛttasvabhāvetyādi yāvad vipariṇāmo veti pūrvapakṣa uttānārthaḥ
uttarapakṣastu tato'nādipravṛttakāraṇasvabhāvavyatyāse iti pratyuccāraṇam, ātmabhavanaviparyaye doṣaḥ, hitāhitaprāptiparihārārthaśāstravyarthatā, dharmārthakāmamokṣaphalaprāptyupāyavidhānārthāni tadapāyaparihārārthāni ca śāstrāṇi vyarthāni syuḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? puruṣasya kriyāyāḥ phalasya ca tathā'svabhāvatvāt, kartṛkaraṇakarmādisādhanānāṃ tadaṅgasampannāyāḥ kriyāyā dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāmanyatamasya tatphalasya cānyonyānurūpeṇa anātmatvādityarthaḥ
parasparānurūpānabhyupagame'nyathotpādo'nyathā vināśo'nyathā vipariṇāmaścānanurūpeṇeti yāvat
tato'nyathotpādavināśavipariṇāmebhya iti puruṣādisādhanakriyāphalānāṃ tathā'nātmatvaṃ samarthayati, ghaṭārthaṃ pravṛtteṣu ghaṭotpattyarthaṃ pravṛtteṣu tatpaṭa utpadyate tadvināśārthaṃ pravṛtteṣvavināśo vipariṇāmārthaṃ pravṛtteṣvavipariṇāmaśceti, svabhāvāniyamānnotpādavināśavipariṇāmāḥ santi, yadi syurayathābhipretāḥ syuḥ svabhāvāniyamāditi svabhāvāparigrahe śāstrāṇāmarthavattā na yujyate
atastasmāt siddhaśāstrāṇāmanatiśaṅkyatvādaniṣṭatvāccānarthakyasya śāstrārthavattvasiddhyarthaṃ ca ghaṭādeḥ kāraṇamanveṣaṇīyam, tacca kāraṇamanviṣyamāṇaṃ śāstrārthavattvāya varamidameva kāraṇaṃ svabhāvaḥ, nāto'nyad vimardaramaṇīyataramasti
kuto'nyannāsti ? yattatkāraṇaṃ sva eva ātmīya eva ātmaiva vā bhāvaḥ, katamo'sau ? saṅgraheṇa dvidhā prativastu jīvājīvavadavasthitaḥ, yo'sti sa bhāvaḥ ya ātmā sa bhāvaḥ svabhāvaḥ

so'nubhavati kṛtvā phalamanubhavati karmaphalaṃ bhuṅkte
so'nubhūyate svabhāvabhedenātmanaiva bhujyate'pi
sa eva kathamanubhavati anubhūyate ca ? iti tadarthapradarśanārthamāha --svadravyetyādi
svayameva dravyāṇi ātmaiva karmakarmitvasvabhāvāni dravyāṇi saṃyujyante viyujyante ca, teṣāmeva svabhāvabhedānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ saṃyogavibhāgau bandhamokṣau deśasarvavikalpau, tadvikalpavicitrasukhaduḥkhajanmamaraṇavaiṣamye, tayoḥ svābhāvyena sa eva bhavatīti saṃsāramokṣau svabhāvataḥ, yathā vrīhireva aṅkuratvādyanubhavanātmānubhavati anubhūyate ca
anyonyasaṃyogaviyogaviparivartena karmakarmisvābhāvyena viparivartamāno'pi svabhāvātmā vyādheḥ sādhyāsādhyadvaitarūpavat svajātyaparityāgādadvaitatvād vyavasthita eva sarvatra bhavyābhavyajīvarāśyoḥ
ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? yathā kanakāśmani suvarṇaṃ dvidhāvirbhavat kriyā-'kriyābhyāṃ tatsvabhāvaḥ, kvacinnāstyeva kanakamiti so'pi svabhāvaḥ, tathā keṣāñcit svayamevāpagamādātmaviśuddhyāvirbhāvaḥ antareṇāpi dhātuvādaṃ kanakāvirbhāvastathā karmavivekasvābhāvyādeva bhavyajīvānāmātmāvirbhāvaḥ, samyagdarśanajñānapūrvikayā tu kriyayā prācuryeṇa kaivalyaprāptirdhātuvādakriyayeva kanakotpattiḥ, keṣāñcidanāvirbhāva eva karmāvivekasvābhāvyāt
evaṃ ca tadubhayasvabhāvavarṇanādabhavyajīvakarmaṇoḥ...

yadi heturanyo mṛgyeta tenānantyamasyāpi syāt, anāditvāt, ākāśavat
tadantavattve vākāśamapi sāntaṃ syāt, anāditvāt, bhavyakarmavat
athāpyasyānāditve'heturanto bhavati tathā ādiḥ siddhakarmasantānasya kasmānna bhavati ? iti svabhāva eva śaraṇaṃ tadupāyasvabhāvo mokṣa iti
evaṃ sarvacodyeṣu
abhavyajīvakarmaṇoranādisantānasyāvyavacchedaḥ svabhāvādeva
bhavyasya tu viśuddhisvabhāvādeva anādikarmasantānasya vyavacchedaḥ ityāśayakamatra kimapi mūlaṃ syāditi sambhāvyate
evaṃ ca tadityādi
evaṃ ca kṛtvā svabhāvanayabalena āmnātā jīvā dvividhāḥ--bhavasiddhikāśca abhavasiddhikāśceti tadubhayasvabhāvavarṇanāt abhavyajīvakarmaṇorityādi bhavyasya tu viśuddhītyādi ca gatārthaṃ vākyadvayam
anāderjīvakarmasantānasya vyavacchedāvyavacchedau svabhāvādeveti nātra kaścid bhavyakarmasantānasāntatāyāmabhavyakarmasantānānantatāyāṃ vā hetuḥ śakyo vaktumanyaḥ svabhāvāt
yadi heturanyo mṛgyeta tena ānantyamasyāpi syāt, kasya ? bhavyakarmasantānasyāpyanantatvaṃ syāt
kasmāt ? anāditvādākāśavat, svabhāvamanicchadbhiranāditvaheturabhyupagantavyo jāyate so'niṣṭānantatvasādhanāya bhavati
adhunā'nāditvahetusadbhāve'pi tatsāntateṣṭāvākāśasāntatetyata āha --tadantavattve vākāśamapi sāntaṃ syādanāditvād bhavyakarmavaditi svabhāva evāntavattve kāraṇam, na heturanyo'sti hetuvādena vimṛgyamāṇaḥ
athāpyasya bhavyasaṃsārasyānāditve sati aheturanto bhavati nirhetukahetuko'nta iṣyate tato yathā cāsyānāditve saṃsārasyāheturanto bhavati tathā kasmāt tasya virodhī punarnirhetukahetukāntavattvavad bhavyakarmasantānasya nirhetukahetukādiḥ siddhakarmasantānasya kasmānna bhavati ? iti vācyamatra viśeṣakāraṇamasvabhāvahetuvādinā, mama tu punaḥ svabhāvavādinaḥ svabhāva eva sarvatra kāraṇaṃ vyāpitvāt
itiśabdo hetvarthe, ityataḥ kāraṇāditthaṃ svabhāva eva śaraṇaṃ kāraṇavādinām
kathaṃ kṛtvā ? tadupāyasvabhāvo mokṣa iti samyagdarśanādiratnatrayopāyasampannabhavyakarmasantānātyantocchedasvabhāvo mokṣa iti
evaṃ tāvad bhavyasaṃsārocchittāvabhavyasaṃsārānucchittau ca hetuvāde codite svabhāvāśrayeṇa parihāra uktaḥ
evaṃ svabhāvānabhyupagame tu na sādhanaṃ na dūṣaṇaṃ ca svabhāvāpetāvayavārthavāditvāditi vādahānaṃ te
ayaṃ sarvo'pi yatnaḥ so'nyabhinnasvarūpopādānenaiva svābhimatinirākaraṇāya bhavati
puruṣavāde tāvajjñānamayo na rūpādimayaḥ, rūpādīnāṃ tanmayatvāt

yadi svabhāvo nābhyupagamyate tataḥ sādhanadūṣaṇābhāvastato vādatyāgaḥ, tadyathā--pakṣahetudṛṣṭāntādayaḥ svena bhāvena sampannāḥ sādhanam, pakṣaḥ sādhyatvenepsito yadi viruddhārthānirākṛtaḥ, hetuḥ pakṣadharmaḥ sapakṣe san vipakṣād vyāvṛttaḥ, dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhyānugatahetupradarśanamasati sādhye hetvasattvapradarśanaṃ ca

1 ityādikāraṇavādā bhidyante saṃjñādibhedāt
te punaḥ sarve'pi paramārthadravyārthasya vidhividhinayasya svarūpamaspṛśanta eva pravartante, yasmāt saṅkṣepeṇāyaṃ sarvo'pi yatnaḥ so'nyabhinnasvarūpopādānenaiva svābhimatinirākaraṇāya bhavati, tadyathā--puruṣavādinaḥ puruṣādanyadavastu apuruṣatvād vandhyāputravat tathā niyateranyadaniyatitvād vartanādanyadavartanatvāt svabhāvādanyadasvabhāvatvād vandhyāsutavadavastu iti bruvatāṃ puruṣaniyatikālasvabhāvavādināmātmātmavastuno dravyārthavṛttasya tatparamārthasya tattvānāṃ sarvaikatvanityatvakāraṇamātratvasarvagatatvānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ pratipādanārthamudyatānāṃ vādinām anyadavastu iti svato bhinnānyārthābhyupagamenaiva tatpratipādanaṃ nānyatheti tatpratipādanārtho yatnaḥ so'yamanyabhinnarūpopādānamantareṇa nāstīti sa yatnaḥ svābhimatapuruṣādyarthanirākaraṇāyaiva bhavatyanyabhinnārthābhyupagamāt

tāni ca rūpādīni kāryātmānaḥ, kāryā tmanāṃ tanmayatve kāryatvānekatvānityatvāsarvatvāni puruṣasyaiva prāptāni
avasthāvacca pūrvādiniyatyādiṣvapi

॰rniyatyā॰bhā॰
svabhāvavāde tu,tuśabdo viśeṣaṇe, viśeṣo'sya svamatanirākaraṇadoṣādatiśayaścāyam
kiṃ kāraṇam ? ādāveva bhedopādānāt, itare sṛṣṭipradarśanadvāreṇa dūraṃ gatvā paścād bhedamupādadate, svabhāvavādī punarutthāna eva bhedamupādatta ityayamatiśayaḥ
kuto bhedopādānamiti cet, sambhavavadvyabhicāravṛttyanumatyā bhāvaviśeṣaṇasvaśabdopādānāt
sati sambhave vyabhicāre ca viśeṣaṇam, yathā nīlamutpalamiti nīlatvaṃ cedutpale sambhavati vyabhicarati ca kadācit, raktamapi tad dṛṣṭamutpalaṃ bhramarādiṣu ca nīlatvam, ato viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati nīlaṃ ca tadutpalaṃ ca taditi evaṃ bhedavṛttyanumatyā vinā viśeṣaṇopādānābhāvāt, tathehāpi bhāvaśabdavācyasyārthasya svaśabdābhidheyaviśeṣaṇārthaṃ svaśabdopādānaṃ bhedādhārasambhavavadvyabhicāravṛttyanumatyaiva sahitam, yathā sambhavānumatyā vinā na viśeṣaṇaṃ tathā nāntareṇa vyabhicāramapi viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavati
tatra vyabhicāro virudhyate dravyārthavādasyaikyādityabhiprāyārthaḥ
tathaiva cārthasya nirūpaṇāditi, na kevalaṃ svaśabdopādānamātrādeva bhedo'ṅgīkṛtaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? artho'pi bhūmyādikaṇṭakāditvena tathā nirūpyate uttareṇa granthena bhedaprādhānyenaiva bhāvīkṛtenārtho'pi bhinno viśeṣaṇatvenopādātuṃ yogyaḥ, tadyathā— yadayaṃ bhavatītyādi, tatra svaśabdabhāvaśabdayorarthavyutpattyorbhāvaśabdārthavyutpattistāvad bhāvavādinaḥ svabhāvavādinaścāvayoḥ śabdārthavyutpattirbhāvaśabdasya bhavatīti bhāvo bhūyate'neneti vā bhāva iti tulyā, tasyāṃ ca tulyatāyāṃ na kaścid visaṃvādaḥ
svaśabdo'rtho vā viśeṣaṇatvena pravartamānaścintyaḥ, so'svavyāvarta yo'rthābhāvārthatvādasvābhavane varteta, sa tatropakṣīṇaśaktitvāt svabhavanasya na prayojakaḥ

syānmatam--tasya vyāvartyasyābhāvād vyāvartyatā viśeṣaṇārthavattā ceti, etaccāyuktam, tadbhāvatvaprasaṅgāt, na hyasataḥ prasaṅgo'sti, aprasaktasya ca vyāvartyatā nāsti abrāhmaṇavacane brāhmaṇatvavat, na hyabrāhmaṇavacane brāhmaṇo'prasakto vyāvartyate, yathoktaṃ nañivayuktamanyasadṛśādhikaraṇe tathā hyarthagatiḥ pā॰ vā॰ 3

tasmād yadapi kiñcittvād vastutvādarthatvādibhyaḥ svavat
ayaṃ ca svabhāvaḥ kiṃ vyāpī prativastu parisamāpto vā ? vyāpitve tyaktasvaparaviśeṣaṇaḥ syāt
prativastutve kiṃ tena kalpitenābhinnaphalena lokavādāt
pratyekamātravṛtti ca vastu ghaṭādyeva ghaṭādītītaretarābhāvāt parasparamasvabhavanaparigrahāt kutaḥ kva cāsau svabhāvaḥ syāt ? bhāvaviṣayaikārthe svatve na kiñcidanyat svaṃ nāmeti kimatra bhedena kriyate ghaṭādinā paṭādibhāvaviśiṣṭena ? so'pi yadi bhāva eva ko'yaṃ vyāvartyate tadapi ca bhavedeva vyāvartyatvādabrāhmaṇavat, vaidharmyeṇa nāsat tat, kutaḥ ? asato'prasakta- tvādaprasaktasya cāvyāvartyatvāt khapuṣpavat

dṛṣṭāntaḥ svavaditi, yathā svaṃ vyāvartyād vibhaktatvāt kiñcid vastu arthaḥ prameyaṃ jñeyaṃ sacca tathā vyāvartyamapi sajjñeyaṃ prameyamartho vastu kiñcidvā prasaktatvādeva, tasmād bhavedeva

kiñcānyat, ayaṃ ca svabhāva ityādi
ayaṃ ca tvadiṣṭaḥ svaśabdaviśiṣṭo bhāvaḥ svabhāvaḥ kiṃ vyāpī prativastu parisamāpto vā ? yadi vyāpī sarvagata eka eva tasmin vyāpitve tyaktasvaparaviśeṣaṇaḥ syāt, ekarūpatvāt tasya pararūpābhāvāt svaśabdopādānaṃ paraśabdopādānaṃ ca nirarthakameva
atha vastuni vastuni parisamāptaḥ prativastu tataḥ prativastutve kiṃ tena kalpitenābhinnaphalena lokavādāt ? lokavādo hi ghaṭasya ghaṭatvameva svabhāvo nānyaḥ, paṭasya paṭa eva iti śrūyate, ghaṭādipṛthagbhūto na kaścideka iti
sa yadi tathā prativastu kalpyate na kaścit tena lokavādābhinnaphalenārthaḥ kalpitena

bhedena yaducyate ghaṭa iti paṭādinā bhāvavyāvartanārthaṃ bhedena ghaṭasya bhāvo na paṭasya iti svo bhāvo na parabhāvaḥ iti ca puruṣādivādavad bhedādhāraṃ tena kiṃ kalpitena dravyārthasvarūpavirodhinā bhedādhāreṇeti
so'pi yadīti so'pi ca ghaṭādirbhedo bhāvo vā yadi bhāvaḥ bhavatīti bhāva eva bhāvasvarūpādabhinna bhedo nāma ghaṭādirbhāvavyatiriktaḥ ? atha na bhavati tadastitvameva na
nanu ghaṭasya bhāva iti paṭādivyatirekeṇa ghaṭa eva, na, bhāvasyaiva tathā tathā bhavanāt
na hi hastādau bhavati kurvati vā devadatto na bhavati na karoti vā
ato bhāvatve'bhāvatve vā nāstyeva bhedo ghaṭādiḥ
yaṃ taṃ bhuvo'rthamabhidadhati sarvadhātavaḥ

itiśabdo hetvarthe, upacitāpacitabhavanābhāve dadhighaṭādyavasthānāmādinidhanavibhāgābhāvadarśanāditi hetuḥ, taṃ darśayitumāha --iti na kācidavasthā dadhighaṭādirādinidhanavibhāgavatī, ādiḥ prāgavidyamānasyotpattiḥ, nidhanaṃ vidyamānasya vināśaḥ, vibhāgo'nyatvam, ete cādinidhana- vibhāgā dadhighaṭādyavasthānāṃ na santi pūrvottarotpattivināśavastupravibhāgābhāvasya pratipāditatvāt

dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 207-- 2
evaṃ tāvadapravṛttapravṛttipratiṣedhādanagniprakāśadṛṣṭāntaprasaṅgāgatavādamavatārya pūrvavadudāharaṇe prasaṅgamutthāpayiṣyannāha --pūrvavadudāharaṇādevetyādi yāvanna pravṛttamiti
nanvetat tvayābhyupagataṃ pūrvāvasthodāharaṇādeva pāścāttyāvasthā viśiṣṭā iti
anyathā hi ko viśeṣaḥ pūrvaparāvasthayo rajaḥpravartanādṛte ? tasmāt sa viśeṣo rajaḥpravartanādeva
ko dṛṣṭāntaḥ ? kṣīradadhipariṇāmakālavat, yathā kṣīrāvasthāto dadhitvapariṇāmāvasthā viśiṣṭā, pūrvaṃ kṣīrakāle na dadhyāsīt paścād bhūtamiti dṛṣṭam, prakarṣavṛttyā ca vinā na bhavatyayaṃ viśeṣastathā so'pīti
etanna, pariṇāmasya tatraivoktatvāt, nāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ parataḥ sidhyati, kutaḥ ? pariṇāmasya tatraiva sukhe'bhyupagamyāsmābhiruktatvāt
yasmāt prakāśātmaiva vṛttiḥ, prakāśasya yaḥ svātmā sa eva vṛttiḥ, prakāśasyaiva ca vṛttiḥ kālaḥ, sa ca tato'nanyaḥ, kṣīradadhipariṇāmāvasthayoḥ kālākhyatvāt kṣīradadhitvāpattiḥ kālabhedāt, sa ca pariṇāmaḥ sukhasvātmeti nānyat kāraṇaṃ mṛgyaṃ svātmana eva pariṇāmāt
itarathā sa prakāśo na saḥ, sa prakāśa eva yadi pravṛttiviśeṣo na syādanyātmā syāt sa eva prakāśātmā na syāt, tathā'pravṛttatvāt tena prakāśātmaprakāreṇāpravṛttatvāt, paryāyeṇa tamarthaṃ sphuṭīkurvannāha --tathā'bhūtatvādityarthaḥ
dṛṣṭānto ghaṭapaṭavat, yathā ghaṭaḥ paṭo na bhavati tena prakāreṇābhūtatvāt paṭo'pi ghaṭo na bhavati tathā sa prakāśo'prakāśa eva syāditi
viparyayeṇa tatsvarūpasādhanamucyate --yaiva ca pravṛttiḥ sa eva prakāśo nānyaḥ kaścidartha iti pratijñā, tathāvṛttatvāt tathāpravṛttatvādityarthaḥ ghaṭaghaṭasvātmavat, yathā ghaṭaprakāreṇa ghaṭātmanaiva vṛttatvād ghaṭa eva ghaṭasvātmā nānyat kiñcit tathā pravṛttireva prakāśa iti

pravartyapravartakatvāt pallavapavanavanneti cet
syānmatam--yaiva pravṛttiḥ sa eva prakāśaḥ itya- yuktaṃ pravartyapravartakayorbhedāt, pravartyaṃ hi sattvaṃ pravartakaṃ rajaḥ, tasmāt pravartyapravartakatvāt tayorbhedaḥ pallavapavanavat, yathā pallavapavanau pravartyapravartakau parasparato bhinnau tathā sattvarajasī iti
etacca na, tadātmana eva pravṛttatvāt, tasyātmā tadātmā, tadātmanaḥ prakāśātmana eva pravṛttatvāt, sattvarajasorbhedāsiddheḥ pallavapavanavad bhedasādharmyābhāvādayukto'yaṃ dṛṣṭānta iti vakṣyati
tadvyākhyānārthamāha --sannidhimātrāt pūrvavada pravartyavyaktisvarūpaḥ, tathāvyāpāraṇād rajaḥpravṛttyātmarūpāpādanāditaratathātmarūpāpādanād rajovat
rajo'pi hi itaratathāsvarūpāpādanādṛte kimanyat karoti ? evaṃ ca pallavavad raja evāpadyate tathā prakāśasya pravartyatvāt
tathāprakāśānatiriktatattvarūpatvādvā pravṛtteḥ kuto'pallavapavanabhedasādharmyam ? yujyate hi pallava- pravartanāt, iha rajaḥ sannihitamapi prāk sannidhimātrādevāpravartakaṃ svayamapravṛttaṃ sattvādhīnapravṛttitvāt, kintu pravartyamapravartanāt
kastarhi pravartakaḥ ? ucyate --ya evāsau sattvasyātmā prakāśaḥ
kathamiti cet, ucyate --tathāpravartyavyaktisvarūpaḥ, tena tena prakāreṇa śabdādinirvartyaprakāreṇa pravartyavyaktisvarūpaḥ prakāśo nartakācārya iva bhrūkṣepaṇādipravartanābhivyañjanātmanā nartakyāḥ pravartamānaḥ pravartakaḥ
kiṃ kāraṇam ? tathāvyāpāraṇāt, tena vyaktirūpeṇa pravartamānasya rajaso vyāpāraṇāt, sattvenaiva hi prakāśanarūpeṇa pravartamānena rajaḥ pravartyate, tasmāt sattvasyātmā prakāśastathāvyāpāraṇād rajasaḥ pravartaka iti tvadabhimatapravartakatvaviparyayāpattireva rajasaḥ pravartyatvāt sattvena sattvādhīnapravṛttitvāt sattvasyaiva pravartakatvāt pakṣadharmaviparītatā ceti
tacca sattvasya pravartakatvaṃ rajaḥpravṛttyātmarūpāpādanāt, rajaso hi pravṛttirātmā, tadeva rūpaṃ rajaḥpravṛttyātmarūpam, tadāpādyate sattvena, sattvāprakāśite pravṛttyabhāvāt, sattvāpāditaṃ pravṛttyātmakarūpaṃ rajaḥ, tasmād rajaḥpravṛttyātmarūpāpādanāt sattvaṃ pravartakam itaratathātmarūpāpādanād rajovat
rajo'pi hi ityādi, rajaso'pi hi pravartakatvamitthameva yujyate, rajo'pi hi yasmāt tvanmatena pravartamānamitarayoḥ sattvatamasostathāsvarūpāpādanādṛte kimanyat karoti ? pravṛttirūpamevāpādayat pravartakamitīṣyate, nānyathā
yathā tat pūrvaṃ prakāśaniyamātmabhyāmapravṛttayostayoḥ pravartanādeva pravartakamevaṃ sattvamitaratathāsvarūpāpādanāt pravartakamastu, ko doṣaḥ ?

vā॰ pra॰
syānmatam--prakarṣeṇa kāśanaṃ prakāśanamityādi yāvat pravṛttivaditi prāsaṅgikaṃ tadeva codyam, tatrottaramapi sattvasyāpi tamovadaparisamāptarūpatvādityādi akṣaraviparyāsena yathāyogākṣaropanyāsaṃ yāvat utthāpyasāhāyakaśaktitvād vātāhatanaudvayavad glānaśibikāvāhakavad yāvacca upahatabījavaditi vācyam, tasmādidaṃ vyākhyātārtham --niyāmakābhāvasya cāparyāptatvenoktatvāt
evaṃ caika eva vinidrāvasthāpuruṣatvavadityādi yāvad bhaṅgacakrāvartanamiti prāguktaṃ bhaṅgacakramāvartya vyākhyeyamiti tadevātidiśati samānatvāt
tatra tu pravṛttireva pradhānaṃ pravṛttyāpattirūpanirūpyatvāt pravṛttisvātmavaditi pravṛttimātratve pradhānabhaṅgacakrakamāvartitam, iha tu pravṛttisthāne niyamaṃ kṛtvā pradhānasthāne pradhānameva ca kṛtvā bhaṅgacakrāvartanaṃ tadvadeva kāryam

evaṃ tvanabhyupagame idaṃ nirūpyam--asti pradhānaṃ bhedānāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvāt
etat kathaṃ nirūpyate ? iti anekātmakatvakāraṇakalpanā asadvāda eva, sambhāvyavikalpānupapannārthatvāt, taduktasatyatvānupapannārthasarvoktānṛtatvapakṣavat
tathā yadi sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvaḥ syāt syādekata eva tattvam, na tu tatheha sukhaduḥkhamohānāṃ sāmānya- viśeṣabhāvo'stīti
kintūbhayato'nanyatvādabhinnatvādekatvādityādinā sattvarajastamasāmekatvāpādanārthaḥ pūrvavat sarva eva prakramabhedaiḥ sa eva tathaiva granthaḥ pravṛttyā prakāśaviśeṣitayā mohaviśeṣitayā ca neyaḥ, tathā ca bhāṣya eva sulikhitatvānna vivriyate
sannihitāpattibhavanasattārthatvamayathārthaṃ syādityatra tu viśeṣaḥ, āpattibhavanaṃ sannidhibhavanāvinābhāve yujyate, nānyathā, yadi tadrūpādi bīje na sannihitasannihitaṃ tato'ṅkurasyāsattvādyāpattiḥ syāt, sat kāryaṃ kāraṇe ceti dvaividhyaṃ ca bhavanasyaivameva yujyeta āpattyanāpattibhedāditi, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat
sattvena tamasā ca saha bhāvanāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ punaśca tathaiva tamaso'pi sattvena rajasā tadvadeva bhāvanāgrantho niravaśeṣo likhita ācāryeṇaiveti na vivṛṇmahe, sa evānusartavyaḥ
sarvatra ca bhedacodyeṣu pravartyapravartakatvāt pallavapavanavanneti cet, na, tadātmana evetyādi tadeva sattvarajaḥsaṃyoge'pi, prakāśārthiprakāśabhedād nartakīnartakācāryavanneti cet, na, tadātmana evetyādi sattvarajaḥ saṃyogesattvarajaḥsaṃyoge sattvatamaḥsaṃyoge ca, niyamyaniyāmakatvād naulambanapāṣāṇavanneti cet, na, tadātmana evetyādi sattvatamaḥsaṃyoge rajastamaḥsaṃyoge ca tatra prakāśanapravartananiyamanavacanāni ca yathopapatti yojyāni
kuto'pallavapavanabhedasādharmyam, kuto'nartakīnartakācāryabhedasādharmyam, kuto'naulambanapāṣāṇabhedasādharmyam ? iti copanayeṣu dvayaṃ dvayaṃ dvayordvayorguṇayoḥ sambhavitvāccodayitvā parihāryamiti
evaṃ tāvat sukhaduḥkhamohānāṃ prakāśapravṛttiniyamātmakānāmananyatvāt ekātmakaikakāraṇapūrvakatvam iti sādhvabhyadhāmeti

tadvicāroddeśārthaṃ sādhanamāha --anekātmakatvakāraṇakalpanā asadvāda eva sambhāvyavikalpānupapannārthatvāt, anupapannasambhāvyavikalpārthatvādityarthaḥ, ye'tra sambhāvyante vikalpāste'nupapannārthā iti vakṣyati, tasmādayamasadvāda eva

asau satyaśced yaducyate sattvarajastamāṃsi trīṇi śabdādyātmabhirvyavatiṣṭhamānāni parasparārthaṃ kurvanti, sattvaṃ śabdakāryaṃ prakhyāya śabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānaṃ rajastamasoḥ śabdātmabhāvāya pravṛttiṃ khyāpayati
atra prakāśātmakena sattvena prakāśātmakayoreva rajastamasoḥ śabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānena śabdātmabhāvāya pravṛttirvyaktiḥ prakhyāpyate, utāprakāśātmakayoḥ ? yadyaprakāśātmake rajastamasī śabdātmabhāvāya prakhyāpyete tataḥ sattvaṃ puruṣasyāpi tarhi śabdātmabhāvāya pravṛttiṃ prakhyāpayiṣyati śabdatvāyainaṃ pravartayiṣyati, aprakāśātmakena tenāpi śabdabhāvāya pravartitavyaṃ prakāśakārakopapatteḥ rajastamobhyāmiva
na tarhi sarvamuktamanṛtam, asya satyatvāt sarvoktāntaḥpātitvācca, athāsatyamidaṃ na tarhi sarvasyoktasyānṛtatvamanenānṛtena pratipādyate'syānṛtasyāpramāṇatvādityubhayathāpyasadvādastṛtīyavikalpābhāvācca tatheyamapi triguṇamekaṃ kāraṇam ityanekātmakaikakāraṇakalpanā asadvāda iti

॰bdābhā॰ya॰
kiñcānyat, --asatkāryavāditā'tyantāniṣṭā prasaktā evamanabhyupagame iti vartate, sā cāsatkāryavāditā'tisphuṭaiva, katham ? sattve pravṛttiniyamayorabhūtayoḥ śabdātmavyavasthānavacanādabhyupagamāt, sattvasya kāryaṃ prakāśa eveṣṭo na pravṛttiniyamau jātyantarabhūtarajastamaskāryatvāt, tau tatrāsantau punastasya kāryāvabhyupagatau, kutaḥ ? vyavasthānavacanāt sattvaṃ śabdakāryaṃ prakhyāya śabdātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānamiti bruvatābhyupagamāditīti
tadā yadi tat sattvamapravṛttamaniyataṃ vā pūrvavadapravṛttatvādaniyatatvācca tayostathārūpāṃ śabdātmikāṃ pravṛttiṃ na prakhyāpayed naiva vā syād vandhyāputravadityuktatvāt vyavasthānasya ca prakāśapravṛttiniyamātmakasya prāgasataḥ sattvaviṣayasyārambhāvasthāyāṃ sāmyāvasthāvilakṣaṇāyāmabhyupagatatvādasatoḥ pravṛttiniyamayoḥ sattvābhyupagamādatisphuṭā
kiñcānyat, rajastamasorityādi yāvat prakāśanasyābhyupagamāditi, asatkāryavāditā'tisphuṭaiveti vartate
tasminneva sattvaprakāśātmavyavasthānopakāra bhyupagamāt, pṛthagbhūtatattvakāraṇāśrayābhivyakteḥ vaiśeṣikābhimatatantvāśrayapaṭavat
tairyathāsvamakāraṇasadbhiḥ prakāśādibhirārabdhaṃ kāryamapi bhrāntimātram, tvaduktahetusāmarthyādeva tanmayārabdhatvādasadātmakaṃ hi tat kārpāsikatantvārabdhapaṭakārpāsikatvavat
tanmayatanmayaṃ ca asadātmakaṃ tanmayatanmayārabdhatvāt kārpāsikapaṭakuṭerapi kārpāsikatvavad rūpādisukhādimayatvavat
vākye rajastamasoḥ śabdabhāvāya pravṛttiṃ prakhyāpayatīti vacanāt tayo rajasi tamasi ca prāgasataḥ prakāśasya jātyantarakāryabhūtasya tadānīṃ prakhyāpanādasato'bhivyaktirutpattirvābhyupagatā, yadi te rajastamasī tathā pratipadyete vyavatiṣṭhete pravartete vā tataḥ sattvena prakāśitaṃ syāt ācāryeṇeva nartakyāḥ prāgapratipannāyā apravṛttāyā avyavatiṣṭhamānāyāḥ
tasmāt prakāśo'pi tayoḥ prāgasan paścājjāta ityasatkāryavāditā
sedānīṃ vaiśeṣikā- satkāryavāditayā tulyeti bhāvyate --pṛthagbhūtatattvetyādi, pṛthagbhūtaṃ tattvamātmā kāryaṃ tadbhāvo yasya sa pṛthagbhūtatattvo guṇaḥ, sa evāśrayaḥ kāraṇaṃ ca, tasmiṃstasmin guṇe sattve rajasi tamasi ca vaiśeṣikakalpitapaṭādikāryasya ca tantvādiṣu parasparasaṃyogāpekṣeṣvasato bhavanavat prakāśapravṛttiniyamānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ sattve pravṛttiniyamayorasatoḥ prakāśaniyamayośca rajasi pravṛttiprakāśayośca tamasyasatāṃ parasparāpekṣapravṛttiṣu sattvādiṣūtpattirbhavanamuktaṃ bhavati
prāgasantaḥ prakāśapravṛttiniyamāḥ śabdādyārambhakāla utpannā iti pratipadyasva pṛthagbhūtatattvakāraṇāśrayābhivyakteḥ vaiśeṣikābhitatantvāśrayapaṭavat

kimarthaṃ punarnirmūlotpattitvāditi siddhe tathābhūtavastugrahaṇam ? dṛṣṭāntadvayenārthadvayapradarśanārtham, tadyathā --dvitīyakṣaṇaghaṭavat, yathā kṣaṇaḥ kṣaṇāntare'nutpanna evottarasmin pūrvo nirudhyate uttaraśca tadanantaramutpadyate nirmūlaḥ nāmonnāmau tulāntayoriva asatkāryāḥ śabdādayaḥ, kāraṇatvāt, anyaguṇātmakasukhapravṛttyādivat itarānupakṛtāvidyamānaprakāśāditrayasukhādikāraṇavat
pratyekamitarānupakṛtavidyamānaprakāśāditrayasvakāryā vā sukhādayaḥ, kāraṇatvāt, śabdādivat tantvādivadvā

॰ttyevet puruṣadṛṣṭāntaḥya॰
evaṃ prakāśādyasatkāryatve siddhe sarvavyaktāsatkāryatvasādhanam --asatkāryāḥ śabdādayaḥ kāraṇatvāt, yad yat kāraṇaṃ tat tadasatkāryaṃ dṛṣṭam, anyaguṇātmakasukhapravṛttyādivat, anyo guṇaḥ sattvād rajaḥ, tasyātmā sukham, tacca svayaṃ sāmyāvasthāyāmekaprakāśātmakāryamapi sad jātyantararajaskāryapravṛttyātmakamārambhāvasthāyāmiṣṭaṃ tryātmakaśabdādyātmavyavasthānavacanāt, tathā niyamātmakamapi ādigrahaṇāt
ataḥ sukhaṃ sattvaguṇaṃ prāgasatpravṛttiniyamakāryaṃ paścāt tatkāryaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca tadvacchabdādayo'satkāryāḥ kāraṇatāṃ ca bibhratīti, evamanyaguṇaduḥkhaprakāśaniyamavat anyaguṇamohaprakāśapravṛttivadityekaikameva dṛṣṭāntaṃ kṛtvā yojyam
etasyārthasya sphuṭīkaraṇārthamāha --itarānupakṛtāvidyamānaprakāśāditrayasukhādikāraṇavaditi, itareṇa rajasā tamasā cānupakṛtau prāgasantau pravṛttiniyamau paścāt tadupakārajanitau sukhe kāraṇe dṛṣṭau, ādigrahaṇādevaṃ duḥkhe prakāśaniyamāvitarānupakṛtau prāgasantau paścāt tadupakārajau tathā mohe'pīti
yadyevaṃ neṣyate tataḥ pratyekamitarānupakṛtavidyamānaprakāśāditrayasvakāryā vā sukhādayaḥ, kāraṇatvāt, śabdādi- vat tantvādivadveti, svaśabdādekasyaiva sattvaguṇasya trayo'pi prakāśādaya ātmīyā eva kāryāstathetarayośceti puruṣādivāda evaiṣa saṃjñāmātravipratipatteriti

apṛthagbhūtatattvenaiva sattvena prakāśena pravṛttisattvena anapekṣayā ghaṭenaiva mṛdā ghaṭaḥ pṛthukukṣyādyākārāḥ kriyante'tyantabhinnenānyenānyasyākaraṇāt
kiñcānyat, tadātmavyaktipratiniyatasvasādhanakramasamāveśāt, ghaṭātmatvasya vyaktiḥ prāganupalabhyasya paścādupalabdhiḥ, sā pratiniyatānāmātmīyānāṃ kulāladaṇḍādīnāṃ tatkramasya ca kālākhyasādhanatvāt piṇḍaśivakādibhāveṣu yathāvasthaṃ vyāpriyamāṇānāṃ krameṇa vyāpārādityarthaḥ
taddarśayati --kāraṇaghaṭena kāryaghaṭo'bhivyajyata iti
kathaṃ vyajyate iti cet, ucyate --tathābhūtavyaktiśaktisthūlatāpattyā, pṛthukukṣyādiprakāreṇa vyaktiśaktirasyāṃ mṛdi śaktimatyāṃ sūkṣmāvasthānāduttarakālaṃ deśakālādyavabandhāpagamāt sthūlatāpattyā indriyagrāhyatayā nirmārjyadarpaṇasvarūpopalabdhivat karmaiva sad vastu kartṛ bhavati, mṛda eva ghaṭatvāt, mṛdeva hi ghaṭo bhavati, ghaṭamātmānamātmanā avasthāntaramātraviśiṣṭamavasthāntaramātraviśiṣṭena karoti, kartureva karmatvābhyupagamāt
kulāladaṇḍādīnāṃ tarhi sādhanatvābhāvaḥ svayameva mṛdaḥ kartṛkarmatvābhyupagamād ghaṭasyaiveti cet, na, ata eva tatsādhanatvād vīraṇādito'karaṇādasadakaraṇādihetubhyo mṛdyeva santaṃ ghaṭaṃ kulālacakradaṇḍādayo'bhivyañjayantaḥ kartṛkaraṇasampradānāpādānādhikaraṇādibhāvaṃ pratilabhante tadviṣayameva na vīraṇādiviṣayaṃ na tantvādiviṣayam, tadātmagatavyaktiśaktipratiniyatasvasādhanakramasamāveśādeva tāni ca kāraṇāni parasparopajanitakāryasādhanaśaktīni ekaprabandhena pravartamānāni kārakāṇi ityucyante, nānyaviṣayāṇi
tasmāt kulālādīnāmapi tathaiva kartṛtvādibhāvopapatteḥ ghaṭenaiva ghaṭaḥ kriyate iti sādhūktam

evaṃ dṛṣṭāntamātmanaivātmānaṃ prakāśayati karotīti pratipādya dārṣṭāntikaṃ pratipādayati --tathaiva sattvenetyādi
yathā kāraṇe kāryasya sattvād ghaṭenaiva ghaṭaḥ kriyata ityuktaṃ tathā kāraṇe kāryasya sattvāt sattvena sukhaprakāśādikāraṇātmanā tadātmakaṃ sattvameva prakāśyate mṛdghaṭāvasthāvat, taddarśayati --śabdādiprakāśenāpṛthagbhūtaprakāśāditattvam, kiṃ tat ? ākāśādi, rūpādyapṛthagbhūtatattvāyā mṛdo ghaṭe tadapṛthagbhūtatattvaghaṭādiprakāśavat prakāśāpṛthagbhūtena prakāśāpṛthagbhūtatattvaṃ prakāśyata ityarthaḥ, prakāśāpṛthagbhūtāveva pravṛttiniyamāvapīti taddarśayati --śabdādipravṛttyā śabdādiniyamena, tadapyākāśādi yathā prakāśāpṛthagbhāvāt prakāśyate tathā pravartyate niyamyate ceti
tad vistareṇa paryāyaśabdānvākhyānena bhāvayati— apṛthagbhūtatattvenetyādi, apṛthagbhūtatattvatvādeva tena sattvena prakāśena pravṛttisattveneti prakāśapravṛttyoraikyaṃ darśayati, evakāreṇāvadhāraṇārthena tataḥ pṛthagbhūtārthābhāvaṃ ca darśayati
ata eva cāha --anapekṣayā svaśaktyā vyaktirāvirbhāvaḥ
āvirbhāvena pravṛttyā pravṛttisattvena pravṛttisattvamevānapekṣā svavyaktirāvirbhāvaḥ pravṛttiḥ
tathā niyamasattvenānapekṣeṇa svaśaktyā āvirbhāvena svaniyatyā niyamasattvamevānapekṣā svavyaktiḥ
prakāśa eva pravṛttirniyamaśca, pravṛttirevetaradvayam, niyama evetaradvayam
ata eṣāmekapuruṣavṛttaśyāmāyatākṣapralambabāhutvavadekavastusvatattvabhūtānāmavyatirekaikavṛttitāvṛttiteti
sattvasattvenaiva sattvasattvaṃ prakāśyate vyaktipariṇāmena vyaktībhavatītyuktaṃ svaśaktyā, yaduktaṃ bhavati prakāśenāpṛthagbhūtatattvena sattvena ityādiparyāyaistaduktaṃ bhavati pravṛttisattvena pravṛttyā svaśaktyā vyaktirāvirbhāvaḥ, janī prādurbhāve pā॰ dhā॰ 1149, prāduḥ prākāśye, prakāśo janma abhivyaktirityanarthāntaram prakāśātmakayoreva rajastamasoḥ iti vacanādapṛthagbhūtaṃ tattvaṃ prakāśādīnāmarthāntaranirapekṣamiti
yathā prakāśa eva pravṛttiriti darśitaṃ tathā pravṛttireva prakāśa iti darśayati --āvirbhāvena pravṛttyā pravṛttisattvena pravṛttisattvamevānapekṣā svavyaktiḥ, svataḥpṛthagbhūtaprakāśaniyamānapekṣā svātmābhivyaktirityarthaḥ
tatparyāyakathanam --āvirbhāvaḥ pravṛttiriti
tathā niyamasattvena anapekṣeṇetyādinā granthena prakāśapravṛttyanarthāntarabhūto niyama eva sattvaṃ rajaścetyata āha --svaśaktyāvirbhāvena svaniyatyā, kā ca sā ? niyamasattvamevānapekṣā svavyaktiḥ pūrvavat svapravṛttiḥ svaniyama ityeko'rtha iti prāgupapāditatvāt prakāśa eva pravṛttirniyamaśca, yasmāt prakāśamānaḥ pravartate niyataścārtha iti
evaṃ pravṛttirevetaradvayam, yasmāt pravartamānaṃ prakāśate niyataṃ ca, niyama evetaradvayam, niyato hyarthaḥ prakāśate pravartate ca, tasmādihāpi tadeva bhāvitamaikyamiti

yadyapi nyāyamukhagranthaḥ saṃskṛtabhāṣāyāṃ nopalabhyate samprati tathāpi Yuen-Chwang ityanena 130॰ varṣebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ vihitaṃ cīnabhāṣānuvādamavalambya Giuseppe Tucci ityanena vihite English> bhāṣānuvāde nimnalikhitaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate--Some object: the reason: because it is audible</q> is not asādhāraṇa, as you assume, but it must be a valid reason when we discuss against a vaiśeṣika who thinks that soundness is eternal.
My reply is that this argument can be valid until the opponent has not indicated that the reason of non-eternity is the fact of being product etc.
But if validity can be reached in either way, since contradiction regarding one and the same object is inadmissible, this kind of reason proves to be a doubtful reason.
Moreover in this world the force of direct perception and of authority of the scripture AGAMA is stronger than any argument and therfore we must search after truth on the basis of these two means of knowledge, p.

evaṃ pra॰
atha mā bhūdeṣa doṣa ityanātmaviśeṣaṇatvāt tvadvat
etaddoṣaparihārārthaṃ yathā tvayā anātmatve sati avaraṇādyātmakatvāt sukhaṃ duḥkhādananyad mohavat ityādyabhihitaṃ tathāhamapi anātmatve sati laghutvāt sukhaṃ duḥkhādanyad mohavat ityābravīmīti, ato dharmadharmisvarūpavirodhau prakṛtipuruṣadoṣaśca neti
atrocyate --tathā sati yathā kim ? iti
evaṃ sati yathā kiṃ sukhādanyat ātmānaṃ muktveti
dṛṣṭāntaḥ idaṃ tat iti nidarśayituṃ na śakyate idaṃ tat sukhāt puruṣāccānyad vastviti samanvayasyābhāvaḥ, yadanātmatve sati laghutvādidharma tat sukhāt puruṣāccānyaditi vastvantarābhāvāt
taddarśayannāha --na hi sukhādanyadasti kiñciduktavadapuruṣam ? puruṣavyatiriktaṃ hi sarvaṃ parasparāviviktasukhādisvatattvamevetyuktam
tasmādanyat sukhameva sarvamiti samanvayābhāvaḥ
ata eva cānyatvena pakṣīkṛte sukhādau puruṣavyatiriktasapakṣābhāvāt sukhāderapi sukhādanyasya vipakṣatvād vipakṣāddhetorvyāvṛttyarthaṃ yaducyate yacca sukhādananyat tadanātmatve na prasādādyanātmakaṃ na laghvādyanātmakaṃ ceti nidarśayituṃ na śakyate, na ca mohādi sukhādanyanna bhavatītyaśakyaṃ darśayitumiti vipakṣāvyāvṛttirapi
ato vipakṣa eva sattvād viruddhāśca te hetava ityabhiprāyaḥ

॰tmakatvaṃbhā॰
॰tmakatvaṃ pra॰
atha tu yad vibhaktasvatattvaṃ duḥkhamohābhyāṃ sukhādanyanna bhavati tat prasādādyanātmakamapi na bhavati yathā sukham
tathā sati tathāniyamavat tathāpravartanāt tathāvyakteśca niyamapravṛttiprakāśātmakaṃ sukhameveti aikyaṃ mohādīnāmabhyupagataṃ tvayaiveti ko vādārtha ubhayorapi ? tatraiva tvavaraṇādyātmakatvādivad vidoṣā laghvādihetavo'pi sukhādāvapi ca viparihārapakṣīkṛte'pi ca
paradharmeṇāpi sukhaṃ duḥkhādananyat, calāprakāśakatvāt, avibhaktāśeṣaguṇātmakaloṣṭavat
evaṃ ca sthite sukhaṃ duḥkhādananyat, laghutvādapravṛttiśīlatvāt prakā-
atha tvityādi yāvat sukhamiti
atha mataṃ tava yad vibhaktasvatattvaṃ duḥkhamohābhyāṃ tat sukhaṃ sukhādanyanna bhavati tat prasādādyanātmakamapi na bhavatīti viviktasvarūpasya sukhasya duḥkhādanyatvāt prasādādyātmakatvācca tadeva śakyate vaidharmyeṇa nidarśayitum
ata eva ca tamaḥ sukhādanyad viviktasvarūpamaprasādātmakamapuruṣaṃ ceti sādharmyadṛṣṭāntaśca syāditi
evamitarasādhaneṣvapi ubhayadoṣaparihāra iti
atrocyate— tathā satītyādi yāvat ko vādārtha ubhayorapi ? iti
evaṃ sati tena prakāreṇa niyamo'yaṃ yat sukhādanyanna bhavati tat prasādādyanātmakamapi na bhavatyeveti etena prakāreṇa niyamavat sukhamevānanyat prasādādyātmakaṃ bhavati ceti tathā tasya vastunaḥ pravartanāt tathāvyakteśca niyamapravṛttiprakāśātmakaṃ sukhameveti tadabhyupagamenaivaikyaṃ mohādīnāmāpannamasmin sādhane, etadabhyupagamavacca śeṣasādhaneṣvapi duḥkhādanyat sukhaṃ mohaśca ityevamādiṣu yad yadanātmatve duḥkhādanyanna bhavati tacchoṣādivaraṇādyanātmakamapi na bhavati ityevaṃ niyamād vyakteḥ pravṛtteścaikyaṃ mohādīnāmabhyupagataṃ tvayaivetītaretaraikatvābhyupagamaḥ
itiśabdo hetvarthe, ityataḥ ko vādārthaḥ vādaprayojanamubhayorāvayoḥ ? tvayaivaikyābhyupagamānna vādārthastava mamāpi pratipannārthapratipādanavaiphalyāditi
evaṃ tāvadavaraṇādyātmakatvādihetavaḥ prathamoktānanyatvapakṣasyaiva sādhakā anātmatvaviśeṣaṇā api nānyatvapakṣasyeti pratipāditāḥ
॰tmakapuruṣaṃ pra॰
॰tmakatveya॰
tatraivānanyatvapakṣa eva tvavaraṇādyātmakatvādivad vidoṣā laghvādihetavo'pi, nānyatvapakṣe, tatra sadoṣā evetyabhiprāyaḥ
nanu laghvādayo'nanyatvahetava uktā eva, kiṃ punaranuśayena ? iti, atrocyate — sukhādāvapi ca na sattvādiṣveva, tatrāpi ca viparihārapakṣīkṛte'pi ca, na yathā tvayā sukhaṃ mohād guroranyat iti parihārapakṣīkṛte caiva

...śarīrādyāpattitvādiprakṛtidharmaiḥ
ityataḥ kutaḥ saṅkalanā pratyekadvitricaturādisaṃyogadharmānantyāt
calāprakāśātmakatvād duḥkhādananya iti sa eva loṣṭo dṛṣṭānto bhāvitasukhādyekātmakatvāt
evaṃ tāvat paradharmeṇa
evaṃ ca sthite'svadharmeṇāpi loṣṭādyarthānāṃ sukhādyekātmakatve sthite'nanyatve laghutvādihetavo'pi sādhakā iti taddarśayati--sukhaṃ duḥkhādananyallaghutvāt loṣṭavaditi vartate
evamapravṛttiśīlatvāt prakāśakatvāt
etāni ca catvāri sādhanāni, pratyekaṃ trīṇi tānyeva samuditānyekamiti
atra dvikasaṃyogenāpi trīṇi--laghvapravṛttiśīlatvāt, laghuprakāśātmakatvāt, apravṛttiprakāśātmakatvāditi
evaṃ mohādapīti, mohāt sukhamananyat ityatrāpi ta eva hetavastāvantaḥ
paradharmeṇa sukhasya duḥkhadharmābhyāṃ pratyekaṃ dve samudāyenaikamiti trīṇi--calatvādaprakāśakatvāccalāprakāśakatvāditi
pravṛttiśīlatvādityapi, tatsaṃyogenetarābhyāmapi sapta sādhanāni
evaṃ mohādapīti mohādananyaccalatvādityādibhyastebhya eva
evaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhādananyad gurutvādaprakāśakatvāt tatsaṃyogācceti mohadharmebhyastribhyaḥ
evaṃ mohādapīti tebhya eva mohadharmebhyastribhyo mohādapyananyat sukhamiti
dvābhyāmapyananyat sahitābhyāmiti duḥkhamohābhyāmananyat sukhaṃ laghutvādityādibhyastebhya eva hetubhyohetubhyaḥ, dvitricaturādisaṃyogena tat pratyekaṃ cānugantavyamityata āha --eta eva sarva ityanayā diśābhyūhyāḥ, na kevalameta eva laghutvādayaścalatvādayo gurutvādayo vā svaparadharmā hetavaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? svaparadharmāḥ prasādādayaśca, prasādalāghavādayaḥ śoṣatāpabhedādayo varaṇasadanāpadhvaṃsanādayaśca
itaretaretyādi, dvitricaturādisaṃyogena ca bhaṅgavikalpāḥ saṅkalanīyāḥ
evameva caita eva duḥkhamohayorapīti sukhāt parasparataścānanyatvaṃ yojyaṃ pratijñānāṃ ca pratyekaṃ dvitrisaṃyogena ceti sukhasya duḥkhād mohād dvābhyāṃ cānanyatayā tisraḥ, evaṃ duḥkhasya tisraḥ, mohasya tisraḥ, trayāṇāṃ parasparato'nanyatayaikaiveti daśa pratijñāḥ
etāsu sukhadharmā laghvādayaḥ, duḥkhadharmāścalādayaḥ, mohadharmau gurvaprakāśau, pratyekaṃ dvikādisaṃyogena saptatyadhikaṃ śataṃ sādhanānām
lāghavagaurave tvapanīya prasādādiśoṣādivaraṇādīnāṃ ca hetvagraṃ pañcaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi pañca śatāni ca ṣaṭtriṃśāni
kiñcānyat, na kevalameta eva hetavaḥ, anye'pyacetanatvetyādi samāsadaṇḍakamadhye yāvaccharīrādyāpattitvādiprakṛtidharmaiḥ sāmānyabhūtai nanvevaṃ svavacanavirodhādi, na, tavātmana evopālambhāt, pradhāna...

iti tattvārthasūtre
itthaṃ sukhaduḥkhamohānāṃ jātyantaratvāsiddhirāpāditā
tasmādeva ca vītāvītānāṃ sukhāditraiguṇyakāraṇapūrvakatvānumānasyānumānābhāsatetyata āha --trayaviṣayasamanvayetyādi yāvad vītānām, vyavahārasamprasiddhetyādi yāvacca hetutvāvadhāraṇārthānāṃ cāvītānāmatathārthatvāditi
teṣāṃ vītāvītānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tadyathā— prāganumānaṃ saprabhedaṃ vyākhyāya teṣāṃ yadetat sāmānyato dṛṣṭaṃ śeṣavadeṣa heturatīndriyāṇāṃ bhāvānāṃ samadhigame, tasya prayogopacāraviśeṣād dvaividhyam, vītavīta āvīta iti sāmānyena, viśeṣeṇa tu svarūpād vītasiddhiḥ, yadā hetuḥ parapakṣamavyapekṣya svenaiva rūpeṇa kāryasiddhāvapadiśyate tadā vītākhyo bhavati
pariśeṣādāvītasiddhiḥ, yadā nedamato'nyathā sambhavati asti cedam tasmāt pariśeṣato heturevāyam ityavadhārya kāryasiddhāvapadiśyate tadā āvītākhyo bhavatīti prayogalakṣaṇam, svalakṣaṇaṃ tvasya parapakṣapratiṣedhena svapakṣaparigrahakriyā āvīta iti
vītasya āvītasya vā bhāvaḥvākyabhāvaḥ pañcapradeśaḥ--pratijñā hetuḥ dṛṣṭānta upasaṃhāro nigamanamiti
tatra sādhyāvadhāraṇaṃ pratijñā, sādhanasamāsavacanaṃ hetuḥ, tannidarśanaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ, sādhyadṛṣṭāntayorekakriyopasaṃhāraḥ, pratijñābhyāso nigamanamiti
purastād vītasya prayogaṃ nyāyyaṃ manyante paścādāvītasyeti

yadyevaṃ prastutaṃ dharmādharmāvaṇavo vā kāraṇamastyeveti siddhatvāt kimanumitena kāraṇena iti cet, netyu dharmādharmāṇvādīnāmapi ca tantvaṃśvādivat pūrvapūrvaśaktatāratamyena sannihitatadvidhaśaktiḥ prativiśiṣṭabuddhiḥ svatantro'bhiprāyapravṛttyāpatteḥ pravartayitṛtvāt kāraṇam, śaktimatpravṛttinivṛttiviniyogeṣu svātantryāt, adhikṛtapaktṛvat
sambhavanadhāraṇajvalanavikledanavyāpāreṣu sthālīkāṣṭhataṇḍulādīnāṃ pravṛttinivṛttiviniyogeṣu svātantryāducyate--devadatta eva pacati, tena pacyate, sa pacati, tena pacanaṃ kriyate, prayojanamātrārthatvāt kriyāyāḥ
sākṣādvā bhavitṛvat, yathā ca sambhavanadhāraṇa- cyate --dharmādharmāṇvādīnāmapi ca tantvaṃśvādivadityādi yāvat prativiśiṣṭabuddhiḥ
yathā paṭastantupūrvakaḥ, tantavoṃ'śupūrvakāḥ, aṃśavastuṭipūrvakāḥ, tuṭīnāmapi pravartane śaktāstataḥ pūrve pūrve yāvacchatāṇukaḥ, tato'pi pūrve pūrve yāvad dvyaṇukaḥ paramāṇurityanumīyate śabdādito yāvat pradhānam, tathā aṇvādīnāmapyacetanānāṃ pravartakau dharmādharmau
ādigrahaṇāt kāla-svabhāva-niyatyādivādyantaraparikalpitāḥ
evaṃ pūrvapūrvaśaktatāratamyena īśvaraḥ sannihitatadvidhaśaktiḥ dharmādharmāṇvādipradhānaśabdādestathā tathā tathā viniveśane sannihitā yasya śaktiḥ so'sti
kātra tadvidhaviniveśanaśaktirmukhyā tasyeti cet, ucyate--prativiśiṣṭā buddhiḥ, ato'sau prativiśiṣṭabuddhirviśiṣṭabuddhibhyo'pi sthapatikulālādibhyaḥ, pratikartṛ viniveśanapravṛttinivṛttiviniyojaneṣu jñatvāt svātantryācca teṣāṃ bhāvānāmīṣṭe, na te tasyeśate nāpyātmanaḥ na ca parasparam, ajñāsvatantratvābhyām
sa tu prativiśiṣṭabuddhitvāt svatantraḥ, tasyābhiprāyeṇaiva pravṛttimāpadyante dharmādharmāṇvādayaḥ
so'pi cābhiprāyapravṛttyāpatterna sannidhimātravṛttiḥ, atasteṣāṃ pravartayitā, pravartayitṛtvāt kāraṇaṃ śaktimat sa eva, teṣāṃ śaktimatāmapi bhāvyatvenāsvātantryāt tasyaiva tatpravṛttinivṛttiviniyogeṣu svātantryāt jagatsargasthityantarālapralayamahāpralayeṣu, pravartanaṃ prāgaudāsīnyena sthitānāṃ dharmādīnāṃ sṛṣṭeḥ pravartanam, pravṛttānāṃ punarupasaṃhārād nivartanam, viniyogo daiva-mānuṣa-tairyagyona-sarit-samudrādi-tanu-karaṇādyavayavavibhāgavinyāsaḥ, viṣṇumanvādīnāmadhikṛtapuruṣāṇāmapi ihatyaparameśvarābhiprāyānurodhena pravartamānādhikṛtarājasthānīyādipuruṣāṇāmiva tasyaiva pravartayitṛtvāt
atastatsādharmyapradarśanārthamāha --adhikṛtapaktṛvat
tadvyākhyānārtham— sambhavanadhāraṇetyādi yāvat prayojanamātrārthatvāt kriyāyā iti

tacca pravartayitṛtvaṃ karmaṇaḥ siddhamuktavidhinā pravartyatvaṃ ceśvarasya, tathā pravartakaṃ karma, karmaṇaḥ puruṣaḥ pravartata iti prakṛtatvād gamyate, itiśabdo hetvarthe, tasmāt puruṣa eveśvaraḥ sarva iti

tathetyādi dārṣṭā pratighātastathā apacitakuśalamanujighṛkṣataḥ upacitakuśalaṃ copajighāṃsatastasya yadyapratighātaḥ syāt syāt svātantryam, na tu bhavati, puruṣakṛtakarmapratyayena īśvarapravṛttipratighātadarśanāt
yattūcyate--sargādau apratihatasvaśaktivaśādeva śarīrādīnyutpādya pratibuddhānāṃ prāṇināṃ dharmādharmamaryādāmupadiśati, madhyakāle ca teṣāṃ svamaryādānuṣṭhānānurūpeṇa phalena iṣṭenāniṣṭena vā anugrahaṃ karoti, ayamanugraha eva teṣāṃ tadṛṇamokṣaṇavat, mokṣamārgopasevinaśca sāyojyaṃ gamayati, antakāle ca śarīrendriyabhūtavat kuśalākuśale saṃhṛtya pralayakṣapāyāṃ svāpayati, yadapi cākāṅkṣyate tasya sarvajñatvaṃ sarvakāri- ntikam, sāpekṣapravṛttitvasādharmyānugamenopanayanaṃ rathakāre kāryam, vaidharmyeṇa tu darśayati --apacitakuśalamanujighṛkṣata ityādinā

54

syānmatam--pṛthivīdravyatvaṃ śivakādiṣvabhinnam, tasmiṃścābhinne tadutpādavināśayoścābhede satyeva pṛthivīdravyatvenānutpannāvinaṣṭatve satyaikye ca sta utpādavināśau tatkālau ca, tasyaiva pṛthivīdravyatvasya cāśābhyāṃ bījāṅkurākhyābhyāṃ bheda ityasti bhedaḥ kārakasadbhāvādityutpattirasti tathā vināśastatkālau ca, itiśabdasya hetvarthatvādevaṃ bhedasyā- bhedasya ca vyāghāto nāsti, tasmāt tadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyati pṛthivīdravyatvābhedāt tadaṃśabījāṅkura diti bhedasyābhedasya cāvyāghātaḥ
evaṃ tarhi pṛthivītvajātimātramabhinnaṃ dravyaikatvavighātakam, bījasya aṅkurasya ca nānātvam
tasmānna tadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyati
tataśca yathā bījamaṅkurāt pṛthageveṣyate tathā pāṃśvāditvamapi pārthivatvād bhinnameṣitavyamiti bhedanirbhedadravyanirmūlanam
api ca tvayaivāpāditaṃ bhedabahutvaṃ dravyaikatvavighāti, tatparihārārthamutthitena pārthivatvamapi nānaivotthāpitam
bhedakaṃ cābhedakādanyadabhedakaṃ ca bhedakāt, bhedakatvādabhedakatvāt, yathā dravyakriye
nanu ghaṭa utpadyamāna eva śivakatvena piṇḍatvena vinaśyati iti sa evotpadyate bhedāt tatkālau ca sta iti nānityaśūnyate doṣāviti
atrocyate --evaṃ tarhītyādi yāvad na tadevotpadyate tadeva vinaśyatīti
ayamidānīmasmatparikalpito bheda evāpatitastavāpi aśmasikatāmṛlloṣṭavajrādibhede sati pṛthivī nāma na kadācidanyāsti tadvyatirekeṇa, kintu pṛthivītvajātimātramabhinnaṃ tadbhedavyāpi
tacca dravyamekam ityasya tvatpakṣasya vighātakaṃ jātimātramabhinnaṃ śeṣaṃ sarvaṃ bhinnamiti sidhyati, bījasya aṅkurasya ca nānātvam, bījād vinaśyato'nyo'ṅkura utpadyamānatvāt, vinaṃṣṭurmṛtādanya iva devadatto yajñadattādutpadyamāna iti
tasmād na tadeva utpadyate tadeva vinaśyati, anyanivṛttyarthāvadhāraṇasya bhedasatyatve sati ānarthakyāt
tataśca yathā bījamityādidṛṣṭāntaḥ
yathā aṅkurādikāleṣu bhinneṣvapi vrīhitvasāmānyābhede sati pṛthageva bījamaṅkurādiṣyate mā bhūt pūrvokto'nutpādādidoṣa iti tvayā tathā pāṃśvāditvamapi pāṃśumṛtpiṇḍāditvamapi pārthivatvād bhinnameṣitavyam
tataḥ kimiti cet, brūmaḥ --iti bhedanirbhedadravyanirmūlanam, ityasmāt pāṃśvāditvabhedābhyupagamāt sarvaprabhedanirbhedaṃ dravyaṃ na bhavati
tataśca lakṣaṇābhāvād dravyameva nirmūlitaṃ tvayeti

āha --nanu ghaṭa utpadyamāna ityādi yāvad ghaṭatvenotpadyata iti
yat tvayoktaṃ yadeva utpadyate sa eva vinaśyati, tathā ghaṭatvena vinaśyan ghaṭatvenotpadyate śivakatveneva vinaśyaṃśchatrakatvena
ayamaparihāra uktottaratvāt, śivakenaivotpattau śivakenaiva vinaṃṣṭavyaṃ tato'bhinnatvāt ghaṭotpādavat
evaṃ tvanutpattau vināśasyāpyabhāvād ghaṭādibhavanābhāvaḥ, bhavanasambandhavyatikramābhāvāt sarvamabhūtaṃ nāstītyevamādyāpadyate
athocyeta--aikya eva mṛtkumbhāvasthayoḥ mṛddravyasyaiva bhavanasya tathāniyatā tadeva vinaśyati tatrānutpattyavināśasvavacanavirodhādikṣaṇikavādātiśayaśūnyatādoṣā na sambhavanti pratyakṣavacanādīnāṃ tathātvāt, yasmād ghaṭa utpadyamāna eva śivakatvenotpadyamānaḥ piṇḍatvena vinaśyati pūrvottarakālayorapi saddravyapṛthivīmṛttvābhedavad ghaṭābhedāt piṇḍāvasthāyāṃ śivakādyavasthāyāṃ mṛdādiyāvatparamāṇvavasthāyāṃ kapālādiyāvatparamāṇvavasthāyāṃ ca ghaṭa eva iti sa evotpadyate sa eva vinaśyati, itiśabdasya hetvarthatvāt uktahetvarthatvāt tasmād ghaṭa eva piṇḍatvenotpadyamānaḥ śivakatvena vinaśyatiṃ, tasmād nānutpattyādidoṣāḥ
yathā ca piṇḍatvenotpadyamānaḥ śivakatvena ghaṭa eva vinaśyati tathā punarghaṭatvena vinaśyan ghaṭatvenotpadyate, kimiva ? śivakatveneva vinaśyaṃśchatrakatvena, yathā śivakatvānantaraṃ chatrakatvaṃ jāyamānaṃ tadotpannaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ ca tathā deśāntarabhāvāntarāntaritaghaṭavināśaghaṭasambhavayorapi abhedo vastutvādibhyaḥ piṇḍaśivakatvavaditi

1, ṣaṇṇāṃ padārthānāṃ madhyād dravyeṣveva jñānaṃ vyākhyātam, yathotpadyate sannikarṣāt na tathā guṇādiṣu
tasya mana ātmā ca vai॰ sū॰ 8
2 mana ātmā ca jñānasya kāraṇaṃ vyākhyātam
idānīṃ guṇādiṣu jñānamāha --jñānanirdeśe jñānaniṣpattiruktā vai॰ sū॰ 8
3, yata indriyasannikarṣeṇa jñānaniṣpattiruktā guṇādīnām
yataḥ guṇakarmasu asannikṛṣṭeṣu jñānaniṣpatterdravyaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāraṇakāraṇaṃ ca vai॰ sū॰ 8
4, guṇakarmaṇāṃ yato dravyaṃ samavāyikāraṇaṃ tatasteṣu sākṣādindriyeṇa asannikṛṣṭeṣu vijñānaniṣpatteḥ kāraṇasya sannikarṣasya tadeva dravyaṃ kāraṇaṃ na guṇakarmāṇi, tasmād guṇakarmasu saṃyuktasamavāyaṃ jñānam, caśabdo hetau
sāmānyaviśeṣeṣu sāmānyaviśeṣābhāvāt tata eva jñānam vai॰ sū॰ 8
5, sāmānye sattādau viśeṣeṣu cāntyeṣu taddarśināṃ dravyasannikarṣādeva jñānamutpadyate, na sāmānyaviśeṣebhyaḥ teṣu tadabhāvāt
anyatra tu sāmānyaviśeṣāpekṣaṃ dravyaguṇakarmasu vai॰ sū॰ 8
6, dravyaguṇakarmasu dravyendriyasannikarṣāt sāmānyācca sādeḥsattādeḥ ? sāmānyaviśeṣācca dravyatvādeḥ saditi dravyamityādi ca jñānamutpadyata iti
iha sūtre sāmānyaṃ sattā, viśeṣā dravyatvādayaḥ, pūrvasūtre'nyathā
tatrāpi dravye dravyaguṇakarmāpekṣam vai॰ sū॰ 8
7, cakṣuḥsannikarṣād yajjñānaṃ dravye sāmānyaviśeṣāpekṣaṃ viṣāṇī iti, guṇāpekṣaṃ śuklaḥ iti, karmāpekṣaṃ gacchati ityutpadyata iti
dravyādīnāṃ ca viśeṣaṇatvāt pūrvamupalambhaḥ, tena viśeṣaṇabuddheḥ kāraṇatvaṃ viśeṣyabuddheḥ kāryatvam
guṇakarmasu guṇakarmābhāvād guṇakarmāpekṣaṃ na vidyate vai॰ sū॰ 8

nāsatā sambadhyate sattā viśeṣaṇatvād daṇḍavat
yathā viśeṣaṇasya daṇḍasya nāsatā daṇḍinā sambandhastathā sattāyā api

yo'pi cāvayavārthetyādi
anupapannavikalpatvāt ityasya sādhanasyāvayavārthāḥ satāmasatāṃ sadasatāṃ vā dravyādīnāṃ satkarī sattā iti vikalpāḥ, teṣu nāsatāṃ satkarī ityasya vikalpasya upapāda- nārthaṃ yāni sādhanāni vyutpāditāni pūrvapakṣīkṛtya vyāvartitāni ca, teṣu yo'ntyo vyutpattivikalpaḥ suṣṭhu vyutpādya vyāvartitaḥ pūrvapakṣa ityabhimataḥ so'pyevamanupapanna iti vicāraparyantasyottarasyānupapattau tuṣakaṇḍavat sarvavicāranairarthakyāt pūrvapakṣa evottarapakṣo bhavatītyabhiprāyaḥ

uktametat upayogo lakṣaṇam tattvārthasū॰ 2
