upayogaḥ praṇidhānam, āyogastadbhāvaḥ pariṇāma ityarthaḥ
eṣāṃ ca satyāṃ nirvṛttāvupakaraṇopayogau bhavataḥ, satyāṃ ca labdhau nirvṛttyupakaraṇopayogā bhavanti nirvṛttyādīnāmekatarābhāve'pi viṣayālocanaṃ na bhavati
iti vācakavaraśrīumāsvātipraṇīte tattvārthabhāṣye
asya siddhasenagaṇikṛtā vyākhyā--"labdhyupayogau bhāvendriyam
labdhiḥ pratisvamindriyāvaraṇakṣayopaśamaḥ, svaviṣayavyāpāraḥ praṇidhānaṃ vīryamupayogaḥ, etadubhayaṃ bhāvendriyamātmapariṇatilakṣaṇaṃ bhavati
atrācāryo labdhisvarūpanirvarṇanāyāha--labdhirnāmetyādi bhāṣyam
lābho labdhiḥ prāptiḥ, nāmaśabdo vākyālaṅkārārthaḥ, athavā labdhiriti yadetad nāma abhidhānaṃ tasyāyamarthaḥ--gatijātyādināmakarmajanitā labdhirucyate
gatijātī ādiryasya tad gatijātyādi, gatijātyādi ca tannāmakarma ca gatijātyādināmakarma, tena janitā nirvartitā manuṣyagatināmodayād manuṣyaḥ tathā pañcendriyajātināmodayāt pañcendriya ityato manuṣyatvapañcendriyatvādilābhe pratisvaṃ tadāvaraṇakarmakṣayopaśamo nirvarttyate, tasya kṣayopaśamasya gatijātiprabhṛtināmakarma kāraṇatvānnidiṣṭamācāryeṇa
ādigrahaṇena yat tadatra nāntarīyakaṃ śarīrādikṣayopaśamalabdhernāmāntaḥpāti tat sakalamādīyate
apare tu āyuṣkamapi tadāśrayatvāt kāraṇamācakṣate kṣayopaśamasya
evaṃ vidūravarti kāraṇamapadiśyādhunā pratyāsannatarakāraṇāntaramāviṣkaroti--tadāvaraṇīyakarmakṣayopaśamajanitā ceti
tasyāḥ khalu rūpādigrahaṇapariṇaterāvaṇīyamāvārakamācchādakam, bāhulakāt kartari vyutpattiḥ, tadāvaraṇīyaṃ ca tat karma ca tadāvaraṇīyakarma, matijñānadarśanāvaraṇakarmetyarthaḥ
tasyobhayasya kṣayopaśamo'bhihitalakṣaṇaḥ, tajjanitā ca tanniṣpāditā cetyarthaḥ
caśabdaḥ pūrvakaṃ kāraṇaṃ samuccinoti
nanu ca kṣayopaśama eva labdhiruktā, tena janitā anyā kā bhavellabdhiḥ ? ucyate--matijñānadarśanāvaraṇakṣayopaśamāvasthānirvṛttau yo jñānasadbhāvaḥ kṣāyopaśamikaḥ so'tra labdhirucyate
kathaṃ kṛtvoktaṃ prāk kṣayopaśamo labdhiriti ? kāraṇe kāryopacāramālambya naḍvalodakaṃ pādarogavadityabhihitamato na doṣāya
anye punarāhuḥ--antarāyakarmakṣayopaśamāpekṣā indriyaviṣayopabhoyo ?gajñānaśaktirlabdhirityucyate
punaḥ pratyāsannatamakāraṇanirdidikṣayā bhāṣyakṛt pratanute grantham--indriyāśrayakarmodayanirvṛttā ca jīvasya bhavatīti
indriyāṇyāśrayo'vakāśo yeṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ tānīndriyāśrayāṇi karmāṇi yāvanti kānicid nirmāṇāṅgopāṅgādīni yairvinā tāni na niṣpadyante tadudayena tadvipākena nirvṛttā janitā ātmano labdhirudbhavati, svacche hi darpaṇatale pratibimbodayo bhavati, na malīmase, tathā nirmāṇāṅgopāṅgādibhiratyantavimalatadyogyapudgaladravyanirmāpitānīndriyāṇi tasyāḥ kṣayopaśamalabdheratulaṃ balamupayacchanti kāraṇatāṃ bibhratīti
saiṣā labdhiḥ kāraṇatrayāpekṣā pañcaprakārā bhavati
tadyathā--sparśenendriyalabdhirityādi bhāṣyam
yathā tat pañcavidhatvaṃ tasyāstathā darśyate
spṛṣṭiḥ sparśanam, sparśanaṃ ca tadindriyaṃ ceti sparśanendriyam, etadeva labdhiḥ sparśanendriyalabdhiḥ śītoṣṇādisparśaparijñānasāmarthyamanabhivyaktamupayogātmaneti yāvat, evaṃ jihvendriyādilabdhayo'pi vācyāḥ
iti śabdo labdheriyattāmāvedayati
uktā labdhiḥ, adhunopayoga ucyate
yadi labdhinirvṛttyupakaraṇakrameṇopayogastato'tīndriyopayogābhāvo nirvṛttyādyapekṣā'bhāvāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati--avadhyādīnāmatīndriyatvādatyantābhāva eva
viśeṣo vācyaḥ
ucyate--na khalu sarva upayogo labdhinirvṛttyupakaraṇendriyakṛtaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? sa evaikastritayanimitta ityata āha--upayogaḥ sparśādiṣu
sparśarasagandhavarṇaśabdeṣu grahaṇarūpo vyāpāra upayoga gṛhyate sparśanendriyādinimittaḥ, nāvadhyādyupayogaḥ
amumevārthaṃ spaṣṭayan bhāṣyakṛdāha--sparśādiṣu matijñānopayoga ityarthaḥ
sparśādiviṣayo matijñānavyāpāraḥ pratiniyataviṣayānubhavanamupalambhanamiti, anena śeṣajñānavyudāsamādarśayati, matijñānopayoga eva labdhinirvṛttyupakaraṇāpekṣaḥ pravartate na śeṣa iti
atropayogasāmānyaśrutyapahnutāvadhānaścodayati--sparśādiviṣayo ya upayogaḥ parisamāptivyāpāra ityuktam
etacca paramāṇudvyaṇukādiṣyapi dṛṣṭam
paramāṇurapi hi sarvātmanopayujyate dvyaṇukādiskandhapariṇāme, tataśca so'pyupayogalakṣaṇaṃ prāpnotītyata āha bhāṣyakāraḥ--uktametadupayogo lakṣaṇamiti
athavā bhāṣyakāraḥ svayamevopayogaviśeṣavyākhyāmātitaniṣurāha--uktametadityādi
abhihitametadupayogaścaitanyapariṇāmo jīvasya vaiśeṣikaṃ lakṣaṇam, kaḥ paramāṇvādiṣvatra prasaṅgaḥ ? atyantāsambandha eva
tamevopayogaṃ paryāyataḥ kathayati caitanyalakṣaṇaṃ viśeṣavyākhyānadarśanadvāreṇa upayoga ityādi
upayogastu dvividhā cetanā--saṃvijñānalakṣaṇā anubhavanalakṣaṇā ca
tatra ghaṭādyupalabdhiḥ saṃvijñānalakṣaṇā, sukhaduḥkhādisaṃvedanā anubhavanalakṣaṇā
etadubhayamupayogagrahaṇād gṛhyate
praṇidhānamavahitamanaskatvam
etadutkīrtayati--spaṣṭo hi matijñānopayogo mānasopayogāvaśyambhāvī dravyendriyādyapekṣaśca, nāvadhyādyupayogastatheti
āyoga iti svaviṣayamaryādayā sparśādibhedanirbhāso jñānodayaḥ sparśanendriyādijanmā abhidhīyate
tadbhāva iti, upayogalāñchano jantuḥ tacchabdenāmṛśyate, tasya bhāvaḥ sparśanādidvārajanma jñānamātmano bhūtirudbhava iti yāvat
pariṇāmo'pyātmana eva tadbhāvalakṣaṇo nārthāntaraprādurbhāvalakṣaṇaḥ, sparśanādinimittajñānasyātmapariṇatirūpatvādityarthaḥ
samprati pravṛttau kramaniyamamāpādayannāha--eṣāmityādi bhāṣyam
eṣāmiti vyākhyātasvarūpāṇāṃ nirvṛttyupakaraṇalabdhyupayogendriya ṇāmayaṃ pravṛttikramo yaduta nirvṛttiḥ prāk, tasyāṃ satyāmupakaraṇamupayogaśca bhavati nirvṛttyāśrayatvādupakaraṇasya taddvārajanmatvāccopayogasya
etacca nirvṛttyāditraya labdhīndriyapūrvakaṃ darśayati--śrotrādikṣayopaśamalabdhau satyāṃ nirvṛttiḥ śaṣkulyādikā bhavati, yasya tu labdhirnāstyevaṃprakārā na khalu tasya prāṇinaḥ śaṣkulyādayo'vayavā nirvartyante, tasmāllabdhyādayaścatvāro'pi samuditāḥ śabdādiviṣayaparicchedamāpādayanta indriyavyapadeśamaśnuvate, ekenāpyavayavena vikalamindriya nocyate na ca svaviṣayagrahaṇasamarthaṃ bhavati
amumarthaṃ bhāṣyeṇa darśayati--nirvṛttyādīnāmiti sūtropanyastakramamaṅgīkṛtyocyate
nirvṛttyupakaraṇalabdhyupayogānāmanyatamābhave ekenāpyaṅgena vikale sati samudāye na jātucit śabdādiviṣayasvarūpāvabodho bhavatyātmanaḥ vikalakaraṇatvāt...

yadvetyādi
athaivaṃ neṣyate na tat satkriyate dravyādyutpannamātraṃ na bhāvyate vā kenacidarthāntareṇa, sadbhūtatvāt, sattādivaditi, ādigrahaṇād dravyatvādisāmānyaviśeṣa-viśeṣa-samavāyavat

yadi tat kāraṇasamavetaṃ svata eva sanna bhavati asadeva tarhi tat, svato nirupākhyatvāt avyapadeśyatvāt tathā'viśiṣṭatvāt khapuṣpavat asat syāt

viśeṣasamavāyāḥ santo nānyaprakāśā nādheyasattvādayo nāpratipūrṇasattvādayaḥ tathā dravyādīni
evaṃ sātmakatvāt pratyekaṃ sattvāt svabhāvasadbhūtatvāditi hetavaḥ, mūlahetoreva paryāyavācino vā
evamanabhyupagame asadeva vā syāt sattvasamavāyalabhyasadbhāvatvāt, sattvasamavāyena labhyaḥ sadbhāvo'syeti dravyādyutpannamātraṃ trayamabhisambadhyate
kāryavaditi kāraṇāvasthāyāṃ yat kāryaṃ sa dṛṣṭāntaḥ

tasmād na satāmapi dravyādīnāṃ satkarī sattā vyarthatvāditi sādhūktamiti prastutadoṣoktyupapattyupasaṃhāraḥ
evaṃ tāvadasatāṃ satāṃ ca dravyādīnāṃ satkarī na bhavati sattā ityuktam

tatra hi satkāryapakṣe kriyā kiṃ virudhyate ? sāṅkhyo yadasau ekāntena sanneva ghaṭaḥ ityāha tatastasya kriyā niṣpannasya na yujyate kartavyābhāvāt kṛtavat iti kriyā'bhāvadoṣo bhavati, na punaḥ syādvādinaḥ
yadi tvasau syādādinā kartavyatvamapi vidadhīta tataḥ ka enamevaṃ brūyāt ? asatkāryapakṣe'pi upādānaniyamaḥ kiṃ virudhyate ? yadasau ekāntena asadeva kāryam iti hetūpādāneṣu sannihitasya kriyābhivyaṅgyasyārthasyoparyavajñayā brūyāt tasya 'paṭārthitāyāṃ tantūpādānaniyamo na
tat pareṇaivābhivācayati praśnapūrvakam --tatra hi satkāryapakṣe kriyā kiṃ virudhyate kena hetunā ? sāṅkhyo yadasāvekāntenetyādi yāvat kṛtavaditi
dravyārthato hi mṛtpiṇḍe ghaṭo'sti na paryāyataḥ
sāṅkhyastu sanneva ghaṭaḥ kāryatvaparyāyanirapekṣa ityāha tatastasya kriyā karaṇaṃ niṣpannasya sarvathā vidyamānasya na yujyate kartavyābhāvāt kṛtavat niṣpannaghaṭavadityevaṃ tasya satkāryavādinaḥ kriyā'bhāvadoṣo bhavati, na punarākāṅkṣitakartavyaparyāyadravyārthavādinaḥ syādvādinaḥ syāt sanneva mṛtpiṇḍe ghaṭaḥ kenaciddharmeṇāsannapi iti vadataḥ parihṛtapūrvoktasatkāryaikāntavādadoṣatvāt
yadi tvasau sāṅkhyo'pi syādādinā kartavyatvamapi vidadhīta syādvādivat kathaṃcit kutaścit ityādinānekāntavācinā viśeṣaṇena viśeṣya sadeva kāryam iti tataḥ ka enamevaṃ brūyāt ? ko vādī susamīkṣitavākyaguṇadoṣo'pi kriyā'bhāvadoṣaste prāptaḥ kartavyatvābhāvāt kṛtavat iti vaktuṃ śaknuyāt parihṛtapūrvadoṣaṃ vādinaṃ sāṅkhyamanyaṃ vābhyupetānekāntavādamiti

dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 529 paṃ॰ 4

kāryakāraṇetyādi
kāraṇamādhāraśca dravyam, ādheye kārye ca guṇakarmaṇī, tayorbhinnayoḥ kāryakāraṇayorādhārādheyayośca samavāyāt tau guṇakarmabhāvau bhaviṣyata iti cet evaṃ cenmanyase, mā maṃsthāḥ, atrottaram --tayorguṇakarmaṇorityādi yāvat prathamadravyabhāvanivṛttiriti tāvadupadeśavacanam, uparitano granthastadvyākhyā, guṇakarmaṇorguṇakarmabhāvanivṛttidvāreṇa dravyasya dravyabhāvanivṛttirākhyāyate
tadyathā--ya uktaḥ kāryakāraṇādhārādheyasamavāyastasyaivaikatvāt yo dravyabhāvena guṇakarmaṇoḥ samavāyaḥ sa ekastena dravyeṇa sambandhāt te guṇakarmaṇī dravyamevaikaṃ karoti, tato guṇakarmaṇī nivartete, tannivṛttau dravyamāśrayyabhāvād nāśrayo na ca kāraṇaṃ samavāyināṃ guṇakarmaṇāmabhāvāt, tato dravyasya dravyalakṣaṇaṃ nāsti kriyāvad guṇavat samavāyikāraṇam vai॰ sū॰ 1

athavā tvadiṣṭena dravyatvena sarvagatena sambandhe sati guṇasya karmaṇo vā dravyaṃ dravyatvena sambaddhamiti dravyībhāvaḥ, tadbhāvād guṇakarmaṇī na dravyāśrite, tato dravyalakṣaṇāyukterdravyabhāvanivṛttiḥ, kiṃ dravyalakṣaṇamiti cet, ucyate --kriyāvad guṇavat samavāyikāraṇam vai॰ sū॰ 1

iha iti samavāyanimittasya jñānasyānvayadarśanāt sarvatraikaḥ samavāya iti gamyate
dravyatvādinimittānāṃ vyatirekadarśanāt pratiniyamo jñāyate
yathā kuṇḍadadhnoḥ saṃyogaikatve bhavatyāśrayāśrayibhāvaniyamaḥ tathā dravyatvādīnāmapi samavāyaikatve'pi ādhārādheyaniyamaḥ syāt ityāśayo bhāti, dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 524 ṭi॰ 3
na tu tathā saṅkarābhāvo ghaṭate
yadi sarvātmakaḥ samavāyo dravyādyādhāra eka eva tadā kimiti saṅkaro na syāt ? nāpi ca dvivṛttitvanivṛttiḥ samavāyasya ityāśayo bhāti
dravyaguṇayoḥ dravyakarmaṇoḥ dravyadravyatvayoḥ guṇaguṇatvayoḥ karmakarmatvayośca samavāyaḥ ityabhidhānapratyayau dṛśyete
tathā ca ādhārādheyabhāvena bhede saṃyogavad dvivṛttitvāt samavāyasyānityataiva

dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 528 ṭi॰ 8
yattu pratyuktamityādi saṅkaradoṣasya yaduttaramuktam --na, ādhārādheyaniyamāditi
yadyapyeka ityādi tadvyākhyā yāvat karmasveva karmatvamiti, sarvatra caikaḥ samavāyaḥ ityanena dvivṛttitvaparihāreṇānityatvamapi parihṛtamiti vaiśeṣikaḥ
ācārya āha --etadapi pratyuktamityādi gatārthaṃ yāvat pratiniyatānīti
dvivṛttitvamevāsya iti ca vakṣyati
yattūcyate--avagamyatāṃ tāvadityādi idaṃ tasya doṣaparihāraprāṇasarvasvamanvayavyatirekābhyāmaniyamātiprasaṅgābhāvabhāvanaṃ gatārthaṃ yāvat samavāyaikatve'pyādhārādheyaniyamaḥ syāditi
atrācārya āha — idamapītyādi, svavādenaivottaramārgo vihito'sya vacanasya tvayā ihedam vai॰ sū॰ praśastamati॰ ityādinā samavāyalakṣaṇaṃ vyācakṣāṇena ādhārādheyasambandhajñānalakṣaṇatvāt kāryakāraṇayoścādhārādheyabhāvāt sambandhinoḥ kuṇḍadadhidṛṣṭāntena ca subhāvito'yamarthaḥ, tenaiva vayaṃ brūmaḥ --na tu tathetyādi, na tu tathā saṅkarābhāvo ghaṭate uttaraprakāreṇa, kuṇḍadadhisaṃyogadṛṣṭānte yadi dadhimadhūdakādibhirbahubhirādheyaiḥ kuṇḍādhāraḥ saṃyukto bhavati tataḥ kimiti saṅkaro nāsti ? tathā yadi sarvātmakaḥ samavāyo dravya-guṇa-karma-dravyatva-guṇatva-karmatva-sattādyādhāra eka eva bhavati tadā kimiti saṅkaro na syāt ? nāpi ca dvivṛttitvanivṛttiḥ samavāyasya yataḥ saṃyogād vaidharmyamucyate tvayā dvayordvayoḥ ityādinā
tatra sādhanam--sarvatra tāvad dravyadravyatvādisamavāye dvivṛttitvaṃ tvayaivopavarṇyate, sādhayāmaścaitad dvivṛttitvaṃ sambandhidvayaviśiṣṭābhidhānapratyayatvāt kuṇḍadadhyādisaṃyogavat, yathā kuṇḍadadhnoḥ saṃyoge dadhnā kuṇḍena vā viśiṣṭe tannimittamabhidhānaṃ pratyayaśca dṛśyate dadhikuṇḍaṃ kuṇḍadadhi veti taddvivṛttitvaṃ ca tathā samavāye'pi dravyaguṇayorityādi dvivṛttivarṇanam
tasmāt tvatpūrvapakṣitadoṣāsaṅgastadavasthaḥ samavāyasyetyata āha --tathā cetyādi yāvadanityataiveti gatārtham

tasya dravyasya guṇabhāvena sambaddhatvād guṇavad dravyabhāvanivṛttiḥ ityāśayo bhāti
dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 440 ṭi॰ 5
yattvidamityādi paroktameva granthamatidiśati yāvajjñānamityādi, dravyādīnāmādhārāṇāṃ dravyatvādibhirādheyaiḥ parasparavyatiriktairviśeṣaṇairniyamo bhavati svatattvānurūpapratyayotpatteriti
atrocyate --anena svapakṣe pratyakṣavirodha udgrāhyate tvayā
katham ? na hītyādinā bhāvayati, hiśabdo hetvarthe, yasmāt samavāya ekastasmād dravyādidravyatvādibhiraviśiṣṭatvād vyatireko niyamaśca nāsti, ato dravyeṣveva dravyam iti jñānaṃ na syāt
tasya vyākhyā --evamityādi, evaṃ te samavāyaikatve dravyeṣvapi guṇajñānaṃ syādaviśiṣṭatvād guṇeṣviva
apiśabdāt karmasvapi
kiṃ kāraṇam ? guṇajñānakāraṇatvāt samavāyasya, kimiva ? guṇavaditi, guṇeṣviva guṇavat iti sādhanam
dravyādi॰bhā॰ pratau nāsti
tadeva vyācaṣṭe --ekatve yo'yamityādi yāvad dravyasyāpi guṇatvam
yadi dadhimadhūdakādīnāṃ kuṇḍasaṅkīrṇānāmaviveke niyamena ayamasyaiva svabhāvaḥ ityaśakyamavadhārayituṃ saṃyoge dadhikuṇḍameva, madhukuṇḍameva, udakakuṇḍameva vā iti ekatvāt saṃyogasya sarveṇāpi sambandhāt, tathātrāpi yo dravyabhāvena sambandhaḥ sa eva guṇasyāpi iti etasmāt kāraṇāt prāptaṃ guṇatvaṃ dravyasyāpi guṇabhāvaḥ, dravyaṃ guṇo bhavatītyarthaḥ
guṇatvābhisambandhācca tasya dravyabhāvahāniḥ, evaṃ guṇabhāvāpattau dravyabhāvo hīyata iti pararūpatāmāpādya svarūpatyāgamāpādayati
tasyetyādi vyākhyānasādhanaṃ yāvad nivṛttiḥ

tayoralakṣaṇatvādasattvāt, tayorguṇakarmaṇoralakṣaṇatvādasattvaṃ khapuṣpavat, tadasattvādāśrayatvopalakṣyadravyābhāvaḥ, guṇakarmaṇorupalakṣaṇayorāśrayiṇorabhāvādvāśrayo dravyaṃ nāsti auṣṇyābhāve'gnyabhāvavat upalakṣaṇābhāvāt khapuṣpavadvā

dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 455 paṃ॰ 18
evametāni dvikasaṃyogena dravyasya guṇena saha karmaṇā ca dve, guṇasya dravyeṇa karmaṇā ca saha dve, karmaṇo dravyeṇa guṇena ca saha dve, iti ṣaṭ cakrakāṇi
dravyatvena guṇasya karmaṇaśca dve, guṇatvena dravyasya karmaṇaśca dve, karmatvena dravyasya guṇasya ca dve, iti ṣaṭ
evaṃ dvādaśa cakrakāṇi
evaṃ dravyatvasya karmaṇā guṇena ca guṇatvasya dravyeṇa karmaṇā ca karmatvasya dravyeṇa guṇena ca ṣaṭ cakrakāṇi
dravyasya guṇatvena karmatvena ca, guṇasya dravyatvena karmatvena ca, karmaṇo dravyatvena guṇatvena ca ṣaṭ, tānyapi dvādaśa

dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 524 ṭi॰ 3
yadyapyaparicchinnadeśāni sāmānyāni bhavanti tathāpyupalakṣaṇaniyamāt kāraṇasāmagrīniyamācca svaviṣayasarvagatāni, antarāle ca saṃyogasamavāyavṛttyabhāvādavyapadeśyānīti
iti praśastapādabhāṣye sāmānyanirūpaṇe
asya vyākhyā--svaviṣaye sarvatra sāmānyaṃ samavaiti nānyatreti yat pūrvamuktaṃ tatra kāraṇamāha— yadyapīti
yadyapi sāmānyāni yatra tatropajāyamānena piṇḍena sambandhādaparicchinnadeśāni aniyatadeśāni tathāpi upalakṣaṇasya abhivyañjakasyāvayavasaṃsthānaviśeṣasya niyamād niyatatvāt piṇḍotpādakakāraṇasāmagrīniyamācca svaviṣaye sarvatra samavayanti nānyatra
etaduktaṃ bhavati--sāsnādisaṃsthānaviśeṣo gotvasya vyañjakaḥ, kesarādisaṃsthānaviśeṣo'śvatvasya, viśiṣṭagrīvādisaṃsthānaviśeṣaśca ghaṭatvasya, pratītiniyamāt
ete ca saṃsthānaviśeṣāḥ na sarveṣu piṇḍeṣu sādhāraṇāḥ, api tu pratiniyateṣu bhavanti
tatra yadyapi sarvaṃ sāmānyaṃ sarvatropajāyamānena svaviṣayeṇeva piṇḍāntareṇāpi sambaddhuṃ kṣamate tathāpi yasyābhivyañjakaṃ yatra piṇḍe sambhavati tasya tatraiva samavāyo nānyatra
evaṃ sāmagrīniyamādapi sāmānyasambandhaniyamaḥ
eṣa hi tantvādīnāṃ kāraṇānāṃ svabhāvo yadetairutpādyamāne dravye paṭatvameva samavaiti nānyat
eṣa hi mṛtpiṇḍādīnāṃ mahimā yat taiḥ kriyamāṇe dravye ghaṭatvameva samavaiti nānyat
na tāvat sāmānyamanyataḥ samāgatya sambadhyate niṣkriyatvāt, tatrāpi yadi pūrvaṃ nāsīt tatropajāyamānena piṇḍenāsya sambandho na syāt, dṛśyate ca sarvatropajāyamānena piṇḍena sambandhaḥ, tasmāt sarvaṃ sarvatrāstīti kasyacid mataṃ nirākurvannāha--antarāle saṃyogasamavāyavṛttyabhāvādavyapadeśyānīti
antarālamiti ākāśaṃ vā digdravyaṃ vā stimitavāyurvā mūrtadravyābhāvo vā, teṣu gotvādisāmānyānāṃ na saṃyogo nāpi samavāyaḥ
na cāsambaddhānāmeva teṣāmavasthāne pramāṇamasti, ato'ntarāle na sāmānyāni vyapadiśyante, na santītyarthaḥ
kathaṃ tarhi tatropajāyamānena piṇḍena sambadhyante ? kāraṇasāmarthyāt
saṃyogo hyanyataḥ samāgatasya bhavati tatraivāvasthitasya vā bhavati, tasmād vilakṣaṇastu samavāyo yatra yatraiva piṇḍotpattau kāraṇāni vyāpriyante tatra tatraiva kāraṇānāṃ sāmarthyāt piṇḍe'nyato'nāgatasya tatrāsthitasyāpi sāmānyasya bhavati vastuśakteraparyanuyojyatvāt
iti nyāyakandalyām

yadapītyādi
yadapi pareṇoktaṃ yathā kuṇḍadadhisaṃyoge dadhyevādheyam, kuṇḍamevādhāraḥ iti niyamastathā dravyamevādhāro guṇakarmādyevādheyam, dravyaguṇakarmāṇyevādhāro dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvānyevādheyāni iti, tadapi naiva, kuṇḍadadhyādhārādheyabhāvasamavāyānāmapyekatvāt, tatrāpi tvanmatenādhārayoḥ kuṇḍadadhnorādheyayośca kuṇḍatvadadhitvayostayostattvayordravyatvādīnāṃ ca tattvānāṃ ye samavāyāsteṣāmapyekatvāt samavāyibhedopacaritabhedānāmāñjasyenaikatvāt pūrvoktavidhinā tadavasthaḥ saṅkaradoṣaḥ

"tatra ṛjusūtraḥ kuṭilātītānāgataparihāreṇa vartamānakṣaṇāvacchinnavastusattāmātram ṛju sūtrayati anyato vyavacchinatti sūtrapātavat
na hyatītamanāgataṃ vāsti
yadi syātāmatītānāgate na tarhi mṛtaputrikā yuvatiḥ putrakamuddiśya rudyāt na ca putrārthinī yoṣit aupayājikādi viśiṣṭadevatāsannidhau vidadhyāt
taddhi vastu vartamānakṣaṇāvasthāyyeva, na jātucit tataḥ paraṃ sattāmanubhavati, nāpi atītakālāsāditātmalābhaṃ kiñcit tatrānveti, svakāraṇakalāpasāmagrīsannidhāvutpadya svarasabhaṅguratāmavalambante tatkṣaṇamātrāvalambinaḥ sarvasaṃskārāḥ
evaṃ ca sati ya ete kartṛbhūtadravyaśabdasannidhau kriyāśabdāḥ prayujyante yathā devadattaḥ pacati paṭhati gacchatīti karmabhūtadravyaśabdasannidhau vā yathā ghaṭo bhidyate ghaṭaṃ vā bhinattityevamādayo na yathārthāḥ
katham ? yato nāmaśabdena avikṛtarūpasya dravyasyābhidhānāt kriyāśabdena ca vikārasya pratipādyatvāt, na ca vikārāvikārayoraikādhikaraṇyamasti viruddhatvāt
arthapratyāyanāya hi prayuktaḥ śabdo viruddhamarthaṃ pratipādayan naiva samyagjñānamādhatte, ayathārthatvāt, mṛgatṛṣṇāyāṃ salilaśabdavaditi
uktārthasaṃvādī ca śloko gītaḥ purāvidā--palālaṃ na dahatyagnirbhidyate na ghaṭaḥ kvacit
nāsaṃyataḥ pravrajati bhavyo'siddho na sidhyati
palālaṃ dahyata iti yad vyavahārasya vākyaṃ tad virudhyate
atravākye vākyārthapratipattaye padārthapravibhāgakāle palālaśabdo viśiṣṭākāradravyavacano nāmaśabdaḥ, taddhi dravyaṃ yāvat tasminnevākāre vartate tāvadeva palālaśabdavācyam
anyadā tu palālabhāvena tasyābhāva eva, tadbhāvenābhāvāt, paṭavat
tasmāt sthirarūpamavyāpāramudāsīnamavikṛtaṃ palālaśabdena vastu pratipāditam, kathaṃ tadeva dahyate ityanena śabdenocyeta, kriyāśabdasya vikārābhidhāyitvāt ? na hi sa evārtho vikāraścāvikāraśca bhavitumutsahate
yadi hi tat palālaṃ na tarhi tadeva dahyate, avipariṇatatvāt, prāgavasthāvat
vipariṇamamānaṃ ca palālameva tanna bhavati, vipariṇāmaśabdasya bhāvāntaravācitvāt
tasmād yāvat tat palālaṃ tāvanna dahyate yadā dahyate tadā palālaṃ na bhavatītyato naitāvekasyārthasya pratyāyanāya samyagjñānopajanakāraṇam, śabdāntarāpattyasahiṣṇutvāt pramattagītāvetāviti
evaṃ ghaṭadyudāharaṇabhāvanā kāryā

tato nārakādyāyurvedanaprathamasamaye eva nārakādivyapadeśaṃ labhate
etacca ṛjusūtranayadarśanam
tathā ca nayavidbhiḥ ṛjusūtranayanirūpaṇaṃ kurvadbhiridamuktam--palālaṃ na dahatyagnirbhidyate na ghaṭaḥ kvacit
nāśūnye na śūnyād ? niṣkramo'stīha na ca śūnyaṃ praviśyate
1
nārakavyatiriktaśca narake nopapadyate
narakānnārakaścāsya na kaścid vipramucyate
2
ityādi
iti malayagirikṛtāyāṃ prajñāpanāsūtravṛttau 17
3
ṛju vartamānasamayaṃ vastu svarūpāvasthitatvāt, tadeva sūtrayati paricchinatti nātītānāgatam, tasyāsattvena kuṭilatvāt
tasya vacanaṃ padaṃ vākyaṃ vā, tasya vicchedo'ntaḥ sīmeti yāvat
...
...
...
tasya ca pūrvāparaparyāyairvivikte ekaparyāya eva prarūpayato vacanaṃ vicchidyate ekaparyāyasya paraparyāyāsaṃsparśāt
uktaṃ ca tanmatamarthaṃ prarūpayadbhiḥ--palālaṃ na dahatyagnirdahyate na giriḥ kvacit
nāsaṃyataḥ pravrajati bhavyajīvo na sidhyati
palālaparyāyasya agnisadbhāvaparyāyādatyantabhinnatvāt yaḥ yaḥ palālo nāsau dahyate yaśca bhasmabhāvamanubhavati nāsau palālaparyāya iti
iti abhayadevasūriviracitāyāṃ sammativṛttau 1
5
"tatra ṛjusūtraḥ kuṭilātītānāgataparihāreṇa vartamānakṣaṇāvacchinnavastusattāmātram ṛju sūtrayati anyato vyavacchinatti sūtrapātavat
na hyatītamanāgataṃ vāsti
yadi syātāmatītānāgate na tarhi mṛtaputrikā yuvatiḥ putrakamuddiśya rudyāt na ca putrārthinī yoṣit aupayājikādi viśiṣṭadevatāsannidhau vidadhyāt
taddhi vastu vartamānakṣaṇāvasthāyyeva, na jātucit tataḥ paraṃ sattāmanubhavati, nāpi atītakālāsāditātmalābhaṃ kiñcit tatrānveti, svakāraṇakalāpasāmagrīsannidhāvutpadya svarasabhaṅguratāmavalambante tatkṣaṇamātrāvalambinaḥ sarvasaṃskārāḥ
evaṃ ca sati ya ete kartṛbhūtadravyaśabdasannidhau kriyāśabdāḥ prayujyante yathā devadattaḥ pacati paṭhati gacchatīti karmabhūtadravyaśabdasannidhau vā yathā ghaṭo bhidyate ghaṭaṃ vā bhinattityevamādayo na yathārthāḥ
katham ? yato nāmaśabdena avikṛtarūpasya dravyasyābhidhānāt kriyāśabdena ca vikārasya pratipādyatvāt, na ca vikārāvikārayoraikādhikaraṇyamasti viruddhatvāt
arthapratyāyanāya hi prayuktaḥ śabdo viruddhamarthaṃ pratipādayan naiva samyagjñānamādhatte, ayathārthatvāt, mṛgatṛṣṇāyāṃ salilaśabdavaditi
uktārthasaṃvādī ca śloko gītaḥ purāvidā--palālaṃ na dahatyagnirbhidyate na ghaṭaḥ kvacit
nāsaṃyataḥ pravrajati bhavyo'siddho na sidhyati
palālaṃ dahyata iti yad vyavahārasya vākyaṃ tad virudhyate
atravākye vākyārthapratipattaye padārthapravibhāgakāle palālaśabdo viśiṣṭākāradravyavacano nāmaśabdaḥ, taddhi dravyaṃ yāvat tasminnevākāre vartate tāvadeva palālaśabdavācyam
anyadā tu palālabhāvena tasyābhāva eva, tadbhāvenābhāvāt, paṭavat
tasmāt sthirarūpamavyāpāramudāsīnamavikṛtaṃ palālaśabdena vastu pratipāditam, kathaṃ tadeva dahyate ityanena śabdenocyeta, kriyāśabdasya vikārābhidhāyitvāt ? na hi sa evārtho vikāraścāvikāraśca bhavitumutsahate
yadi hi tat palālaṃ na tarhi tadeva dahyate, avipariṇatatvāt, prāgavasthāvat
vipariṇamamānaṃ ca palālameva tanna bhavati, vipariṇāmaśabdasya bhāvāntaravācitvāt
tasmād yāvat tat palālaṃ tāvanna dahyate yadā dahyate tadā palālaṃ na bhavatītyato naitāvekasyārthasya pratyāyanāya samyagjñānopajanakāraṇam, śabdāntarāpattyasahiṣṇutvāt pramattagītāvetāviti
evaṃ ghaṭadyudāharaṇabhāvanā kāryā
" iti siddhasenaganiviracitāyāṃ tattvārthabhāṣyavyākhyāyām 5
31
palālaṃ na dahatyagnirbhidyate na ghaṭaḥ kvacit
nāsaṃyataḥ pravrajati bhavyo'siddho na sidhyati
31
iti yaśovijayopādhyāyaviracite nayopadeśe
sūtrapātavadṛjutvādṛjusūtraḥ

...
...samayamātramasya nirdidikṣitam
kaṣāyo bhaiṣajyam ityatra ca sañjātarasaḥ kaṣāyo bhaiṣajyam, na prāthamikakaṣāyo'lpo'nabhivyaktarasatvādasya viṣayaḥ
pacyamānaḥ pakvaḥ, pakvastu syāt pacyamānaḥ syāduparatapāka iti
...
...evaṃ kriyamāṇakṛta--bhujyamānabhukta--badhyamānabaddha-sidhyatsiddhādayo yojyāḥ
tathā pratiṣṭhante'sminniti prasthaḥ, yadaiva mimīte, atītānāgatadhānyamānāsambhavāt
kumbhakārābhāvaḥ, śivakādiparyāyakaraṇe tadabhidhānābhāvāt, kumbhaparyāyasamaye ca svāvayavebhya eva nirvṛtteḥ
sthitapraśne ca kuto'dyāgacchasi iti ? na kutaścit ityayaṃ manyate tatkālakriyāpariṇāmābhāvāt
...
...ataḥ palālādidāhābhāvaḥ prativiśiṣṭakālaparigrahāt
asya hi nayasyāvibhāgo vartamānasamayo viṣayaḥ agnisambandhanadīpanajvalanadahanāni asaṅkhyeyasamayāntarālāni yato'sya dahanābhāvaḥ
kiñca, yasmin samaye dāhaḥ na tasmin palālam bhasmatābhinirvṛtteḥ, yasmiṃśca palālaṃ na tasmin dāha iti
yat palālaṃ tad dahatīti cet, na, sāvaśeṣāt
samudāyābhidhāyināṃ śabdānāmavayaveṣu vṛttidarśanādadoṣa iti cet, na, tadavasthatvāt, ekadeśadāhābhāvasyoktatvāt
niravaśeṣadāhāsambhavāditi cet, na, vacanavirodhāt tadavasthatvācca
vacanavirodhastāvat yadi niravaśeṣasya palālasya dāhasyāsambhava ityekadeśadāhāt palāladāho nādāhaḥ nanu bhavadvacanasya niravaśeṣaparapakṣadūṣakatvābhāvāt parapakṣaikadeśasya dūṣakatvam, ataḥ ekadeśadūṣakatvāt kṛtsnamapīdaṃ dūṣakamevetyasya sādhakatvasāmarthyābhāva iti
tadavasthatvamapi ekasamaye dāhābhāvaḥ ityuktatvāt
avayavānekatve yadyavayavadāhāt sarvatra dāho'vayavāntarādāhāt nanu sarvadāhābhāvaḥ
atha dāhaḥ sarvatra, kasmānnādāhaḥ ? ato na dāhaḥ
evaṃ pānabhojanādivyavahārābhāvaḥ
na śuklaḥ kṛṣṇībhavati, ubhayorbhinnakālāvasthatvāt pratyutpannaviṣaye nivṛttaparyāyānabhisambandhāt
sarvasaṃvyavahāralopa iti cet, na, viṣayamātrapradarśanāt
pūrvanayavaktavyāt saṃvyavahārasiddhirbhavati
iti tattvārtharājavārtike 1
33
tiṣṭhaṃtiga॰bhā॰
bhāvato'saṃyata ityādi, anādikālasambaddhadarśanacāritramohanīyodayajāyā avirateḥ pṛthagbhāvaḥ pravrajyā prakarṣavrajanaṃ viratiḥ, sā kathamasaṃyate ghaṭate ? evameveti ekasya bhāvābhāvātmakatvādhikārānuvṛttyā bhāvataḥ siddha-bhavyakālabhedādayuktamityudāharati
nārakādyāyuḥprathamasaṃvedanakāle eva nārakādivyapadeśo bhavati ṛjusūtranayadarśanena
yata uktaṃ nayavidbhiḥ ṛjusūtrasvarūpanirūpaṇaṃ kurvadbhiḥ--palālaṃ na dahatyagnirbhidyate na ghaṭaḥ kvacit
na śūnyānnirgamo'stīha na ca śūnyaṃ praviśyate

132, athavā sarvaśaktirartho vyavasthitaḥ, tasya pratiniyataśaktyabhidhānaṃ śabdeneti navamaṃ pakṣaṃ darśayitumatraivoktam--sarvaśaktervā iti

yā etā gati-sthiti-jalpi-cintyādidhātuvācyāḥ kriyā bāhyārthaśaktyabhimatāḥ tadvān vāsau bāhyo'rtho'stu aśaktireva vā dvayorapi śaktimadaśaktipakṣayostāḥ kriyādiśaktayo niyatā eva jalpanādi manuṣyādīnāmeva, sarpaṇaplavanādyāḥ sarpaśakunādīnāmeva iti, sarvā eva tu ekasya kasyacidarthasya anekāḥ śabdaireva prakalpitāḥ śabdaśaktyutthāpitā ityarthaḥ

dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 591 paṃ॰ 6
niruktyartho'pyabhijalpasya tathā ghaṭate nānyathā, japa jalpa vyaktāyāṃ vāci pā॰ dhā॰ 397, 398, ābhimukhyena jalpatyarthaṃ śabdaḥ, taṃ prayuṅkte'rthaḥ abhijalpayati, tadviṣaya evābhijalpa ityucyate, yadyābhimukhyenāvasthitamarthaṃ jalpati tato jalpaḥ śabdaḥ, so'rtho viṣayo'sya tadviṣaya evābhijalpaḥ śabdaḥ, etaduktaṃ bhavati--arthaviṣayaḥ śabdaḥ śabdārthakalpanāyāṃ yuktataraḥ syāt, arthotthāpitaśabdābhijalpatvapakṣe'bhijalpaśabdārthaparikalpanā yuktatarā syāt, na tu tvatparikalpite śabdaprerite
evaṃ tāvad bhartṛharyādidarśanamayuktam
yattu vasurāto bhartṛharerupādhyāyaḥ sa ca svarūpānugatamarthamantaravibhāgena saṃniveśayatītyāha tena dvāvapi śabdo'rthaścābhyupagatau
na tu sa tena śabdanayenābhihitānanyānyaliṅgādisāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvādidoṣān parihartuṃ śaknoti
nanu śabdānugatārthamantaravibhāgena iti bruvatā arthatantraḥ śabdo'bhihitaḥ, na śabdatantro'rthaḥ
tato'rthatantratvācchabdapravṛtteḥ tadavasthā doṣāḥ
pṛ॰ 581 paṃ॰ 7
yathā ca rūpādaya ekaikabhavanātmakā na paryāyāntaramapekṣante viśeṣatvāt tathā puṣyatārānakṣatrādipuṃliṅgādayaḥ parasparavirodhitvād viśeṣāṇāmiti kutaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam ?
yattu vasurāto bhartṛharerupādhyāyaḥsa ca svarūpānugatam ityādyāha tena dvāvapi śabdo'rthaścābhyupagatau, sambandhasya dviṣṭhatvāt sambandhinorabhyupagatiḥ
prācyādatyandhadarśanāt taimirikadarśanamidaṃ tattvadṛṣṭiṃ pratyāsīdati, na dūrāpayātam, abhijalpasvarūpaṃ tu punastenāpi nirastam
kiñca na tu sa tenetyādi
etasminnapi darśane yathā puṣyaśabdārthayorantaḥ sanniveśanamavibhāgena svaliṅgavacanakārakādibhedayorevamiṣṭālliṅgāderanyānyaliṅgādīni anyaśabdārthagatānyapi sanniveśayiṣyati sa iti sāmānyopasarjanaviśeṣapradhānavādinā śabdanayenābhihitāṃstatsāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvādidoṣān parihartumaśakta eva tathāpi
kasmāt ? nanu śabdānugatetyādi
svarūpamanugato'rthaḥ, tamarthamantaravibhāgena iti bruvatā arthatantraḥ śabdo'bhihito na śabdatantro'rthaḥ, yadyarthamanugataḥ śabdo'ntaravibhāgena sanniveśyeta tataḥ śabdapreritatvācchabdāvadhāraṇādartho vyudastaḥ syāt, kintu tadviparītaṃ śabdāvadhāraṇavyudasanādarthaprādhānyāva- lambanaṃ kṛtam
tato'rthatantratvāt arthapradhānatvācchabdapravṛtteḥ, pravartako hi śabdasyārthaḥ, tasmāt tadavasthā doṣāḥ
śabdaprādhānyāvadhāraṇe tu parihṛtāḥ syuḥ
tasmāduktavadeva viśeṣaprādhānyavāde'rthāntaranirapekṣāṇāṃ puṣya-tārā-nakṣatrādiviśeṣāṇāṃ nāsti sāmānādhikaraṇyam, ato viśeṣa eka eva vyavasthitaḥ

mañcaśabdo yathādheyaṃ mañceṣveva vyavasthitaḥ
tattvenāha tathā bhāvaśabdo dravyeṣu vartate
viśeṣa eva vastu paramārthato'sti, na dravyārthaḥ sāmānyam
tasyāsattvād viśeṣa eva svatantraḥ kalpitasāmānyopasarjanaḥ, mañcaśabdavat
itaśca tvanmativad bhedāt tadvato na vācakaḥ
bhinnā hi vyāvṛttimantaḥ kiṃ tarhi ? rājavadamātyaḥ iti bhinnaivābhedopacārā bhavati

syānmatam--guṇopakārāditi

kiñca, ayathārthajñānotpatteḥ, yathā sphaṭike raktatvādipratyayo mithyāpratyayastathā viśeṣaṇasarūpapratyayo viśeṣye syāt
kiñca, yugapadasambhavācca, yadā ca bahavo grahītāro bhavanti guṇavataḥ śuklādeḥ tadyathā--ghaṭaḥ pārthivo dravyaṃ sañchuklo madhuraḥ surabhiḥ ityevamādiviśeṣaistadā guṇopakāro virudhyate
na hi śakyaṃ tadā dravyeṇa ekaguṇarūpeṇa sthātum, anekātmakasyāviśiṣṭatvāt
nāpyekadeśena guṇarūpamanubhavituṃ śakyam, kṛtsnasya ghaṭādirūpapratīteḥ
atha punaḥ sarvairghaṭatvādibhirupakāro yugapat kṛtsnasya kriyate tataḥ sarveṣāṃ pratyekaṃ grahītṝṇāṃ ghaṭādirūpagrahaṇābhāvāt sarvaguṇasaṅkareṇa mecakadarśanam yugapat sarvarūpāpatteḥ syāt sphaṭikavadeva, na tu bhavati

tadabhāvamatra darśayituṃ yathā divā na bhuṅkta iti vaidharmyanidarśanam

ākṣepo nāstīti pramāṇaphalam

sa ca tatsāmānyāpekṣayā, na tu viśeṣāpekṣayā

te'pītyādi

...tathāhi--te pratyekaṃ svārthaviśeṣe saṃśayahetavaḥ

yasmād nīlotpalādiśabdāḥ pratyekaṃ svārthaviśeṣe sandehahetavaḥ sahitā eva niścayahetavaḥ, tasmāt sahitāḥ svārthaviśeṣaikārthavyañjakāḥ samānādhikaraṇabhūtāḥ
śabdāntarasahitaprakāśyārthāsambhavāccetyādi
śabdāntareṇa nīlādiśabdena sahitasya utpalaśabdasya prakāśyo viśiṣṭo'rthaḥ sa utpalaśabde kevale na sambhavati
evaṃ nīlaśabde'pi utpalaśabdena sahitasya yaḥ prakāśyaḥ sa kevale na sambhavatīti śabdāntarasānnidhyena viśiṣṭārthe pravṛtteḥ parasparaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ

...nanvekādhikaraṇaṃ yat taditi, vigrahakāle nīlaṃ ca tadutpalaṃ ca iti kriyate tasmāt pṛcchati
anena yaduktaṃ śabdāntarasahitenaiva śabdena viśeṣyārthaḥ prakāśyate ityatrābhyupagamabādhāmāha
na hi tat kevalaṃ nīlam iti kevalanīlaniṣedhena nīlaśabdamātravācyatvasya niṣedhaḥ
evaṃ na ca kevalamutpalamiti utpalaśabdamātravācyatvasya kevalasya
tathāhi--kevalanīlaśabdena kevalotpalaśabdena ca yadabhidhīyate tat kevalaṃ nīlaṃ kevalaṃ cotpalamiti prasiddham
kasmāt punaḥ nīlotpalaśabdābhyāṃ kevalābhyāṃ tannābhidhīyata iti ceducyate --samudāyābhidheyatvāditi
yasmāt sahitābhyāmeva nīlotpalaśabdābhyāṃ so'rtho'bhidhīyate na kevalābhyām, anyathā ekena tadarthasyābhihitatve paryāyaśabdavat tayoḥ saha prayogo nopapadyate
tato'nena vigrahakāle'pi sahitābhyāṃ nīlotpalaśabdābhyāṃ tadabhidhīyata ityabhyupagamād nābhyupagamabādheti darśayati
nanu kevalābhyāṃ kiṃ pratīyate iti cet, na kiñcidapi, yasmād varṇavat tannirarthakam
kathaṃ punaraṃśānāṃ nirarthakatve tatsamudāyasyārthavattvamiti ceducyate --yathetyādi
--viśālāmalavatī.VT.

athāsyaikadeśaṃghaṭaḥ ityaghaṭanivṛttyā gṛhṇāti ekaḥ, aparo'pārthivanivṛttyā deśaṃ pārthivaḥ iti gṛhṇātīti matam tadayuktamapratīteḥ, na hi nimittāntarairucyamānasya ekadeśapratītirdṛṣṭā yathā ācāryo mātula iti tathā na hi vyāvṛttisāmānyaśabdaistadvata ekadeśo vaktuṃ śakyaḥ
kasmāt ? atadasatvatsāmānyaviṣayatvāt
atasya anyasya vyāvṛttasya asattvam, tadasyāsti san ghaṭaḥ ityādisāmānye, sa viṣayo'sya śabdasya so'tadasatvatsāmānyaviṣayaḥ, yatrātadasatvatsāmānyaviṣayatvaṃ śabde tasyaikadeśo na śakyo vaktum
kimiva ? ācāryo mātula ityādinimittāntaroktaikadeśānuktivat
athāpi syādityādi paramatāśaṅkā
yathā vidhivādimatamāśaṅkyate tathāpohavādimatam --asadvyāvṛttijātimatītyādi śabdaviśeṣitagranthamarthatastulyaṃ yāvad nīlatama iti veti
asya vyākhyā— śabdaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati tatsāmānyaguṇatvāt tadvāciśabdasyāpi tadvyavacchedyaviṣayatvāt
yatra yatra tatsāmānyaguṇatvaṃ tatra tatra sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ dṛṣṭam, tadyathā ananyadravyavartini nīlaguṇe'nīlanivṛttisāmānyasya nīlatarādidravyavṛttitvāt taiḥ saha sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati nīlataro nīlatama iti vā
na, sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvasya tacchabdārthābhāvāt sampradhāryatvāt
yataśca nīlaśabdo'pi na dravyaṃ nīlatvenāha, kiṃ tarhi ? anīlavadabhāvam
tatra ca na nīlādibhedānāṃ kasyacidapi sambhavaḥ
anīlābhāvabhāvatvānneti cet, evaṃ vidhiśabdārthatā tarhi
yasmādevaṃ sato'pi na sāmānādhikaraṇyam, abhūtasāmānyaviśeṣatvāt
yadyapi tadvad ghaṭādi paṭādiṣu na vartate tathāpi ekatrātadvyāvṛttyādhāre vartate sattā, tato bahvarthāśaṅkāsti, tasyāṃ ca satyāṃ ghaṭādibhedavādibhiḥ śabdairyeṣu sā sattā vartate taistadvācibhiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti pratijñā
tatsāmānyaguṇatvāditi hetuḥ, sā sāmānyaguṇo yeṣāṃ te bahavo'rthāstatsāmānyaguṇāḥ, tadbhāvāt tatsāmānyaguṇatvāt
tadvāciśabdasyāpi tadvyavacchedyaviṣayatvāt, tayā sattayā vyavacchedyāḥ sarve viṣayā arthāḥ, te viṣayā asya śabdasya sa tadvyavacchedyaviṣayaḥ, tadbhāvāt tadvyavacchedya- viṣayatvāt
yatra yatretyādyupanayaḥ kāryaḥ
dṛṣṭāntaḥ --tadyathā ananyadravyavartinītyādi, anīletaro hi nīlaguṇo'nanyadravyavartī dravye nīlaguṇa eva vartate, nīlatarādiṣvavartamāne'pi tasmin nīlaguṇasāmānye anīlanivṛttisāmānyasya nīlatarādidravyavṛttitvāt taiḥ saha sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati, yathā nīlataraḥ paṭo nīlatama iti veti

evaṃ trayāṇāmavirodhitvaṃ yugapadabhidhāyedānīṃ pratyekaṃ darśayitumāha --paryāyaśabdasya ityādi
apohyastulya ityekārthatvamāha
yugapadaprayogādityekārthatvasādhanam
tadekārthīkṛtatvādubhayoraprayogaḥ
yatra śaktau satyāmapyubhayoraprayogastayorekārthatvam, yathā viśeṣayoḥ
ya ekārthāste'virodhino yathā dravye rūpādayo mitrāṇi vā
paryāyaśabdā apyekārthā iti vyāpakavirodhaḥ
ye'virodhinaste parasparato'pratikṣiptā yathā ta eva, paryāyaśabdā apyavirodhina iti vyāpakavirodha eva
svārthaśca pratikṣeptuṃ na yukta ityanapohatve hetvantaramāha
yo yasya svārthaḥ sa tena nāpohyate yathā vijñānena svārthaḥ, paryāyaśabdo'pi paryāyaśabdāntarasya svārthaḥ
sāmānyaśabdenāpītyādi
sāmānyaśabdasya vṛkṣaśabdasya yat svasāmānyaṃ vṛkṣatvaṃ tadviśeṣāḥ svabhedāḥ śiṃśapādayaḥ, teṣu arthāntarasya ghaṭādervṛkṣaśabdenāpoho bhedaśabdena śiṃśapāśabdena anumanyata eva arthitvāt
arthito hi śiṃśapāśabdena ghaṭādyapohaḥ
tadevārthitvaṃ darśayitumāha --yathetyādi
anena ghaṭādyapohenārthitvādekārthatvadyotakabhedaśabdaḥ sāmānyaśabdenāviruddha iti darśayati
yathā palāśādirūpaḥ śiṃśapāśabdārtho na bhavatīti palāśādayastatpratikṣepyā evaṃ ghaṭādirūpo'pi na bhavatīti ghaṭādayo'pyapohyāḥ
te ca vṛkṣaśabdenāpohyante
etenetyādinā svasāmānyasya vṛkṣatvasya yat sāmānyaṃ pārthivatvaṃ tacchabdaḥ pārthivaśabdaḥ sāmānyasāmānyaśabdaḥ tena yadapohyamāpyādi tacchiṃśapāśabdenāpyanumanyate, arthitvāt
yathā śiṃśapā na palāśādi evamāpyatvādyapi nāsti
...
...evaṃ sāmānyaśabda ityādi
yathā bhedaśabdo'virodhāt sāmānyaśabdārthaṃ na pratikṣipati evaṃ sāmānyaśabdo'pi sadādiḥ svārthaṃ sattādikam abhimataviṣaye sthāpayanniti bhedeṣvanavasthitatvāt sthāpayan guṇādito vyavacchinne dravyādau niveśayan...
...bhedaśabdena dravyādinā bhedabhedaśabdena vā pārthiva-vṛkṣa-śiṃśapādiśabdena kathaṃ nopekṣyate ? upekṣyata eva, arthitvāt svaviṣaye sthityā nirviṣayasvārthānupapatteḥ
etenābhimatārthasādhanād bhedaśabdaḥ sāmānyaśabdamupakurute
tataśca sāmānyaśabdastenāviruddha iti darśayati
samūhaścetyādi avirodhādapratikṣepe guṇotkarṣaṃ darśayati, athavā anyonyāpratikṣepe hetvantaramāha
parasparārthāpratikṣepe hi svārthaviśiṣṭārthavācakatvamupapadyate, nānyathā

na hi tat kevalaṃ nīlaṃ na ca kevalamutpalam pṛ॰ 630 paṃ॰ 22 ityādinā nīlotpalaśabdayoḥ samūhārthasya pratyekaṃ nairarthakyadarśanena samūhasyārthāntarābhidhāyakatvamuktam

sāmye caikārthatā tayoriti yatra sāmānyaviśeṣaśabdābhyāmubhayamaparihṛtamanupāttaṃ ca tatraikārthatvaṃ tatsāmānādhikaraṇyamityarthaḥ

kiṃ punaratretyādi
sāmānyayoḥ svasāmānyāpekṣayā bhedatvāt pṛthaganupādānam
bhedo bhedāntarārthamiti vṛkṣatvasya bhedaḥ śiṃśapādiḥ, parasparato bhidyata iti kṛtvā
atra viṣayeṇa viṣayinirdeśād bhedo bhedāntaraṃ ca śabda iti vijñeyam
bhedaśabdo bhedāntaraśabdārthamityarthaḥ
virodhitvāditi hetuḥ
sāmānyārthāpahāritvāditi virodhitvasya kāraṇam
rājaputravaditi dṛṣṭāntaḥ
rājaputrāṇāṃ pitari mṛte sāmānyārtho rājyam, tasya tairyathāsarvaparākramamapahṛtatvād virodhinaḥ, tataśca parasparārthaṃ na sahante
ye sāmānyārthāpahāriṇaste parasparavirodhinaḥ, rājaputravat, sāmānyaśabdā api tatheti svabhāvaḥ
ye virodhinaste parasparārthaṃ na sahante, tadvadeva, bhedaśabdā api tatheti vyāpakavirodhaḥ
yatheti sāmānyārthāpahāritvaṃ darśati
ekadravyāpahāritvāditi sāmānyārthāpahāritvasyaivānvākhyānam

...virodhaḥ parihāraheturuktaḥ, sa ca sāmānyārthāpahāritvāt
sāmānyāntarasya pārthivatvāderye bhedā ghaṭādayastadvācakaśabdaiḥ saha śiṃśapāśabdasyaikārthāpahāritvaṃ nāsti, kiṃ tarhi ? vṛkṣaśabdena
tasmāt parihārahetvabhāvānnāpoha iti manyamāna āha --athetyādi
śiṃśapāsāmānyaṃ vṛkṣatvam, tato'nyatvāt pārthivatvaṃ sāmānyāntaram, tadbhedo ghaṭādiḥ, so'sambaddhaḥ śiṃśapāśabdena virodhābhāvāt, tacchabdena śiṃśāpāśabdasyaikadravyāpahāritvamapi nāsti
tasmāt taṃ kuto'pohate ? avirodhādasyānapoha evetyarthaḥ
sāmānyāntarabhedārthā iti tameva apohakāraṇaṃ virodhaṃ darśayati
virodhasāmānyamapohasya kāraṇam
atra ca yadyapi na sākṣād virodhastathāpi paramparayāstyeva
taddarśayati --vṛkṣaśabdena tvityādi
tenetyādi
śiṃśapāśabdasya mitraṃ vṛkṣaśabdaḥ, tadarthasāmānyavācakatvāt
tacchatravo ghaṭādiśabdāḥ pārthivatvāpahāritvāt
tato vṛkṣaśabdena tena ghaṭādyapohaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ śiṃśapāśabdenānumanyate mitraśatruvat
arthatastat teneti śiṃśapāśabdārthaḥ śiṃśapāsāmānyam, taccāghaṭādirūpatvād ghaṭādito vyāvṛttam
tata evārthato gamyate
śiṃśapāśabdasya tatra vyāpāro nāsti tathāpi śiṃśapāśabdena tena ghaṭādyapoḍhamiti gamyate, tadgatyārthatastasyāpoḍhatvāt
eteneti anayā yuktyā pārthivatvasāmānyāt sāmānyāntaraṃ dravyatvam, tatsāmānyaṃ sattā, tadbhedā guṇāḥ karmāṇi ca, teṣāmapi bhedā rūpādaya utkṣepaṇādayaśca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ svavirodhisāmānyaśabdenāpoḍhā viśeṣaśabdenopekṣitāśca sambaddhasambandhād veditavyāḥ
kathamiti ceducyate— mitramitraśatruvadityādi
atra mitramitreti dviruktiḥ paramparayā mitrapratipādanecchayānatātparyeṇāvagantavyā, anyathā ekīkṛtenaiva mitreṇa mitrasya pratīteḥ
tatra guṇakarmaṇī śiṃśapāśabdena dravyaśabdenāpohyamānāni mitramitraśatruvadanumanyante
guṇaviśeṣā rūpādayaḥ karmaviśeṣāścotkṣepaṇādayastu śiṃśapāśabdena mitraśatrumitravad dravyaśabdena...
...apohyamānā upekṣyante
--viśālāmalavatī VT.

tulanā ṭipṛ॰ 84 paṃ॰ 13
nyāyamukhe'pi etadasti, tathāhi Prof.
Giuseppe Tucci ityebhirvihite English bhāṣānuvāde itthamupalabhyate--Some say; it is logical to admit only four kinds of reasons called inconclusive, because they are in both ways in the affirmative as well as in the negative instances.
But how can the cause: because sound is audible, be an inconclusive one ? I reply: because it is too--narrow asādhāraṇa.
When the predicate of the middle term is too narrow it includes all the possible varieties of the predicate to be proved.
Therefore it is absolutely a doubtful reason.
In fact it is merely included in the subject possessing that particular nature: thus it is deprived of one of the neccessary aspects of the reason, that is it does not reside in any positive instance.

yattūktaṃ na sarvatra liṅgini liṅgaṃ sambhavati yathā agniratra dhūmāt tadidamapyaprekṣyavāditayā
yadi liṅgyeva tat sarvaṃ kathaṃ tasya liṅgaṃ nāsti ? atha nāsti liṅgaṃ kathaṃ tadvān
dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 652 paṃ॰ 13, pṛ॰ 662 paṃ॰ 1
agnidhūmodāharaṇe ca agniratra iti nirdeśādagnimattvena deśasya sādhyatvādagnimati pradeśe sarvatra dhūmavattvaṃ liṅgamastyeva
cāgninānuba॰ya॰
liṅge tvayaṃ punarviśeṣaḥ --liṅgānubandhinastvarthā ityādiślokaḥ
pūrvodāhṛtāḥ sāmānyadharmāḥ sattvādayo liṅgasya dhūmasya na gamayanti, uktakāraṇatvāt
viśeṣāstu kecid liṅgyavinābhāvinaḥ pratītāḥ pratipādakāḥ pāṇḍutva-bahulatvādaya iti
॰stvārthā pra॰
etat punaḥ kathaṃ pūrvavadalakṣaṇam ? ityata āha --kimaṅgamityādi ślokatrayaṃ kṣepaprastāreṇopanyastaṃ samastasya tvaduktasyārthajātasya pūrvoktena na bhavati, na bhavati ityabhavanaparamārthatvāt khapuṣpavadabhāvena gamyagamakaniyamo nāstyeveti gatārtham

prepaprastāre॰ ya॰

tad vyācaṣṭe --yadi liṅgyevetyādi
liṅgamasyāstīti liṅgi, yadi tat sarvaṃ liṅgi bhasmāṅgārāyoguḍapākādyagnyākhyaṃ vastu kathaṃ tasya liṅgaṃ nāsti liṅgābhāve liṅgitvasyaivābhāvāt ? matvarthīyanirdeśyasya liṅgitvābhyupagamādeva liṅgāstitvamityabhiprāyaḥ
atha nāsti liṅgaṃ kathaṃ tadvān ? liṅgamasyāsti iti liṅgavān liṅgītyarthaḥ, matvarthīyanirdeśyo na bhavitumarhati so'rthastannimittatvābhāvāditi svavacanavirodhi te vacanamiti

asya viśālāmalavatī vyākhyā--idaṃ punarvaktavyamityādi
svādisambandhinaḥ svatvādirūpeṇaiva āhosvid rūpāntareṇa grahaṇaṃ syāt ? yadi svatvādirūpeṇa svam ityevaṃ gṛhyate tarhi svāmisambandhitvāt svasya svāmyabhāve svatvasyānupapatteḥ svāminiścayāpekṣatvāt liṅgadarśanāt pūrvameva svāmipratipattyā bhavitavyam, anyathā idamasya svam ityevaṃ grahaṇaṃ na sambhavati
tataścottarakālaṃ sambandhasmṛtiranarthikā syāt, svāminaḥ prāgeva siddhatvāt śeṣānupapatteḥ
śeṣeṇa siddheścānumānatvasyeṣṭatvāt
athānyathā prakārāntareṇa grahaṇamiṣyate tannoktamiti lakṣaṇasyāparipūrṇatvam
liṅgagrahaṇe tulyamiti yadyavinābhāvitvena liṅgaṃ gṛhyate avinābhāvitvamapi pratiyogyantarāpekṣameveti liṅgagrahaṇāt pūrvameva sādhyapratipattyā bhavitavyam
tathā ca sādhye pratiyogini siddhe sambandhasmṛterānarthakyam
athānyathā, tannoktamiti tulyam
na, tasyetyādi
anumeyasthamiti
dharmiṇi dhūmādeḥ sattvamātraṃ gṛhyate, na sambandhitvamiti
kadā tarhi tad gṛhyata ityāha --paścādityādi
avyutpannasya tadgateriti svasvāmisambandhādyanabhijñasyāpi śeṣapratipatterityarthaḥ
kathaṃ punastadgatirityāha --dṛṣṭa ityādi
kāryakāraṇabhāvasambandhe hi yathā kāryakāraṇabhāvasambandhaḥ śāstre vivecitaḥ tathaivāpratītatvamatra vivakṣitam, na sarvatheti vedyam
śāstre hyekasyaiva bhāvasya svarūpātyāgāt pariṇāmena kāryakāraṇabhāvo vyavasthāpyate
ya evaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvasambandhaṃ na pratipādayanti te'pyanyathā taṃ pratipadya avinābhāvitvamātropalabdheranumeyaṃ niścinvanti
śāstradṛṣṭaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo'nupapanna eva
yasmāt kāryakāraṇayorekatve idaṃ kāryamidaṃ kāraṇamityetadeva na syāt
atha tayoryenaivaṃ svabhāvātiśayaḥ kaścidasti, bhedaprasaṅgaḥ
sattvādiṣvapi svabhāvabheda eva bhinnaprakārāntarakāraṇam
nanu kāryakāraṇabhāvatve satyapi na bhedaḥ, traiguṇyajātyabhedādekatvamiti cet; na, kāryakāraṇābhyāṃ bhinnasya traiguṇyasyānupalakṣaṇāt
nityasya krameṇa yugapadvā pariṇāmo na sambhavati
tatastatkāraṇavatkāryakāraṇavyavasthā kuta ityalaṃ prasaṅgena
syādetat--so'gṛhīta eva tadanumānasya kāraṇamityāha --netyādi sugamam
nāvaśyamityādi
nanu svasvarūpasiddhiḥ svāmyapekṣaiva, tadvyabhicāraḥ kuta iti cet, ayamāśayaḥ--anumānakāla eva svatvena gṛhītaṃ liṅgaṃ pratiyoginaṃ pratipādayati, āhosvit sambandhagrahaṇakāle tathā paricchinnamanumānakāle cānyathopalabhyamānamiti
yadyanumānakāle idamasya svam ityevaṃ niścitaṃ gamakamiṣyate, atrokto doṣaḥ--svāmisambandhitvāt svatvasya pṛ॰ 683 paṃ॰ 31 ityādinā
tasmād dvitīyaṃ darśanamabhyupagantavyam, tataśca vyabhicāraḥ, svasvāminoḥ paramparayā vyatirekabhāvasambhavāt tathā'numātuṃ na śakyate--atrātmanā tat pūrvaṃ svatvena gṛhītaṃ tasmād yatredamasti tatrāsya svāmī niyamena bhavitumarhatīti
bhūpateḥ sampattyādyabhāve'pi kevalasya chatrāderadhipatyabhāve ca darśanasambhavāt
evamanyatrāpi yathāsambhavaṃ vyabhicāraḥ kalpanīyaḥ
syādetat--svasvāmibhāvādinā sarvaḥ sambandho na gamakaḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? yatrāvyabhicāra ityāha --upalabdhasambandhasya netyādi
yadi yathoktasambandhagrahaṇe'pi punarliṅgasya vyabhicāritvamavyabhicāritvaṃ cāpekṣate tato'vinābhāvitvamevānumānasya kāraṇaṃ bhavet, na svasvāmyādisambandhāḥ
avinābhāvasyānumānakāraṇatve syādetat, sa yathoktasambandhe sati bhavati, tato nirdeśa iti cet, tadayuktam, tasmin satyapi tadabhāvāt sambandhasyāviśiṣṭatvāditi nimittanaimittikasambandho dviṣṭha iti sa yathaikatra tathā dvitīye'pīti ubhayatra gamakabhāvaḥ syāt

saṃyogivad vidhivṛttyā gamayati, atra ca pakṣe guṇānabhyadhāma
yat punarniruktīkṛtyānvayāsambhavaṃ vyatirekāsambhavamāśaṅkyoktaṃ syādetad vyatirekasyāpyasambhavaḥ iti, tad yuktamevoktam, anvayavyatirekayorabhāvāt

tāvadityādiruktārthopasaṃhāraḥ

sa ca pratiṣedhaḥ

dṛśyatāṃ pṛ॰ 674--675
gamyante te'pi liṅgena ye liṅginyanubandhinaḥ
viśeṣā na tu gamyante tasyaiva vyabhicāriṇaḥ || 2 | 17 1/2
liṅgānubandhinastvarthā gamayanti na liṅginam
vyabhicārād viśeṣāstu pratītāḥ pratipādakāḥ || 2 | 18 1/2 || ityantaraślokau
asya jinendrabuddhinā racitā viśālāmalavatī ṭīkāpi bhoṭabhāṣānuvādāt saṃskṛte parivartyehopanyasyate --anubandhivyavaccheda iti
anubandhinā sambandhinā yenāṃśenāgniḥ pratīyate tasya dravyatvādeḥ vipakṣādanyasmād vyavacchedo vyāvṛttiḥ pratīyate
ke punaranubandhino viśeṣā iti cet, yadabhāve'gnirna bhavatītyādi
nanu dhūmasya prakāśakatvād yadabhāve dhūmo na bhavati iti vaktavyam, kuta evamucyata iti cet; ayamevārtho'nena prakāreṇokta iti na doṣaḥ
tathāhi--yadabhāve'gnirna bhavati tadabhāve dhūmo'pi na bhavatyeva
athavā ye sambandhina iti dhūmasyaivānubandhina iti yojyam
ye dhūmasyaivānubandhinastāneva darśayitumāha --yadabhāve ityādi
yadabhāve'gnirna bhavati ta eva dhūmasyānubandhinaḥ
anubandhināmanyasmād vyāvṛttiḥ pratīyata ityatrodāharaṇamāha --yathāgneranagnito vyāvṛttimātramityādi
kasmād vyāvṛttimātraṃ gamyate na viśeṣa ityāha— svasambandhānurūpyādityādi
ayaṃ kārako hetuḥ, na liṅgam
tathāhi--ayamiti tatsambandhānurūpyamāha
anagnau sarvatra na dṛṣṭa ityanena vyāvṛtteḥ prādhānyaṃ vipakṣe sarvatrādarśanena kathayati anyatra ca dṛṣṭa iti caśabdena kvacidadarśanamapīti dyotanenānvayāprādhānyam
evaṃ yasmādanvaya upacarito vyāvṛttistu mukhyaḥ sambandhaḥ sa ca sāmānyenaiva sambhavati na viśeṣeṇa tasmāt tadānurūpyād vyāvṛttidvāreṇa atrāgnireva, nānagnirbhavati iti anagnito vyāvṛttimātraṃ pratīyate na viśeṣaḥ
yathā cāgnitvena sambandha evaṃ dravyatvaguṇitvādibhirapīti teṣāmapyadravyatvādibhyo vyāvṛttireva pratīyate
vyāvṛttidvāreṇaiva heturgamaka ityatra hetvantaramāha— guṇatva-gandha-saurabhya-tadviśeṣairityādi
ekavṛddhyeti ekaikavṛddhyetyarthaḥ
guṇatvena adravyāditi idaṃ dravyaṃ guṇatvāt iti guṇatvenādravyavyavaccheda utpalādau kriyate
tathāhi--tat sarvatrādravye na dṛṣṭam, dravye dṛṣṭam
atrādravyavyavaccheda ādye na vṛddhirekasmin
yadapekṣayā gandhenaikavṛddhyā vyavacchedaḥ kriyate tatpradarśanārthaṃ guṇatvena adravyāt ityuktam
ata eva guṇatvasyāpyekavṛddhyā vyavacchedaṃ prati aṅgabhāvo'sti
yadi tenādravyavyavacchedo vidhīyate tarhi gandhenaikavṛddhyā vyavacchedaḥ kriyate, nānyathā
tathā ca kārikāyāṃ dvandvasamāsāntatvena guṇatvaśabdasyāvirodhaḥ padāntareṇa tulyasāmarthyāt
gandhatvenāpārthivādadravyatvācceti idaṃ pārthivaṃ dravyaṃ ca gandhatvāt iti apārthivādadravyācca vyavacchedaḥ kriyate
saurabhyeṇa asurabhisādhāraṇāditi saurabhyeṇa pūrvābhyāmasurabhisādhāraṇācca vyavacchedaḥ kriyate
gandhaviśeṣasurabhisādhāraṇaṃ sāmānyaṃ surabhisādhāraṇam, yad na surabhisādhāraṇaṃ tat tathoktam
gandhābhāva ityarthaḥ
saurabhyaviśeṣa utpalādau gandhaviśeṣaḥ
evamadravyādivyavaccheda ekaikavṛddhyotpalādiṣu guṇatvādibhiḥ kriyamāṇo dṛṣṭaḥ
sa katham ? yadi vipakṣād vyāvṛttidvāreṇa heturgamakaḥ, anyathā na yujyate
dṛṣṭavad vidhidvāreṇa sarvatra sarveṣāṃ draṣṭṝṇāṃ nirviśeṣatvāt samānā pratītiḥ syāt
tasmāt vyāvṛttidvāreṇaiva heturgamaka ityabhyupagantavyam
ye tannecchanti tān pratyāha --dṛṣṭavadityādi
dṛṣṭena tulyaṃ dṛṣṭavat
yathā pūrvaṃ sambandhakāle liṅgamupalabdhaṃ tathā yadi prakāśayedityarthaḥ
vidhirūpeṇa agniratra bhavati iti, na vyatirekarūpeṇa atrāgnireva, nānagniḥ ityevam
sarvatrādarśanāt prakāśanaṃ na syāditi vijñeyam, prakāśayet ityasya prakṛtatvāt yadi ca yathāgnau dṛṣṭa ityādi
yadyevamabhyupagamyate vidhivādinā yasmādagnāveva dhūmo dṛṣṭaḥ, nānagnau, tasmāt pratyāyayati iti, tathā sati pratiṣedhadvāreṇaiva prakāśayet
tasmāt tenaivamabhyupagantavyaṃ yasmādagnau dṛṣṭa eva, nādṛṣṭaḥ, tasmāt sa taṃ gamayati iti
tataśca naiva prakāśayet
yasmāt sa sarvatrāgnau na dṛṣṭaḥ, deśāvasthādibhinne sarvatrāgnau darśanasyāsambhavāt
yadi ceti doṣāntaramāha
yadā dhūmo'gnau dṛṣṭastadā dīptyādiviśeṣāṇāmanyatareṇa yukta eva dṛṣṭaḥ
tataśca te'pi prakāśyeran
tathā ca na
tasmāddarśanamātramanumeyapratīterna kāraṇam, tadbhāve'pi tadabhāvāditi
nanu pratiṣedhavādināpi darśanamiṣyata eva, tathāhi--kāryatvenāvinābhāvitvād dhūmo hutabhujo hetuḥ, kāryakāraṇabhāvaśca darśanādarśanābhyāṃ sahitābhyāṃ sidhyati na kevalādadarśanāditi cet, ucyate --yasmādityādi
etad darśayati--yasmād dhūmenāgniḥ sāmānyarūpeṇa prakāśyate, na dīptyādiviśeṣarūpeṇa, tasmāt kāryakāraṇabhāvasiddhaye vidhināpi tadevāsya rūpaṃ dṛṣṭamiti kāryakāraṇavyapadeśasiddheḥ kāraṇatvena pratīyate, na viśeṣarūpamityāśayaḥ
dīptyādiviśeṣadarśanaṃ kāryakāraṇavyapadeśasiddherna kāraṇam, tadabhāve'pi dhūmadarśanāt

yadyapītyanena tadabhāva eva, tathāpyabhyupagamya doṣa ucyate ityetad darśayati

sādṛśyasyāpi neti āśrayādabhinnatvāt sādṛśyasya bhedenopanyāsaḥ

saṃśayo na syāt śauklyaikātmyāt
vyāvṛttiprādhānye tu— dṛṣṭavad yadi siddhiḥ syācchauklyarūpaguṇāśritāt

pra॰ samu॰ 3
44 iti
tadapi dṛṣṭānuvṛtterityādi ślokaḥ, krameṇa dvitryekārthagativat prātilomye dvitryekārthagatirna bhavati tathā darśanādadarśanācceti
tadvyākhyā--dṛṣṭānuvṛttereva nādṛṣṭāvacchedāt nādṛṣṭānanuvṛtterānulomyād niścayaḥ prātilomyādvā saṃśayaḥ
kasmāt ? yatastatra tulye'nyatve śuklatvād guṇe niścayo dravya-karmaṇorneti, tayoścāpoho na sattva-guṇayoḥ
śauklya-rūpādīnāmaikātmyād niścayaḥ, darśanādeva caikānekātmabhyāmāśritaguṇa-rūpādibhirguṇa-rūpa-śauklyeṣu saṃśaya iti
dṛṣṭavad yadi siddhiḥ syācchauklyarūpaguṇāśritāt
yadi yathā dṛṣṭaṃ tathā pratīyate na vyavacchedadvāreṇa tarhi yathā krameṇa śauklyena trayāṇāṃ rūpatva-guṇatvā-''śritatvānāṃ pratītirbhavati, guṇatvād dvayo rūpā-''śritatvayoḥ, guṇatvāccaikasyāśritatvasya, evaṃ prātilomyenāpi āśritatvāt trayāṇāṃ guṇatvarūpatva-śauklyānāṃ syāt guṇatvād dvayo rūpatva-śauklyayoḥ rūpatvāccaikasyaiva śauklyasya
na hi āśritatvādayo guṇatvādiṣu na dṛṣṭāḥ
atha yathā āśritatvaṃ guṇatvādiṣu dṛṣṭaṃ tathā karmādiṣvapīti sandeho bhavati, śauklyamapi rūpa-guṇā-''śriteṣu dṛṣṭamityatasteṣu sādhāraṇatvāt sandehaḥ syāt
vyāvṛttidvāreṇa pratītau tu na doṣaḥ
yathā guṇatvābhāve'bhāvācchauklyaṃ rūpatve hetuḥ tathā guṇatvāśritatvayorapi tayorabhāve'bhāvāditi
āśritatvaṃ tu guṇatvādyabhāve'pi dṛṣṭamiti nāsti tasmād guṇatvādiniścayaḥ
— viśālāmalavatī pramāṇasamuccayaṭīkā VT.

sāmānyaśabdasya hi yo'rthāntaravyudāso vyāpāraḥ sa svabhedāpratikṣepeṇa pra॰ samu॰ vṛ॰ 5
36 iti vāṅmātreṇoktam
sa svabhedapratikṣepeṇaiva, tasya sanniyamārthatvādasatpratiṣedhasyābhāvatvāt bhedānāṃ parasparataḥ sadasattvāt bhedaśrutyā saha sāmānādhikaraṇyamanupapannam
sambandhasyāpi bhedairabhāvasyānupapatteḥ kasya vā te bhedāḥ ? tasmādapṛthakchrutidoṣo'styeva
sukaro hi śabdasyānyāpohena sambandhaḥ, śabdo jātimātrasya tadyogasya vā na vācako bhedārthairapṛthakchruteḥ
tathā hi sad dravyaṃ san guṇaḥ sat karma iti bhedārthairdravyādiśabdaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na syāt, tacca dṛṣṭam

tasmādatulyavikalpatvāt sato'nyasvabhāvameva kāryam
evaṃ tu anāvirbhāvyatvād na pratyakṣavyaktayaḥ pṛthivyādayaḥ pratiniyatacakṣurādyaviṣayatvāt khapuṣpavat
rūpādyeva tu yat kiñcit pratyakṣam, svata evāvirbhavitṛtvāt, itaravat
pratyakṣatvādyavirodhāt tadeva bhavati
athaivamubhayasattvaṃ tyaktvānyatarasattvaṃ kāryāsattvābhyupagamaparihāreṇa kāryameva saditi
tatra kāryasamīpa evakāra ityanyatra sacchabdārthe tatpratiyogini niyamaḥ sattvaṃ kārya eva niyataṃ
punaridānīṃ bhūmyādiprādurbhāvatulyaṃ rūpādiprādurbhāvaṃ kāryāsattvabhayādicchatastathaiva bhūmyādikāryāsattvaṃ sadvailakṣaṇyādasvarūpotpatterutthāpya tatparyavasānameva cakrakaṃ tadviparyayeṇa yāvad bhūmyādivaditi gamanīyam
tasmādatulyavikalpatvāt sato'nyasvabhāvameva kāryamityupasaṃhārārthaḥ
kiñcānyat, evaṃ tvityādi
rūpādiṣu viṣayeṣu cakṣurādīnāṃ pratiniyataṃ grahaṇaṃ cakṣuṣā rūpameva, jihvayā rasa meeva ityādi grahaṇaṃ vyaktiravirbhāvaḥ sa na syāt, cakṣurādyaviṣayatvāt, rūpādaya eva hi pratisvaṃ niyatāścakṣurādīnāṃ viṣayāḥ, pṛthivyādayastu na prativiviktarūpādisvatattvā ityanāvirbhāvyāḥ, tasmādanāvirbhāvyatvād na pratyakṣavyaktayaḥ pṛthivyādayaḥ pratiniyatacakṣurādyaviṣayatvāt khapuṣpavat
ādigrahaṇādanumānādyaviṣayatāpīti rūpādisamudāyasyāvastutetthamuktā
rasameva gṛhṇāti iti vivakṣāyāṃ yathāśrutamapi sādhu
rūpādyeva tvityādi
yat kiñcit iti sāmānyavacanād viśeṣya pakṣīkriyate --rūpameva pratyakṣam, svata evāvirbhavitṛtvāt, itaravaditi sāmānyavacanād rasavaditi viśeṣya dṛṣṭāntaḥ
evaṃ śeṣāṇāmapi rasādīnāṃ viśeṣya pratyakṣatvamitaradṛṣṭāntasādhyatvādaviruddham
pratyakṣapūrvakatvādanumānatvādyavirodhaḥ
tasmāt pratyakṣatvādyavirodhāt tadeva bhavati rūpādyeva vastviti siddham
athaivaṃ doṣavadityubhayasattvapakṣamuktadoṣabhayāt tyaktvā anyataraṃ sat kāraṇaṃ rūpādi kāryaṃ vākāśādi itīṣyamāṇe kāryasadvādino me prātipakṣyeṇa kāryāsattvābhyupagame vādāvasānaṃ mā bhūditi kāryāsattvābhyupagamaparihāreṇa kāraṇasattvapakṣaṃ tyaktvā kāryasattvapakṣamekamevāśrayestvaṃ tataḥ kāryameva sat ityavadhāryamāṇaḥ pakṣaḥ syāt
tanmataṃ kaḥ punarvādī kāryameva sat, na kāraṇam iti pratipadyate nānyat saditi
tataśca rūpādi na sat
rūpāderasattve kāryasya sattve viparītā saṃjñā kriyate sato'saditi asataśca saditi
kāryasattvaṃ kharaviṣāṇādīnāṃ saditi nāmavad nāmamātrameva
kāryāsattvanivṛttyekāntatyāgāccābhyupagamavirodhavat svavacanādivirodhāḥ— yadi kāryaṃ kathaṃ sat ? atha sat kathaṃ kāryam ? kāraṇe kāryasattvanyāyāttu sa evobhayasattvavādaḥ, tatra coktā doṣāḥ
sadevakāre tu sadanavadhṛteḥ pūrvadoṣa eva
yasya siddhānte rūpādayo na syurākāśādaya eva syuḥ ? iti, atrocyate--tasyaiva ubhayasadvādinaḥ sāṅkhyasya kāraṇe kāryasattvasiddhāntād bhavedayaṃ pakṣaḥ, kāraṇāvinābhāvitvāt kāryasya kāryābhyupagame'bhyupagatameva kāraṇam, kintu na niyamyate kāraṇamasadeva sadeva vā iti, yadi syādastu ko vārayati ? kāryaṃ tu sattvena niyamyate
tatrāpi ca dvayī gatiḥ--kāryameva sat sadeva kāryamiti vā, tatra kāryameva sat iti kāryasamīpe evakāraḥ kriyate yata evakārastato'nyatrāvadhāraṇam iti kāryaṃ sadeva ityavadhāryamāṇe kāryasya sattvena niyamāt sattvasya kāryeṇāniyamāt kāraṇe'pi sattvamiti pūrvavicāritobhayasattvapakṣa eva āpatatītyavadhāraṇavaiphalyaṃ syāt, taccāniṣṭam, tasmādevakāraprayatnasāphalyāt kāryaśabdārthādanyatra sacchabdārthe tatpratiyogini niyamaḥ-- kāryameva saditi
taddarśayati --sattvaṃ kārya eva niyataṃ nānyat saditi
tataḥ kim ? tataśca rūpādi na saditi te prasaktam
tasya rūpādeḥ pratyakṣamupalabhyamānasyāsattve kāryasyāsataḥ pratyakṣādyanupalabhyasya sattve viparītā svamanīṣikayā saṃjñā kriyate sato'saditi asataśca saditi saṅgītyāgnimaṅgalanāmavat paścimāpaścimatvavat
yadapi ca kāryasattvaṃ kharaviṣāṇādīnāṃ sat iti nāmeti nāmavad nāmamātrameva nārtha iti

syānmatam--hrasve tarhi dīrghatā bhaviṣyati, tvaduktavidhinā hrasvāpekṣatvād dīrghatvasyānāmikāhrasvatvāyattā bhihi madhyamādīrghatā bhavitumarhati, ataḥ sidhyati dīrghatvaṃ tathā hrasvatvamitarāpekṣatvāditi
atrocyate --na hrasve'pi dīrghatvam, tatpratidvandvitvāt dīrghasya hrasvatvena virodhāt hrasvameva saṃvṛttam, tasya dīrghatvābhāvātmakatvāt kuto dīrghatvamāgatamanyat ? hrasvatvābhāvācca nāsti dīrghatvam
tathāpi punardīrghatvahrasvatvayorbhāvābhyupagame hrasvatvapratiyogino dīrghatvasyābhāvānna dīrghatvam
na dvaye, uktanyāyāt svaparayoḥ pratidvandvitvādvā
eṣo'pītaretarayogaścintyaḥ--kiṃ hrasve vartamāne dīrghatve dīrghaṃ bhavati uta dīrgha eva vartamāne ? yadi hrasve vartamānaṃ dīrghatvamubhayatra bhāvaṃ labhate tato hrasve vartamānaṃ dīrghatvaṃ hrasvasya tadātmatāṃ tatpratyayaṃ hrasvatva-dīrghatvayoḥ parasparavirodhāt tamaḥprakāśavat jīvita-maraṇavaccaikatra kuto bhāvaḥ ? tasya vā dīrghatve dīrghatvābhāvāt hrasvasyatasya dīrghatvābhyupagame dīrghādapasṛtya hrasve sthitaṃ dīrghatvaṃ hrasvameva saṃvṛttamiti prasaktamato dīrghatvābhāvaḥ
kasmāt ? tasya hrasvatvasya dīrghatvābhāvātmakatvāt
yaddhi loke dīrghaṃ na bhavati taducyate hrasvamiti
tasmāttasya dīrghatvābhāvātmakatvāt kuto dīrghatvamāgatamanyat ? hrasvatvābhāvācca nāsti dīrghatvam, dīrghatvasya hrasve vṛtterdīrghatvāvaṣṭabdhasyānavakāśāddhrasvatvasya hrasvābhāve kva dīrghatvaṃ varteta ? ato'pi dīrghatvābhāvaḥ

dīrghena hrasvatvenaya॰

tathāpi punardīrghatvahrasvatvayorbhāvābhyupagame hrasvatvapratiyogino dīrghatvasyābhāvānna dīrghatvam
na dvaye, uktanyāyāt svaparayoḥ pratidvandvitvādvā

etadantargataḥ pāṭho ya॰ pratau nāsti
ucyateya॰
tathāpi punarityādi
punarapi ca dīrghatva-hrasvatvayorbhāvābhyupagame'pi hrasvatvapratiyogino dīrghatvasyābhāvānna sidhyati dīrghatvam, svātmani paratra vā vṛttyasambhavāt
syānmatam--ubhayatra vartate'nyāpekṣatvādubhayoḥ hrasvamapekṣya dīrghaṃ sidhyati dīrghamapekṣya hrasvaṃ sidhyatīti
etacca na dvaye, kasmāt ? uktanyāyāt, yathā dīrghe dīrghatvaṃ na parāyattatvāt ityupakramya yāvat itaretarāśrayatvādasiddhiḥ ityuktād nyāyānna sidhyati dīrghatā, tathā hrasve'pi na vartata ityadhunoktād nyāyānna sidhyati, dvayoranyataratrāpyasiddhasya kuta ubhayatra siddhiḥ ? sva-parayoḥ pratidvandvitvādvā, yathā dīrghatvaṃ dīrghe hrasve ca vartate tathā hrasvatvamapi dīrghe hrasve ca vartate, ata ubhayorubhayatra bhāvo virodhī, tayoḥ sahavṛttirayuktā virodhitvādeva parasparam ityuktam
tasmānna svato na parato nobhayataśca dīrghatvaṃ sidhyati hrasvatvaṃ vā, evaṃ hrasvatve'pi ityatidekṣyamāṇatvāt

॰tideśyamāṇa॰ya॰
kiñcānyat, ubhayatra dīrghatvavṛttireṣā, sā tvitaretarayogaḥ, eṣo'pi cintyaḥ--kiṃ hrasve svāśrayāddīrghādanyatra vartamāne dīrghatve dīrghaṃ bhavati ? uta svāśraye dīrgha eva vartamāne dīrghatvaṃ bhavati ? iti nirdhāryam
kiñcātaḥ ? yadi hrasve ityādi, yadi hrasve vartamānaṃ dīrghatvamubhayatra bhāvamitaretarayogaṃ labhata itīṣyate prathamavikalpa iti, tataḥ kim ? tato hrasve vartamānaṃ dīrghatvaṃ hrasvasya dīrghatāṃ na cākurvāṇaṃ dīrghasya tadātmatāṃ tadbuddhiṃ ca na kuryāt, tato'nyatra vṛttatvāt, hrasvādīrghatvapratyayavat
dīrgha eva vartamāne dīrghatve dīrghaṃ bhavati tato dīrgha eva dīrghatāṃ karoti tatpratyayaṃ cādhatte, kintu hrasvena tatpratyayena ca nārthaḥ
atha tatra dīrghatāṃ na karoti na vā tatpratyayamādadhāti tato hrasve kathaṃ dīrghatvaṃ kuryāt, tato'nyatra vṛttatvāt, hrasvādīrghapratyayavat
athocyeta--hrasve dīrghatāṃ naiva karoti tatpratyayamapi nādadhāti
etadapi na, hrasvadīrghayoḥ parasparāpekṣasiddherloke dṛṣṭatvāt tatpratyayasya ca
tadyathā--siddhārthaka...
...
karoti na ca dīrghapratyayamādhatte, tat svādhārasya tadātmatāṃ tatpratyayaṃ cākurvāṇaṃ hrasvasya dīrghasyānādhārasya dīrghatāṃ dīrghaḥ iti buddhiṃ ca kathaṃ kuryāt ? na kuryād nādadhyāt tadbuddhiṃ ca, tato'nyatra vṛttatvāt, yad yato'nyatra vartate tat tasya tattāṃ na karoti na ca tadbuddhimādadhāti, hrasvādīrghatvapratyayavat, yathā hrasve dīrghatvaṃ na karoti nādadhāti tatpratyayaṃ tathā dīrghatvaṃ dīrgheṃ dīrghapratyayaṃ ca na kuryād nādadhyāditi

॰ṣvatibhā॰
pṛ॰ 830 paṃ॰ 1
yadi hi svaviṣayamevaitat syāt ghaṭo nāghaṭo'pi syāt
kathaṃ punaraghaṭo'pi bhavati ? ityata āha --bhavati tvitaretaraḥ
tasya cāghaṭatve evaṃ tasya ghaṭasyaivāghaṭatve yathā'sāvaghaṭastathānye'pi ghaṭā aghaṭā eveti ghaṭābhāvaḥ
paṭādayastvaghaṭā eva siddhāḥ
tasya ghaṭasyābhāve'ghaṭābhāvaḥ, kasmāt ? ghaṭāpekṣatvādaghaṭatvasya, so'pyevamaghaṭo na bhavatīti, aghaṭaḥ tasmādanyo ghaṭaḥ paṭo vā, etadghaṭatvā kadā ghaṭaḥ setsyati pratyekavyaktyātmā yadāsau ghaṭo'ghaṭo bhavati, kadā'ghaṭo setsyati yadāsau ghaṭo bhavatītītaretarāśrayatvādasiddhiḥ
evaṃ tarhi darśitadigaghaṭa eva ghaṭatvaṃ tathādṛṣṭatvāditi cet, aghaṭe'pi na ghaṭatvaṃ pratyakṣata evāghaṭe ghaṭatvābhāvāt pratidvandvitvācca hrasvadīrghatvavat
aghaṭasya vā ghaṭatve ghaṭa eva so'ghaṭaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ ko ghaṭo nāmāghaṭādanyaḥ, ghaṭatvābhāvātmakatvādaghaṭatvasya...
na dvaye, yathā ghaṭe ghaṭatvaṃ na vartate parāyattatvād ghaṭatvasya tathā'ghaṭe'pi na vartate
dvayoranyataratrāpyasiddheḥ kuta ubhayatra vartate pratidvandvitvāt svaparayorapi
ayamapi cetaretarayogaścintyaḥ kimaghaṭe vartamāne ghaṭatve ghaṭo bhavati uta ghaṭa eva vartamāne ? yadi aghaṭe vartamānaṃ ghaṭatvamubhayatra bhāvaṃ labhate tato'ghaṭe ghaṭatvamaghaṭasya tadātmatāṃ tatpratyayaṃ cākurvāṇaṃ ghaṭasya tadātmatāṃ tatpratyayaṃ ca na kuryāt, tato'nyatra vṛttatvāt, paṭāghaṭatvapratyayavat
ghaṭa eva vartamāne ghaṭatve ghaṭo bhavati tato ghaṭa eva ghaṭatāṃ karoti tatpratyayaṃ cādhatte, kintu aghaṭena tatpratyayena ca nārthaḥ
atha tatra ghaṭatāṃ na karoti yattatvād ghaṭatvasya, parasparāyattavṛttitvād ghaṭatvāghaṭatvayoḥ
taddarśayati --kadā ghaṭaḥ setsyati pratyekavyaktyātmā ghaṭāntaravyāvṛttaviviktavyaktasvarūpaḥ
yadāsau ghaṭa ityādi pūrvavad grantho neyo dīrgha-hrasvayoriva ghaṭāghaṭayoryāvaditaretarāśrayatvādasiddhiḥ
evaṃ tāvad ghaṭe nāsti ghaṭatvam

॰ktasvarūpaḥya॰

ubhayobhayapakṣastūbhayadoṣāpattervipratiṣedhācca

evaṃ sarvārtheṣvapītyasiddhireva
athāntareṇāpītaretarayogaṃ svata eva sidhyati ghaṭa iti cet, yadyasti ghaṭa ekastatastasya sattvaikatvaghaṭatvānāṃ yuktisteṣāmekatve'nyatve vā na sambhavati
yadadyastyeko ghaṭa iti trayāṇāmekatvaṃ tato yatraikatvaṃ tatrāstitvasyāpi niṣkalenaiva svatattvena
evamaghaṭatve'pītyatideśo'pi pūrvavadeva
tasya diśaṃ darśayati --nāghaṭe'ghaṭatvamityādinā svayameva granthakāro yāvatkāreṇa yāvad ghaṭatvavadanusartavyamiti gatatvānnyāyasya
